 RETURNS SETOF ops.pdf_published_revision
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT pdf_published_revision.build_id,
     pdf_published_revision.task_id,
     pdf_published_revision.product_key,
     pdf_published_revision.logical_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.release_id,
     pdf_published_revision.source_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.schema_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest,
     pdf_published_revision.kind
    FROM (ops.pdf_published_revision
      JOIN ops.pdf_stage_build ON ((pdf_published_revision.build_id = pdf_stage_build.build_id)))
   WHERE ((pdf_published_revision.task_id = read_pdf_published_revision.p_task) AND (pdf_published_revision.product_key = read_pdf_published_revision.p_key) AND (pdf_published_revision.logical_digest = read_pdf_published_revision.p_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.state = 'published'::text));
END

SELECT pdf_published_revision.task_id,
    pdf_published_revision.product_key,
    pdf_published_revision.logical_digest AS content_digest,
    pdf_published_revision.release_id,
    contract_input.content_digest AS contract_digest,
    pdf_published_revision.schema_digest,
    pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest,
    NULL::bigint AS parent_task_id,
    NULL::text AS parent_product_key,
    NULL::text AS parent_digest,
    NULL::jsonb AS native_json,
    ( SELECT pdf_record_companion.body - ARRAY['source_scope'::text, 'page_start'::text, 'page_end'::text] AS anon_1
           FROM kb.pdf_record_companion
          WHERE pdf_record_companion.product_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id AND pdf_record_companion.revision_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id AND pdf_record_companion.family = 'health'::text AND pdf_record_companion.body ? 'source_scope'::text
          ORDER BY pdf_record_companion.ordinal, pdf_record_companion.local_id
         LIMIT 1) AS health,
    NULL::bytea AS payload
   FROM ops.pdf_published_revision
     JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation ON pdf_build_validation.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id
     JOIN sem.input contract_input ON contract_input.release_id = pdf_published_revision.release_id AND contract_input.input_kind = 'dependency'::text AND contract_input.input_name = 'pdf-domain/schema/pdf_products'::text;

DECLARE
 principal name := SESSION_USER;
 owner_oid oid;
BEGIN
 SELECT pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspowner 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname = 'sem' INTO owner_oid;
 IF (pg_catalog.pg_has_role(principal, owner_oid, 'MEMBER')) THEN
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF (NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(principal, 'corpus_sem_admitter', 'USAGE') OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(principal, 'corpus_sem_publisher', 'MEMBER') OR (EXISTS (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_roles.oid 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolname = principal AND (pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolsuper OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolcreaterole OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolcreatedb OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolbypassrls OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolreplication))) OR pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.current_database(), 'TEMP') OR (EXISTS (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname IN ('sem', 'data', 'ops', 'kb', 'eval') AND pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid, 'CREATE'))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_class.oid 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ON pg_catalog.pg_class.relnamespace = pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname IN ('sem', 'data') AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND (pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_class.oid, 'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER') OR pg_catalog.has_any_column_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_class.oid, 'INSERT,UPDATE')))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_class.oid 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ON pg_catalog.pg_class.relnamespace = pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname IN ('eval') AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_class.oid, 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE'))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements((data.execution_contract_descriptor())['functions']) AS anon_1 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc ON pg_catalog.pg_proc.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure((anon_1.value ->> 'signature')) 
WHERE pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_proc.oid, 'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((anon_1.value['execute_roles'] ? 'corpus_sem_admitter'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'unrestricted admission caller', ERRCODE = '42501';
 END IF;
END

DECLARE
 p jsonb := jsonb_build_object('scope', boundary.scope);
 node record;
BEGIN
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS requested JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (requested.value ->> 'operation') 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id IN ('record_policy.grade', 'record_policy.fit', 'record_policy.authorize') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles || sem.data_operation_definition.output_roles) AS role_1 JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = (role_1.value ->> 'kind_contract') 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.universe = 'evaluator')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'record census cannot consume a protected judgment demand', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 FOR node IN WITH RECURSIVE selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry, source_set.value AS source_set 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value['entries']) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AND ops.ddo_source_set_proof_matches(source_entries.source_set, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id, source_entries.entry ->> 'member', ops.data_derivation.id, ops.demand_use.id, jsonb_build_object('member_id', ops.data_derivation_output.member_id, 'role', ops.data_derivation_output.role, 'position', ops.data_derivation_output.position, 'multiplicity', ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity)))) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT support_closure.kind, support_closure.id 
FROM support_closure LOOP
  IF (node.kind = 'episode' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = ops.data_derivation.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = ops.data_request.operation_id 
WHERE ops.data_derivation.id = node.id AND (sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id IN ('record_policy.grade', 'record_policy.fit', 'record_policy.authorize') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles || sem.data_operation_definition.output_roles) AS role_1 JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = (role_1.value ->> 'kind_contract') 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.universe = 'evaluator')))))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'record census support reaches a protected judgment', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF (node.kind = 'original' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.original_source_admission.product_id JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.id = node.id AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe = 'evaluator'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'record census source reaches a protected judgment', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
END

WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.universe = 'evaluator')))))) THEN

FROM ops.original_source_admission JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.original_source_admission.product_id JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract

'obligation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.id = (p ->> 'obligation_id'))))) THEN jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'selection', CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND boundary.scope != CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN jsonb_build_object('version', 'data-demand-public-selection-v1', 'model', d.selection['model'], 'intent_digest', ops.ddo_digest(d.selection), 'roots', d.selection['roots'], 'targets', d.selection['targets'], 'root_operations', d.selection['root_operations'], 'discovery', d.selection['discovery']) ELSE d.selection END, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'view', selected_view, 'after', (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded), 'limit', lim, 'max_bytes', selected_max_bytes) ELSE NULL END)) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END AS result INTO results;
  SELECT obligations || coalesce(jsonb_object_agg((page_rows.value ->> 'obligation_id'), page_rows.value), CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) AS anon_1

  SELECT uses_ || coalesce(jsonb_object_agg((page_rows.value ->> 'use_id'), page_rows.value), CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) AS anon_1

  IF (results['payload']['continuation'] IS NULL OR results['payload']['continuation'] = CAST('null' AS JSONB)) THEN
   EXIT;

 END LOOP;
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1

WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true),

(SELECT selected_output_validity_rows.kind AS kind, selected_output_validity_rows.id AS id, selected_output_validity_rows.valid AS valid

selected_output_seed AS

support_closure(kind, id) AS

FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) THEN 'authority' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END = 'episode' AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END)) THEN 'authority' ELSE CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END AS TEXT) AS id

WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((CAST(ops.ddo_structural_report_support(ops.demand_use.id, boundary, (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS JSONB) ->> 'use_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected_output)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE CASE WHEN ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind IN ('episode', 'authority') AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND true AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1

 RETURN jsonb_build_object('obligations', obligations, 'uses', uses_, 'outputs', outputs);

 outputs jsonb;

 SELECT ops.data_demand_read.*

(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid

'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1

(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid

WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = export_scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true 
WHERE (p ->> 'support_scope') = 'read'),

'subject') OR ops.original_source_admission.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.original_source_admission.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? FROM ops.data_population

WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1

WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.data_obligation.id > (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) AND (NOT (p ? 'obligation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.id = (p ->> 'obligation_id'))))) THEN jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'selection', CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND boundary.scope != CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN jsonb_build_object('version', 'data-demand-public-selection-v1', 'model', d.selection['model'], 'intent_digest', ops.ddo_digest(d.selection), 'roots', d.selection['roots'], 'targets', d.selection['targets'], 'root_operations', d.selection['root_operations'], 'discovery', d.selection['discovery']) ELSE d.selection END, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'view', selected_view, 'after', (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2

  SELECT obligations || coalesce(jsonb_object_agg((page_rows.value ->> 'obligation_id'), page_rows.value), CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) AS anon_1

  SELECT uses_ || coalesce(jsonb_object_agg((page_rows.value ->> 'use_id'), page_rows.value), CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) AS anon_1

  IF (results['payload']['continuation'] IS NULL OR results['payload']['continuation'] = CAST('null' AS JSONB)) THEN

 END LOOP;
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid

 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true),

support_closure(kind, id) AS

FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((CAST(ops.ddo_structural_report_support(ops.demand_use.id, boundary, (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS JSONB) ->> 'use_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected_output)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1

DECLARE

 e bigint;

(SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE root_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(support) AS root_support_reference(value)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT source AS source UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = project)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(project, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project ORDER BY scope LOOP
  INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope (scope, project_id, epoch) VALUES (scope_key, project, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  SELECT ops.data_trust_scope.epoch 
FROM ops.data_trust_scope 
WHERE ops.data_trust_scope.scope = scope_key FOR SHARE INTO e;
  snapshot := snapshot || jsonb_build_object(scope_key, e);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN snapshot;
END

FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT source AS source UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = project)
 SELECT ordinary_scopes.scope 
FROM (SELECT ops.ddo_scope(project, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project ORDER BY scope) AS ordinary_scopes UNION SELECT grade_completion.scope 
FROM ops.ddo_record_grade_completion_scopes(r) AS grade_completion(scope) UNION SELECT fit_completion.scope 
FROM ops.ddo_record_fit_completion_scopes(r) AS fit_completion(scope) UNION SELECT event_completion.scope 
FROM ops.ddo_operation_event_completion_scopes(r) AS event_completion(scope) ORDER BY scope LOOP
  INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope (scope, project_id, epoch) VALUES (scope_key, project, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  SELECT ops.data_trust_scope.epoch 
FROM ops.data_trust_scope 
WHERE ops.data_trust_scope.scope = scope_key FOR SHARE INTO e;
  snapshot := snapshot || jsonb_build_object(scope_key, e);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN snapshot;
END$$

catalog.body:
DECLARE
 facts jsonb;
 edges jsonb;
 good text[] := CAST('{}' AS text[]);
 added text[];
BEGIN
 WITH RECURSIVE nodes(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT seeds.kind AS kind, seeds.id AS id 
FROM (SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, anon_2.id AS id 
FROM unnest(seed_uses) AS anon_2(id) UNION SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, anon_3.id AS id 
FROM unnest(seed_episodes) AS anon_3(id) UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, anon_4.id AS id 
FROM unnest(seed_populations) AS anon_4(id)) AS seeds UNION SELECT edge.child_kind AS child_kind, edge.child_id AS child_id 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL ops.ddo_validity_edges(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS edge ON true 
WHERE edge.child_id IS NOT NULL), 
adjacency AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT CAST(jsonb_build_array(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS TEXT) AS parent, adjacent.alternative AS alternative, CASE WHEN (adjacent.child_id IS NOT NULL) THEN CAST(jsonb_build_array(adjacent.child_kind, adjacent.child_id) AS TEXT) END AS child 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL ops.ddo_validity_edges(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS adjacent ON true), 
reach(parent, child) AS 
(SELECT adjacency.parent AS parent, adjacency.child AS child 
FROM adjacency 
WHERE adjacency.child IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT reach.parent AS parent, adjacency.child AS child 
FROM reach JOIN adjacency ON adjacency.parent = reach.child 
WHERE adjacency.child IS NOT NULL), 
direct AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT nodes.kind AS kind, nodes.id AS id, CAST(jsonb_build_array(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS TEXT) AS key, ops.ddo_validity_direct(nodes.kind, nodes.id, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM reach 
WHERE reach.parent = CAST(jsonb_build_array(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS TEXT) AND reach.child = reach.parent)) AS valid 
FROM nodes)
 SELECT (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(direct)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM direct) AS anon_1, (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(adjacency)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_2 
FROM adjacency) AS anon_5 INTO facts, edges;
 WHILE true LOOP
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(fact.value ->> 'key'), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(facts, CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS fact 
WHERE CAST(fact.value ->> 'valid' AS BOOLEAN) AND NOT ((fact.value ->> 'key') = ANY (good)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(edges, CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS known_edge 
WHERE (known_edge.value ->> 'parent') = (fact.value ->> 'key') GROUP BY known_edge.value ->> 'alternative' 
HAVING bool_and((known_edge.value ->> 'child') IS NULL OR (known_edge.value ->> 'child') = ANY (good)))) INTO added;
  IF (cardinality(added) = 0) THEN
   EXIT;
  END IF;
  good := good || added;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT fact.value ->> 'kind' AS anon_1, fact.value ->> 'id' AS anon_2, (fact.value ->> 'key') = ANY (good) AS anon_3 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(facts, CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS fact;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_valid_closure(seed_uses text[], seed_episodes text[], boundary ops.data_demand_read = NULL, seed_populations text[] = CAST('{}' AS text[])) RETURNS TABLE (kind text, id text, valid boolean) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$DECLARE
 facts jsonb;
 edges jsonb;
 good text[] := CAST('{}' AS text[]);
 added text[];
BEGIN
 WITH RECURSIVE nodes(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT seeds.kind AS kind, seeds.id AS id 
FROM (SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, anon_2.id AS id 
FROM unnest(seed_uses) AS anon_2(id) UNION SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, anon_3.id AS id 
FROM unnest(seed_episodes) AS anon_3(id) UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, anon_4.id AS id 
FROM unnest(seed_populations) AS anon_4(id)) AS seeds UNION SELECT edge.child_kind AS child_kind, edge.child_id AS child_id 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL ops.ddo_validity_edges(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS edge ON true 
WHERE edge.child_id IS NOT NULL), 
adjacency AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT CAST(jsonb_build_array(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS TEXT) AS parent, adjacent.alternative AS alternative, CASE WHEN (adjacent.child_id IS NOT NULL) THEN CAST(jsonb_build_array(adjacent.child_kind, adjacent.child_id) AS TEXT) END AS child 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL ops.ddo_validity_edges(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS adjacent ON true), 
reach(parent, child) AS 
(SELECT adjacency.parent AS parent, adjacency.child AS child 
FROM adjacency 
WHERE adjacency.child IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT reach.parent AS parent, adjacency.child AS child 
FROM reach JOIN adjacency ON adjacency.parent = reach.child 
WHERE adjacency.child IS NOT NULL), 
direct AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT nodes.kind AS kind, nodes.id AS id, CAST(jsonb_build_array(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS TEXT) AS key, ops.ddo_validity_direct(nodes.kind, nodes.id, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM reach 
WHERE reach.parent = CAST(jsonb_build_array(nodes.kind, nodes.id) AS TEXT) AND reach.child = reach.parent)) AS valid 
FROM nodes)
 SELECT (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(direct)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM direct) AS anon_1, (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(adjacency)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_2 
FROM adjacency) AS anon_5 INTO facts, edges;
 WHILE true LOOP
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(fact.value ->> 'key'), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(facts, CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS fact 
WHERE CAST(fact.value ->> 'valid' AS BOOLEAN) AND NOT ((fact.value ->> 'key') = ANY (good)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(edges, CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS known_edge 
WHERE (known_edge.value ->> 'parent') = (fact.value ->> 'key') GROUP BY known_edge.value ->> 'alternative' 
HAVING bool_and((known_edge.value ->> 'child') IS NULL OR (known_edge.value ->> 'child') = ANY (good)))) INTO added;
  IF (cardinality(added) = 0) THEN
   EXIT;
  END IF;
  good := good || added;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT fact.value ->> 'kind' AS anon_1, fact.value ->> 'id' AS anon_2, (fact.value ->> 'key') = ANY (good) AS anon_3 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(facts, CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS fact;
END$$

DECLARE
 key text;
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 subject_scopes jsonb;
 root_context jsonb;
 selected_definition sem.data_operation_definition%ROWTYPE;
 inserted_count bigint;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_fields(p_payload, ARRAY['project_id', 'release_id', 'runtime_id', 'root', 'selection', 'strength']);
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM data.project 
WHERE data.project.project_id = (p_payload ->> 'project_id'))) OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id'))) OR ((p_payload ->> 'strength') NOT IN ('value', 'episode', 'independent'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'unadmitted demand/project/strength', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (((p_payload['selection']) ->> 'version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'data-demand-intent-v2' OR p_payload['root'] IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload['selection']['roots'] OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_release 
WHERE sem.data_operation_release.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_release.lowering_digest = '653ff73a7cc24ca3cc48d2999a0635313e84c83290b4fb9b2b2af21fc35f35b0' AND sem.data_operation_release.model_digest = ((p_payload['selection']) ->> 'model'))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected 
WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') AND sem.data_operation_definition.recipe = (selected.value ->> 'recipe') AND sem.data_operation_definition.definition_identity = (selected.value ->> 'definition') AND sem.data_operation_definition.eligibility_identity = (selected.value ->> 'eligibility')))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'demand differs from authenticated effective model/selection', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected GROUP BY (selected.value ->> 'operation') 
HAVING count(*) != 1)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') 
WHERE NOT (sem.data_operation_definition.dependencies['required'] <@ selected.value['dependencies']) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected.value['dependencies']) AS local_dependency_1 
WHERE NOT (((sem.data_operation_definition.dependencies['required'] || sem.data_operation_definition.dependencies['potential']) ? local_dependency_1.value)))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected.value['dependencies']) AS local_dependency_1 GROUP BY local_dependency_1.value 
HAVING count(*) != 1)))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected.value['dependencies']) AS dependency_1 ON true 
WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS target 
WHERE (target.value ->> 'operation') = dependency_1.value))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'selected dependencies differ from the authenticated declared graph', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery GROUP BY (discovery.value ->> 'population') 
HAVING count(distinct(jsonb_build_array((discovery.value ->> 'producer'), (discovery.value ->> 'output_role')))) != 1)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery GROUP BY discovery.value 
HAVING count(*) != 1))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'discovery population requires one source projection and distinct targets', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery 
WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (discovery.value ->> 'producer') AND sem.data_operation_definition.profile = 'discovery' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.output_roles) AS producer_output_1 
WHERE (producer_output_1.value ->> 'name') = (discovery.value ->> 'output_role'))))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'discovery relation differs from declared producer output', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery 
WHERE (discovery.value ? 'target_role') AND (jsonb_typeof(discovery.value['target_role']) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition AS target_kind JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(target_kind.input_roles) AS input_role_1 ON true JOIN sem.data_operation_definition AS producer ON producer.release_id = target_kind.release_id AND producer.operation_id = (discovery.value ->> 'producer') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(producer.output_roles) AS output_role_1 ON true JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = (output_role_1.value ->> 'kind_contract') 
WHERE target_kind.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND target_kind.operation_id = (discovery.value ->> 'target') AND (input_role_1.value ->> 'name') = (discovery.value ->> 'target_role') AND (output_role_1.value ->> 'name') = (discovery.value ->> 'output_role') AND (coalesce(input_role_1.value['support']['origins'], CAST('["computation"]' AS JSONB)) ? 'computation') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(input_role_1.value['accepted_kind_contracts']) AS accepted_1 
WHERE (sem.data_kind_contract.member_contracts ? accepted_1.value)))))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery 
WHERE (discovery.value ? 'target_role') GROUP BY (discovery.value ->> 'target'), (discovery.value ->> 'target_role') 
HAVING count(*) != 1))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'discovery target role differs from declared member/input contracts', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE edges AS 
(SELECT selected.value ->> 'operation' AS source, dependency_1.value AS target 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected.value['dependencies']) AS dependency_1 ON true), 
reach(source, target) AS 
(SELECT edges.source AS source, edges.target AS target 
FROM edges UNION SELECT reach.source AS source, edges.target AS target 
FROM reach JOIN edges ON edges.source = reach.target)
 SELECT 1 
FROM reach 
WHERE reach.source = reach.target)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'selected demand dependency cycle', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE roots AS 
(SELECT demand_target.value AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_payload['selection']['targets']) AS demand_target UNION SELECT discovery.value ->> 'producer' AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery), 
root_closure(id) AS 
(SELECT roots.id AS id 
FROM roots UNION SELECT root_closure_dependency_1.value AS value 
FROM root_closure JOIN jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected ON (selected.value ->> 'operation') = root_closure.id JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected.value['dependencies']) AS root_closure_dependency_1 ON true), 
member_closure(id) AS 
(SELECT (discovery.value ->> 'target') AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery UNION SELECT member_closure_dependency_1.value AS value 
FROM member_closure JOIN jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected ON (selected.value ->> 'operation') = member_closure.id JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected.value['dependencies']) AS member_closure_dependency_1 ON true)
 SELECT 1 
FROM (SELECT root_closure.id AS id 
FROM root_closure 
WHERE root_closure.id IN (SELECT roots.id 
FROM roots) OR (root_closure.id NOT IN (SELECT member_closure.id 
FROM member_closure))) AS root_expected FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT root_operation.value AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_payload['selection']['root_operations']) AS root_operation) AS declared_root ON root_expected.id = declared_root.id 
WHERE root_expected.id IS NULL OR declared_root.id IS NULL)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'root operations differ from selected dependency closure', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE all_roots AS 
(SELECT demand_target.value AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_payload['selection']['targets']) AS demand_target UNION SELECT discovery.value ->> 'producer' AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery UNION SELECT discovery.value ->> 'target' AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['discovery']) AS discovery), 
selected_closure(id) AS 
(SELECT all_roots.id AS id 
FROM all_roots UNION SELECT selected_closure_dependency_1.value AS value 
FROM selected_closure JOIN jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected ON (selected.value ->> 'operation') = selected_closure.id JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(selected.value['dependencies']) AS selected_closure_dependency_1 ON true)
 SELECT 1 
FROM selected_closure FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT selected.value ->> 'operation' AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected) AS declared_operations ON selected_closure.id = declared_operations.id 
WHERE selected_closure.id IS NULL OR declared_operations.id IS NULL)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'selected operations differ from requested target/discovery closure', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_validate_parameters(compiled_operation_1.value, selected.value, CAST(convert_from(sem.artifact.content, 'UTF8') AS JSONB)) AS ddo_validate_parameters_1 
FROM sem.artifact JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements((CAST(convert_from(sem.artifact.content, 'UTF8') AS JSONB))['operations']) AS compiled_operation_1 ON true JOIN jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected ON (selected.value ->> 'operation') = (compiled_operation_1.value ->> 'semantic_id') 
WHERE sem.artifact.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.artifact.artifact_name = 'data_operations.json';
 PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(sem.data_kind_contract.universe) AS ddo_authorize_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles || sem.data_operation_definition.output_roles) AS role_1 ON true JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = (role_1.value ->> 'kind_contract');
 IF ((p_payload ->> 'strength') = 'independent') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'independent strength requires declared distinct-episode replicate obligations', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') 
WHERE (selected.value ->> 'replicate') = '' OR ops.ddo_replicate_required((sem.data_operation_definition.support_contract ->> 'replicate_policy')) IS DISTINCT FROM ((selected.value ->> 'replicate') IS NOT NULL))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'replicate selection differs from declared operation policy', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF ((p_payload ->> 'strength') = 'episode' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS role_1 ON true 
WHERE NOT ((role_1.value['identity_requirements'] ? 'episode'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'episode strength requires episode-qualified input contracts', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 subject_scopes := ops.ddo_release_subject_scopes(p_payload ->> 'release_id');
 FOR root_context IN SELECT requested_root.value 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['root']) AS requested_root LOOP
  FOR selected_definition IN SELECT sem.data_operation_definition.* 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND p_payload['selection']['root_operations'] ? sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id LOOP
   PERFORM ops.ddo_require_subject_source(subject_scopes, selected_definition.subject_definition, root_context ->> 'original_source');
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_validate_source_sets(coalesce(p_payload['selection']['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)), p_payload ->> 'project_id', subject_scopes);
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_source_set_acquisitions(coalesce(p_payload['selection']['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)), p_payload ->> 'project_id');
 IF ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p_payload['selection']['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS named_set 
WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS role_1 ON true 
WHERE ((role_1.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') = named_set.key)))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['selection']['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = (p_payload ->> 'release_id') AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS role_1 ON true 
WHERE ((role_1.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NOT NULL AND NOT ((coalesce(p_payload['selection']['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? ((role_1.value['support']) ->> 'source_set')))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'frozen source sets differ from admitted selected role policies', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_runtime_binding(p_payload ->> 'release_id', p_payload ->> 'runtime_id');
 key := 'demand:' || ops.ddo_digest(p_payload);
 INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope (scope, project_id, epoch) SELECT DISTINCT ops.ddo_scope(p_payload ->> 'project_id', scoped_sources.root ->> 'original_source') AS scope, p_payload ->> 'project_id' AS anon_1, 0 AS anon_2 
FROM (SELECT requested_root.value AS root 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload['root']) AS requested_root UNION ALL SELECT source_entry_1.value AS value 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p_payload['selection']['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS named_set JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(named_set.value['entries']) AS source_entry_1 ON true) AS scoped_sources ORDER BY scope ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO ops.data_demand (id, project_id, release_id, runtime_id, root, selection, strength, created_at) VALUES (key, (p_payload ->> 'project_id'), (p_payload ->> 'release_id'), (p_payload ->> 'runtime_id'), (p_payload['root']), (p_payload['selection']), (p_payload ->> 'strength'), clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = key INTO STRICT d;
 INSERT INTO ops.data_obligation (id, demand_id, operation_id, subject, original_source, analyzed_scope, parameters, created_at, created_xid) SELECT 'obligation:' || ops.ddo_digest(qualified.payload) AS anon_1, d.id, qualified.payload ->> 'operation_id' AS anon_2, qualified.payload ->> 'subject' AS anon_3, qualified.payload ->> 'original_source' AS anon_4, qualified.payload['analyzed_scope'] AS anon_5, qualified.payload['parameters'] AS anon_6, clock_timestamp() AS clock_timestamp_1, CAST(pg_current_xact_id() AS TEXT) AS pg_current_xact_id_1 
FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'operation_id', selected.value ->> 'operation', 'subject', root.value ->> 'subject', 'original_source', root.value ->> 'original_source', 'analyzed_scope', root.value['analyzed_scope'], 'parameters', selected.value['parameters']) AS payload 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root JOIN jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected ON true 
WHERE d.selection['root_operations'] ? (selected.value ->> 'operation')) AS qualified 
WHERE true ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 GET DIAGNOSTICS inserted_count = ROW_COUNT;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('payload', jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'selection', d.selection, 'inserted_obligations', inserted_count) || CASE WHEN ops.ddo_demand_active(d.id) THEN CAST('{}' AS JSONB) ELSE jsonb_build_object('state', 'cancelled') END);
END
