WHERE latest.fate = 'attached' AND ops.data_external_packet.request_id = latest.request_id AND ops.data_external_packet.generation = latest.generation AND ops.ddo_request_useful(data_request) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_external_receipt 
WHERE ops.data_external_receipt.packet_id = ops.data_external_packet.id)))) THEN 'awaiting-external' ELSE coalesce(latest.fate, 'waiting') END, 'request_id', latest.request_id, 'generation', latest.generation, 'intent_id', (SELECT ops.data_completion_intent.id 
FROM ops.data_completion_intent 
WHERE ops.data_completion_intent.request_id = latest.request_id AND ops.data_completion_intent.generation = latest.generation ORDER BY ops.data_completion_intent.created_at DESC, ops.data_completion_intent.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY bounded.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_5 
FROM bounded LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = bounded.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 'original_source_admissions', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('admission_id', ops.original_source_admission.id, 'selection_name', ops.original_source_admission.selection_name, 'product_id', ops.original_source_admission.product_id, 'kind_contract', kb.data_product.kind_contract, 'subject', ops.original_source_admission.subject, 'subject_definition', kb.data_product.subject_definition, 'original_source', ops.original_source_admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope, 'source_reference', ops.original_source_admission.source_reference, 'trust_snapshot', ops.original_source_admission.trust_snapshot, 'evidence', ops.original_source_admission.evidence) ORDER BY ops.original_source_admission.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_6 
FROM ops.original_source_admission JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.original_source_admission.product_id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM bounded 
WHERE bounded.subject = ops.original_source_admission.subject AND bounded.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.original_source_admission.original_source AND bounded.analyzed_scope = ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope)) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.original_source_admission.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.original_source_admission.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_original_product(value) 
WHERE (scope_original_product.value #>> '{}'::text[]) = ops.original_source_admission.product_id))) AND ops.ddo_original_admission_valid(original_source_admission, boundary) AND CASE WHEN (NOT boundary.public_disclosure OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_kind_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract) ELSE false END), 'support_page', CASE WHEN (selected_view = 'support') THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT coalesce(bool_and(ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body)), true) AS coalesce_2 
FROM kb.data_product 
WHERE kb.data_product.id IN (SELECT export_products.product_id 
FROM export_products)) THEN CASE WHEN ((SELECT coalesce(sum(octet_length(CAST(support_export_page.record AS TEXT))), 0) AS coalesce_7 
FROM support_export_page) <= selected_max_bytes) THEN jsonb_build_object('records', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', support_export_page.key, 'relation', support_export_page.relation, 'record', support_export_page.record) ORDER BY support_export_page.key), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_8 
FROM support_export_page), 'after', CASE WHEN ((SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM support_export_bounded) > lim) THEN (SELECT max(support_export_page.key) AS max_1 
FROM support_export_page) ELSE NULL END, 'complete', (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM support_export_bounded) <= lim) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE NULL END, 'attempt_failures', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('failure_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.id, 'request_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, 'generation', ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, 'task_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.task_id, 'attempt', ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt, 'holder', ops.data_attempt_failure.holder, 'failure', CASE WHEN ((ops.data_attempt_failure.failure ? 'd1_limitation') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_request JOIN jsonb_array_elements(ops.data_request.binding['inputs']) AS failure_input(value) ON true JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = (failure_input.value ->> 'product_id') LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_product_member AS failure_member ON failure_member.product_id = kb.data_product.id AND failure_member.member_id = (failure_input.value ->> 'member_id') 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND NOT CASE WHEN (NOT boundary.public_disclosure OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_kind_access(coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract)) ELSE false END))) THEN (ops.data_attempt_failure.failure - 'd1_limitation') || jsonb_build_object('d1_limitation_disclosure', 'undisclosed') ELSE ops.data_attempt_failure.failure END) ORDER BY ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_9 
FROM ops.data_attempt_failure 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.request_id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND selected_uses.generation = ops.data_attempt_failure.generation)) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_attempt_failure.created_at, ops.data_attempt_failure.created_xid, boundary)), 'populations', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(((((to_jsonb(data_population) - 'created_at') - 'created_xid') - 'selected_obligation_id') - 'context_key') || jsonb_build_object('population_id', ops.data_population.id, 'evidence', ops.data_population.evidence || jsonb_build_object('producer_context', ops.ddo_population_producer_context(data_population))) ORDER BY ops.data_population.name), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_10 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.id IN (SELECT candidate_populations.id 
FROM candidate_populations) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM page_validity 
WHERE page_validity.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = page_validity.id AND page_validity.valid))), 'continuation', CASE WHEN ((SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT ops.data_obligation.id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.data_obligation.id > (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) AND (NOT (p ? 'obligation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.id = (p ->> 'obligation_id'))))) THEN jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'selection', CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND boundary.scope != CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN jsonb_build_object('version', 'data-demand-public-selection-v1', 'model', d.selection['model'], 'intent_digest', ops.ddo_digest(d.selection), 'roots', d.selection['roots'], 'targets', d.selection['targets'], 'root_operations', d.selection['root_operations'], 'discovery', d.selection['discovery']) ELSE d.selection END, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'view', selected_view, 'after', (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded), 'limit', lim, 'max_bytes', selected_max_bytes) ELSE NULL END)) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END AS result INTO results;
 IF (selected_view IN ('products', 'support') AND octet_length(data.canonical_json(results)) > selected_max_bytes) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'complete native product page envelope exceeds max_bytes; reduce the page limit', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 RETURN results;
END$$

DECLARE
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 snapshot jsonb;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = p_demand INTO STRICT d;
 IF (p_read IS NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'binding requires exact native read acquisition', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 SELECT ops.data_demand_read.* 
FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = p_read AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = d.id INTO STRICT boundary;
 IF (p_read_checked) THEN
  snapshot := p_trust;
 ELSE
  snapshot := ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, d.project_id);
 END IF;
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected_operations(value) 
WHERE (selected_operations.value ->> 'operation') = p_operation))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'projection operation outside frozen demand', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (p_source IS NOT NULL) THEN
  IF ((jsonb_typeof(p_source) NOT IN ('string', 'null'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'source filter requires JSON string or explicit null', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  PERFORM ops.ddo_require_subject_source(ops.ddo_release_subject_scopes(d.release_id), ops.ddo_operation_subject(d.release_id, p_operation), p_source #>> ARRAY[]::TEXT[]);
 END IF;
 IF (ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(p_trust)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'binding trust snapshot changed', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH declared_pins AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT entry.value AS entry, d.selection['source_sets'][((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set')] AS source_set 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'][((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set')]['entries'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS entry(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation), 
admitted AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT x.id AS product_id, x.kind_contract AS parent_kind, x.subject AS parent_subject, x.subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, x.original_source AS parent_source, x.analyzed_scope AS parent_scope, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body, outp.member_id AS output_member, outp.role AS output_role, outp.position AS output_position, outp.multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, episode.id AS episode_id, u.id AS use_id, producer.operation_id AS producer_operation 
FROM ops.demand_use AS u JOIN ops.data_derivation AS episode ON episode.id = u.derivation_id JOIN ops.data_request AS producer ON producer.id = episode.request_id JOIN ops.data_derivation_output AS outp ON outp.derivation_id = episode.id JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = outp.product_id 
WHERE u.fate = 'fulfilled' AND x.project_id = d.project_id AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = x.id))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(u.created_at, u.created_xid, boundary) AND u.demand_id = d.id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected_operation(value) 
WHERE (selected_operation.value ->> 'operation') = p_operation AND (jsonb_array_length(selected_operation.value['dependencies']) = 0 OR producer.operation_id = any(ops.ddo_consumed_producers(d.selection, p_operation))))) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS later 
WHERE later.obligation_id = u.obligation_id AND (later.created_at > u.created_at OR later.created_at = u.created_at AND later.id > u.id) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(later.created_at, later.created_xid, boundary))) UNION SELECT x.id AS product_id, x.kind_contract AS parent_kind, x.subject AS parent_subject, x.subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, x.original_source AS parent_source, x.analyzed_scope AS parent_scope, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body, outp.member_id AS output_member, outp.role AS output_role, outp.position AS output_position, outp.multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, episode.id AS episode_id, u.id AS use_id, producer.operation_id AS producer_operation 
FROM ops.demand_use AS u JOIN ops.data_derivation AS episode ON episode.id = u.derivation_id JOIN ops.data_request AS producer ON producer.id = episode.request_id JOIN ops.data_derivation_output AS outp ON outp.derivation_id = episode.id JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = outp.product_id 
WHERE u.fate = 'fulfilled' AND x.project_id = d.project_id AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = x.id))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(u.created_at, u.created_xid, boundary) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM declared_pins 
WHERE (declared_pins.entry ->> 'product') = x.id AND ops.ddo_source_set_proof_matches(declared_pins.source_set, x.id, declared_pins.entry ->> 'member', episode.id, u.id, jsonb_build_object('member_id', outp.member_id, 'role', outp.role, 'position', outp.position, 'multiplicity', outp.multiplicity)) AND ((declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NULL AND outp.member_id IS NULL OR (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member') IS NOT NULL AND (outp.member_id IS NULL OR outp.member_id = (declared_pins.entry ->> 'member')))))), 
candidates AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT admitted.product_id AS product_id, admitted.parent_kind AS parent_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS parent_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS parent_source, admitted.parent_scope AS parent_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS canonical_body, admitted.output_member AS output_member, admitted.output_role AS output_role, admitted.output_position AS output_position, admitted.output_multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, admitted.episode_id AS episode_id, admitted.use_id AS use_id, admitted.producer_operation AS producer_operation, projected.member_id AS member_id, projected.projected_kind AS projected_kind, projected.projected_subject AS projected_subject, projected.projected_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, projected.projected_source AS projected_source, projected.projected_scope AS projected_scope, projected.projected_body AS projected_body, CAST(coalesce(member_role.position, admitted.output_position) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_position, CAST(coalesce(member_role.multiplicity, admitted.output_multiplicity) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_multiplicity 
FROM admitted JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member_id, admitted.parent_kind AS projected_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS projected_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS projected_source, admitted.parent_scope AS projected_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS projected_body 
WHERE admitted.output_member IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT m.member_id AS member_id, m.kind_contract AS kind_contract, m.subject AS subject, m.subject_definition AS subject_definition, m.original_source AS original_source, m.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, m.body AS body 
FROM kb.data_product_member AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = admitted.product_id AND (admitted.output_member IS NULL OR admitted.output_member = m.member_id)) AS projected ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_member_role AS member_role ON member_role.product_id = admitted.product_id AND member_role.member_id = projected.member_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation AND CASE WHEN ((input_role.value['accepted_kind_contracts'] ? projected.projected_kind) AND (coalesce(input_role.value['support']['origins'], CAST('["computation"]' AS JSONB)) ? 'computation') AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR projected.projected_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope)) THEN CASE WHEN (ops.ddo_kind_access(admitted.parent_kind) AND ops.ddo_body_access(projected.projected_kind, projected.projected_body)) THEN (p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('subject', projected.projected_subject, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT))) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admitted.product_id, 'member', projected.member_id, 'subject', projected.projected_subject, 'subject_definition', projected.projected_subject_definition, 'original_source', projected.projected_source, 'analyzed_scope', projected.projected_scope, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body, 'support_references', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'computation', 'derivation_id', admitted.episode_id, 'admission_use_id', admitted.use_id)), 'support_evidence', jsonb_build_object('producer_output', jsonb_build_object('member_id', admitted.output_member, 'role', admitted.output_role, 'position', admitted.output_position, 'multiplicity', admitted.output_multiplicity))), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admitted.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM projected.member_id)))), 
candidate_validity AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT candidate_validity_rows.kind AS kind, candidate_validity_rows.id AS id, candidate_validity_rows.valid AS valid 
FROM ops.ddo_valid_closure((SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT candidates.use_id), CAST('{}' AS TEXT[])) AS coalesce_2 
FROM candidates), CAST('{}' AS TEXT[]), boundary, CAST('{}' AS TEXT[])) AS candidate_validity_rows)
 SELECT CAST(candidates.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(candidates.projected_kind AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(candidates.projected_subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(candidates.projected_subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(candidates.projected_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(candidates.projected_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST((SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(coverage_row) - 'product_id') - 'member_id' ORDER BY coverage_row.ordinal), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1

(SELECT admission.id AS id, admission.demand_id AS demand_id, admission.project_id AS project_id, admission.release_id AS release_id, admission.selection_name AS selection_name, admission.source_reference AS source_reference, admission.reference AS reference, admission.selectors AS selectors, admission.product_id AS product_id, admission.subject AS subject, admission.original_source AS original_source, admission.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, admission.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, admission.evidence AS evidence, admission.created_at AS created_at, admission.created_xid AS created_xid, x.kind_contract AS kind_contract, x.subject_definition AS subject_definition, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body

CASE WHEN ((admission.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END) AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR admission.analyzed_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))))) THEN CASE WHEN ops.ddo_body_access(x.kind_contract, x.canonical_body) THEN p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT)) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1

WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admission.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(NULL AS TEXT)))))
 SELECT CAST(factual.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(factual.kind_contract AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(factual.subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(factual.subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(factual.original_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(factual.analyzed_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS coverage, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS support_episodes, CAST(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', CASE WHEN ((factual.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END, 'admission_id', factual.id, 'source_reference', factual.source_reference) ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS JSONB) AS support_references, CAST(jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'original_admissions', coalesce(jsonb_agg(factual.id ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)), 'trust_snapshot', snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at) AS JSONB) AS support_evidence, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS position, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS multiplicity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS provider_identity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS alternative_identity, CAST(CASE WHEN p_decode_body THEN data.ddo_json(factual.canonical_body) ELSE NULL END AS JSONB) AS body, CAST(factual.canonical_body AS JSONB) AS meaning_body

END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_binding_rows(p_demand text, p_operation text, p_trust jsonb, p_read text = NULL, p_subject text = NULL, p_source jsonb = NULL, p_scope jsonb = NULL, p_decode_body boolean = TRUE, p_selected jsonb = NULL, p_read_checked boolean = FALSE) RETURNS TABLE (product text, kind_contract text, subject text, subject_definition text, original_source text, analyzed_scope jsonb, coverage jsonb, support_episodes jsonb, support_references jsonb, support_evidence jsonb, "position" bigint, multiplicity bigint, member text, provider_identity text, alternative_identity text, body jsonb, meaning_body jsonb) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$DECLARE
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 snapshot jsonb;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = p_demand INTO STRICT d;
 IF (p_read IS NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'binding requires exact native read acquisition', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 SELECT ops.data_demand_read.* 
FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = p_read AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = d.id INTO STRICT boundary;
 IF (p_read_checked) THEN
  snapshot := p_trust;
 ELSE
  snapshot := ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, d.project_id);
 END IF;
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected_operations(value) 
WHERE (selected_operations.value ->> 'operation') = p_operation))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'projection operation outside frozen demand', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (p_source IS NOT NULL) THEN
  IF ((jsonb_typeof(p_source) NOT IN ('string', 'null'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'source filter requires JSON string or explicit null', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  PERFORM ops.ddo_require_subject_source(ops.ddo_release_subject_scopes(d.release_id), ops.ddo_operation_subject(d.release_id, p_operation), p_source #>> ARRAY[]::TEXT[]);
 END IF;
 IF (ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM ops.ddo_trust_snapshot_meaning(p_trust)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'binding trust snapshot changed', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH declared_pins AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT entry.value AS entry, d.selection['source_sets'][((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set')] AS source_set 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'][((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set')]['entries'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS entry(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation), 
admitted AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT x.id AS product_id, x.kind_contract AS parent_kind, x.subject AS parent_subject, x.subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, x.original_source AS parent_source, x.analyzed_scope AS parent_scope, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body, outp.member_id AS output_member, outp.role AS output_role, outp.position AS output_position, outp.multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, episode.id AS episode_id, u.id AS use_id, producer.operation_id AS producer_operation 
FROM ops.demand_use AS u JOIN ops.data_derivation AS episode ON episode.id = u.derivation_id JOIN ops.data_request AS producer ON producer.id = episode.request_id JOIN ops.data_derivation_output AS outp ON outp.derivation_id = episode.id JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = outp.product_id 
WHERE u.fate = 'fulfilled' AND x.project_id = d.project_id AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = x.id))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(u.created_at, u.created_xid, boundary) AND u.demand_id = d.id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected_operation(value)

WHERE u.fate = 'fulfilled' AND x.project_id = d.project_id AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1

candidates AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT admitted.product_id AS product_id, admitted.parent_kind AS parent_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS parent_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS parent_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS parent_source, admitted.parent_scope AS parent_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS canonical_body, admitted.output_member AS output_member, admitted.output_role AS output_role, admitted.output_position AS output_position, admitted.output_multiplicity AS output_multiplicity, admitted.episode_id AS episode_id, admitted.use_id AS use_id, admitted.producer_operation AS producer_operation, projected.member_id AS member_id, projected.projected_kind AS projected_kind, projected.projected_subject AS projected_subject, projected.projected_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, projected.projected_source AS projected_source, projected.projected_scope AS projected_scope, projected.projected_body AS projected_body, CAST(coalesce(member_role.position, admitted.output_position) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_position, CAST(coalesce(member_role.multiplicity, admitted.output_multiplicity) AS BIGINT) AS occurrence_multiplicity 
FROM admitted JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member_id, admitted.parent_kind AS projected_kind, admitted.parent_subject AS projected_subject, admitted.parent_subject_definition AS projected_subject_definition, admitted.parent_source AS projected_source, admitted.parent_scope AS projected_scope, admitted.canonical_body AS projected_body

WHERE m.product_id = admitted.product_id AND (admitted.output_member IS NULL OR admitted.output_member = m.member_id)) AS projected ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_member_role AS member_role ON member_role.product_id = admitted.product_id AND member_role.member_id = projected.member_id 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true

'computation') AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR projected.projected_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope)) THEN CASE WHEN (ops.ddo_kind_access(admitted.parent_kind) AND ops.ddo_body_access(projected.projected_kind, projected.projected_body)) THEN (p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('subject', projected.projected_subject, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT))) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admitted.product_id, 'member', projected.member_id, 'subject', projected.projected_subject, 'subject_definition', projected.projected_subject_definition, 'original_source', projected.projected_source, 'analyzed_scope', projected.projected_scope, 'meaning_body', projected.projected_body, 'support_references', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'computation', 'derivation_id', admitted.episode_id, 'admission_use_id', admitted.use_id)), 'support_evidence', jsonb_build_object('producer_output', jsonb_build_object('member_id', admitted.output_member, 'role', admitted.output_role, 'position', admitted.output_position, 'multiplicity', admitted.output_multiplicity))), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admitted.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM projected.member_id)))),

(SELECT candidate_validity_rows.kind AS kind, candidate_validity_rows.id AS id, candidate_validity_rows.valid AS valid

 SELECT CAST(candidates.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(candidates.projected_kind AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(candidates.projected_subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(candidates.projected_subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(candidates.projected_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(candidates.projected_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST((SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(coverage_row) - 'product_id') - 'member_id' ORDER BY coverage_row.ordinal), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1

 RETURN QUERY WITH factual AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT admission.id AS id, admission.demand_id AS demand_id, admission.project_id AS project_id, admission.release_id AS release_id, admission.selection_name AS selection_name, admission.source_reference AS source_reference, admission.reference AS reference, admission.selectors AS selectors, admission.product_id AS product_id, admission.subject AS subject, admission.original_source AS original_source, admission.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, admission.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, admission.evidence AS evidence, admission.created_at AS created_at, admission.created_xid AS created_xid, x.kind_contract AS kind_contract, x.subject_definition AS subject_definition, x.canonical_body AS canonical_body 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS admission JOIN kb.data_product AS x ON x.id = admission.product_id 
WHERE admission.demand_id = d.id AND admission.project_id = d.project_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(admission.created_at, admission.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.ddo_original_admission_valid(admission, boundary) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles) AS input_role(value) ON true 
WHERE sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = p_operation AND CASE WHEN ((input_role.value['accepted_kind_contracts'] ? x.kind_contract) AND (coalesce(input_role.value['support']['origins'], CAST('["computation"]' AS JSONB)) ? CASE WHEN ((admission.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END) AND (p_scope IS NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_field') IS NOT NULL OR (input_role.value ->> 'subject_target') = 'source-set' OR admission.analyzed_scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_scope) AND (p_source IS NULL AND ((input_role.value['support']) ->> 'source_set') IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_source(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT), coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))))) THEN CASE WHEN ops.ddo_body_access(x.kind_contract, x.canonical_body) THEN p_subject IS NULL OR ops.ddo_binding_subject(input_role.value, jsonb_build_object('product', admission.product_id, 'member', CAST(NULL AS TEXT), 'subject', admission.subject, 'subject_definition', x.subject_definition, 'original_source', admission.original_source, 'analyzed_scope', admission.analyzed_scope, 'meaning_body', x.canonical_body), p_subject, CAST(p_source #>> '{}' AS TEXT)) ELSE false END ELSE false END)) AND (p_selected IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_selected) AS selected_binding_key(value) 
WHERE (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'product_id') = admission.product_id AND (selected_binding_key.value ->> 'member_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(NULL AS TEXT)))))
 SELECT CAST(factual.product_id AS TEXT) AS product, CAST(factual.kind_contract AS TEXT) AS kind_contract, CAST(factual.subject AS TEXT) AS subject, CAST(factual.subject_definition AS TEXT) AS subject_definition, CAST(factual.original_source AS TEXT) AS original_source, CAST(factual.analyzed_scope AS JSONB) AS analyzed_scope, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS coverage, CAST(CAST('[]' AS JSONB) AS JSONB) AS support_episodes, CAST(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', CASE WHEN ((factual.reference ->> 'kind') = 'authored-fact') THEN 'authored' ELSE 'original-source' END, 'admission_id', factual.id, 'source_reference', factual.source_reference) ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS JSONB) AS support_references, CAST(jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'original_admissions', coalesce(jsonb_agg(factual.id ORDER BY factual.id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)), 'trust_snapshot', snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at) AS JSONB) AS support_evidence, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS position, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS multiplicity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS member, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS provider_identity, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS alternative_identity, CAST(CASE WHEN p_decode_body THEN data.ddo_json(factual.canonical_body) ELSE NULL END AS JSONB) AS body, CAST(factual.canonical_body AS JSONB) AS meaning_body 
FROM factual 
WHERE ops.ddo_body_access(factual.kind_contract, factual.canonical_body) GROUP BY factual.product_id, factual.kind_contract, factual.subject, factual.subject_definition, factual.original_source, factual.analyzed_scope, factual.canonical_body;
END$$

catalog.body:
DECLARE
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
 p jsonb;
 admitted boolean;
 cut jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = p_demand INTO STRICT d;
 SELECT ops.data_demand_read.* 
FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = p_read AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = d.id INTO STRICT boundary;
 p := jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'view', 'frontier', 'limit', 1, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at);
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, d.project_id);
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_validity AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_output_validity_rows.kind AS kind, selected_output_validity_rows.id AS id, selected_output_validity_rows.valid AS valid 
FROM ops.ddo_valid_closure((SELECT array_agg(selected_uses.id) AS array_agg_1 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled'), CAST('{}' AS TEXT[]), boundary, CAST('{}' AS TEXT[])) AS selected_output_validity_rows), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_output_validity 
WHERE selected_output_validity.kind = 'use' AND selected_uses.id = selected_output_validity.id AND selected_output_validity.valid))), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id)) THEN 'authority' ELSE 'episode' END END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) THEN 'authority' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END = 'episode' AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END)) THEN 'authority' ELSE CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((CAST(ops.ddo_structural_report_support(ops.demand_use.id, boundary, (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS JSONB) ->> 'use_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE CASE WHEN ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind IN ('episode', 'authority') AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND true AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_output_validity 
WHERE selected_output_validity.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = selected_output_validity.id AND selected_output_validity.valid))) THEN CASE WHEN (NOT boundary.public_disclosure OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body) ELSE false END ELSE false END)
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF (NOT coalesce(admitted, false)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'output is outside current pinned selected support', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'project_id', d.project_id, 'release_id', d.release_id, 'runtime_id', d.runtime_id, 'selection', CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND boundary.scope != CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN jsonb_build_object('version', 'data-demand-public-selection-v1', 'model', d.selection['model'], 'intent_digest', ops.ddo_digest(d.selection), 'roots', d.selection['roots'], 'targets', d.selection['targets'], 'root_operations', d.selection['root_operations'], 'discovery', d.selection['discovery']) ELSE d.selection END, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'scope', boundary.scope) AS jsonb_build_object_1 INTO cut;
 RETURN cut;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_require_selected_output(p_demand text, p_read text, p_use text, p_product text, p_derivation text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$DECLARE
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
 p jsonb;

 cut jsonb;
BEGIN

FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = p_demand INTO STRICT d;

FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = p_read AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = d.id INTO STRICT boundary;
 p := jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'view', 'frontier', 'limit', 1, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at);
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, d.project_id);
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_validity AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_output_validity_rows.kind AS kind, selected_output_validity_rows.id AS id, selected_output_validity_rows.valid AS valid 
FROM ops.ddo_valid_closure((SELECT array_agg(selected_uses.id) AS array_agg_1 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled'), CAST('{}' AS TEXT[]), boundary, CAST('{}' AS TEXT[])) AS selected_output_validity_rows), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_output_validity 
WHERE selected_output_validity.kind = 'use' AND selected_uses.id = selected_output_validity.id AND selected_output_validity.valid))), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id)) THEN 'authority' ELSE 'episode' END END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) THEN 'authority' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END = 'episode' AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END)) THEN 'authority' ELSE CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((CAST(ops.ddo_structural_report_support(ops.demand_use.id, boundary, (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS JSONB) ->> 'use_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE CASE WHEN ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind IN ('episode', 'authority') AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND true AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_output_validity 
WHERE selected_output_validity.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = selected_output_validity.id AND selected_output_validity.valid))) THEN CASE WHEN (NOT boundary.public_disclosure OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body) ELSE false END ELSE false END)
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF (NOT coalesce(admitted, false)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'output is outside current pinned selected support', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'project_id', d.project_id, 'release_id', d.release_id, 'runtime_id', d.runtime_id, 'selection', CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND boundary.scope != CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN jsonb_build_object('version', 'data-demand-public-selection-v1', 'model', d.selection['model'], 'intent_digest', ops.ddo_digest(d.selection), 'roots', d.selection['roots'], 'targets', d.selection['targets'], 'root_operations', d.selection['root_operations'], 'discovery', d.selection['discovery']) ELSE d.selection END, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'scope', boundary.scope) AS jsonb_build_object_1 INTO cut;
 RETURN cut;
END$$

WITH targets AS MATERIALIZED

eligible AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT targets.id AS id, targets.digest AS digest, CAST(CAST(pg_catalog.jsonb_extract_path(vector_input.value, 'values') AS text) AS public.vector) AS vector 
FROM targets JOIN pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(vectors) AS vector_input(value) ON (vector_input.value ->> 'object_id') = targets.id 
WHERE (vector_input.value ->> 'profile_id') = (profile ->> 'profile_id') AND (vector_input.value ->> 'representation_digest') = targets.digest AND (vector_input.value ->> 'source_binding') = targets.source AND public.vector_dims(CAST(CAST(pg_catalog.jsonb_extract_path(vector_input.value, 'values') AS text) AS public.vector)) = CAST((profile ->> 'dimension') AS INTEGER) AND pg_catalog.abs(public.vector_norm(CAST(CAST(pg_catalog.jsonb_extract_path(vector_input.value, 'values') AS text) AS public.vector)) - 1) <= 0.00001), 
coverage AS 
(SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM targets))) THEN 'completed' WHEN (profile IS NULL) THEN 'profile_unavailable' WHEN ((SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM targets) != (SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM eligible) OR (SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM eligible) != (SELECT count(DISTINCT eligible.id) AS count_3 
FROM eligible) OR (SELECT count(*) AS count_4 
FROM targets JOIN pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(vectors) AS vector_input(value) ON (vector_input.value ->> 'object_id') = targets.id 
WHERE (vector_input.value ->> 'profile_id') = (profile ->> 'profile_id')) != (SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM eligible)) THEN 'vector_coverage_unavailable' ELSE 'completed' END AS status), 
representatives AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT eligible.id AS id, eligible.digest AS digest, eligible.vector AS vector, group_input.value ->> 'target_id' AS group_id 
FROM coverage JOIN pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(inv['semantic_groups']) AS group_input(value) ON true JOIN eligible ON eligible.id = ((group_input.value['member_target_ids']) ->> 0) 
WHERE coverage.status = 'completed'), 
directed AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT a.id AS from_id, nearest.id AS to_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY nearest.distance, nearest.id COLLATE "C") AS rank_, nearest.distance AS distance 
FROM representatives AS a JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b.id AS id, a.vector OPERATOR(public.<=>) b.vector AS distance 
FROM representatives AS b 
WHERE b.id != a.id ORDER BY a.vector OPERATOR(public.<=>) b.vector, b.id COLLATE "C" 
 LIMIT 5) AS nearest ON true), 
mutual AS 
(SELECT d.from_id AS from_id, d.to_id AS to_id, d.rank_ AS left_rank, r.rank_ AS right_rank, d.distance AS distance

WHERE (d.from_id COLLATE "C") < (d.to_id COLLATE "C"))
 SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_strip_nulls(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('policy', 'mutual-exact-cosine-top5-2', 'inventory_id', inv ->> 'inventory_id', 'profile_id', profile ->> 'profile_id', 'status', coverage.status, 'directed_ranks', coalesce((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('from_id', directed.from_id, 'to_id', directed.to_id, 'rank', directed.rank_, 'distance', directed.distance) ORDER BY directed.from_id COLLATE "C", directed.rank_) AS jsonb_agg_1 
FROM directed), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)), 'edges', coalesce((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('left_id', mutual.from_id, 'right_id', mutual.to_id, 'left_group', a.group_id, 'right_group', b.group_id, 'left_digest', a.digest, 'right_digest', b.digest, 'left_rank', mutual.left_rank, 'right_rank', mutual.right_rank, 'distance', mutual.distance) ORDER BY mutual.from_id COLLATE "C", mutual.to_id COLLATE "C") AS jsonb_agg_2 
FROM mutual JOIN representatives AS a ON a.id = mutual.from_id JOIN representatives AS b ON b.id = mutual.to_id), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)))) AS jsonb_strip_nulls_1 
FROM coverage

DECLARE
 principal name := SESSION_USER;
BEGIN
 IF (NOT pg_has_role(principal, 'corpus_sem_fitter', 'USAGE') OR (current_setting('role') NOT IN ('none', CAST(principal AS TEXT))) OR pg_has_role(principal, 'corpus_sem_evaluator', 'MEMBER') OR pg_has_role(principal, 'corpus_sem_publisher', 'MEMBER') OR has_database_privilege(principal, current_database(), 'TEMP') OR (EXISTS (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolname 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolname = principal AND (pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolsuper OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolcreatedb OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolcreaterole OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolbypassrls OR pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolreplication))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname IN ('sem', 'data', 'ops', 'kb', 'eval') AND (pg_has_role(principal, pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspowner, 'MEMBER') OR has_schema_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid, 'CREATE')))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_class.oid 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ON pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid = pg_catalog.pg_class.relnamespace 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname IN ('ops', 'kb', 'eval') AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') AND (has_table_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_class.oid, 'SELECT') OR has_any_column_privilege(principal, pg_catalog.pg_class.oid, 'SELECT'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'feature fitting requires a restricted actual fitting principal', ERRCODE = '42501';
 END IF;
END

 END IF;
 FOR node IN WITH RECURSIVE selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry, source_set.value AS source_set 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value['entries']) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AND ops.ddo_source_set_proof_matches(source_entries.source_set, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id, source_entries.entry ->> 'member', ops.data_derivation.id, ops.demand_use.id, jsonb_build_object('member_id', ops.data_derivation_output.member_id, 'role', ops.data_derivation_output.role, 'position', ops.data_derivation_output.position, 'multiplicity', ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity)))) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT support_closure.kind, support_closure.id 
FROM support_closure LOOP
  IF (node.kind = 'episode' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_derivation.id = node.id AND (ops.data_request.operation_id IN ('record_policy.fit', 'record_policy.authorize') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_derivation_output JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract 
WHERE ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id AND sem.data_kind_contract.kind IN ('https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoFittedRecordPolicy', 'https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/DdoRecordPolicyAuthorization'))))))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade selection support reaches fitted policy authority', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
END

FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id

WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true
