DECLARE
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
 p jsonb;
 p_use text := selection ->> 'use_id';
 p_product text := selection ->> 'product_id';
 p_derivation text := selection ->> 'derivation_id';
 admitted boolean;
 chosen jsonb;
 grade jsonb;
 producer ops.data_derivation%ROWTYPE;
 definition sem.data_operation_definition%ROWTYPE;
 intent ops.data_completion_intent%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 PERFORM ops.ddo_record_fit_cut_scopes(r.project_id, selection);
 SELECT ops.data_demand_read.* 
FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = (selection ->> 'read_id') AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = (selection ->> 'demand_id') INTO STRICT boundary;
 IF (NOT authenticate_output) THEN
  PERFORM ops.ddo_require_read_epochs(boundary, r.project_id, true);
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 PERFORM ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, r.project_id, true);
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = boundary.demand_id AND ops.data_demand.project_id = r.project_id INTO STRICT d;
 p := jsonb_build_object('scope', boundary.scope);
 WITH RECURSIVE scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
selected_output_validity AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_output_validity_rows.kind AS kind, selected_output_validity_rows.id AS id, selected_output_validity_rows.valid AS valid 
FROM ops.ddo_valid_closure((SELECT array_agg(selected_uses.id) AS array_agg_1 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled'), CAST('{}' AS TEXT[]), boundary, CAST('{}' AS TEXT[])) AS selected_output_validity_rows), 
selected_output_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.id = p_use AND selected_uses.fate = 'fulfilled' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_output_validity 
WHERE selected_output_validity.kind = 'use' AND selected_uses.id = selected_output_validity.id AND selected_output_validity.valid))), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT selected_output_seed.kind AS kind, selected_output_seed.id AS id 
FROM selected_output_seed 
WHERE selected_output_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id)) THEN 'authority' ELSE 'episode' END END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) THEN 'authority' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END = 'episode' AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END)) THEN 'authority' ELSE CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id') WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') ELSE (selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id') END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((CAST(ops.ddo_structural_report_support(ops.demand_use.id, boundary, (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS JSONB) ->> 'use_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
selected_whole_outputs AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ops.data_derivation.id AS derivation_id, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AS product_id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id 
WHERE CASE WHEN ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM support_closure 
WHERE support_closure.kind IN ('episode', 'authority') AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id)) AND true AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND kb.data_product.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_output_validity 
WHERE selected_output_validity.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = selected_output_validity.id AND selected_output_validity.valid))) THEN CASE WHEN (NOT boundary.public_disclosure OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body) ELSE false END ELSE false END)
 SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;
 IF (NOT coalesce(admitted, false)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade is outside exact current native selected support', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT item.value 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding['inputs']) AS item(value) 
WHERE (item.value ->> 'role') = role_name AND (item.value ->> 'product_id') = p_product AND (item.value ->> 'member_id') IS NULL AND CAST((item.value ->> 'multiplicity') AS INTEGER) = 1 INTO STRICT chosen;
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding['support']) AS support(value) 
WHERE (support.value ->> 'derivation_id') = p_derivation AND (support.value ->> 'role') = role_name)) OR NOT (ops.ddo_input_support_selection(chosen) ? p_derivation)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade selection differs from actual bound input product and producing episode', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT ops.data_derivation.* 
FROM ops.data_derivation 
WHERE ops.data_derivation.id = p_derivation AND ops.data_derivation.outcome = 'success' INTO STRICT producer;
 SELECT sem.data_operation_definition.* 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.operation_id = sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = producer.request_id AND ops.data_request.project_id = r.project_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = producer.release_id INTO STRICT definition;
 SELECT ops.data_completion_intent.* 
FROM ops.data_completion_intent 
WHERE ops.data_completion_intent.id = producer.intent_id AND ops.data_completion_intent.request_id = producer.request_id AND ops.data_completion_intent.generation = producer.generation INTO STRICT intent;
 IF ((intent.producer_task_id, intent.producer_attempt, intent.runtime_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (producer.producer_task_id, producer.producer_attempt, producer.runtime_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade differs from original producer fences', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (definition.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'record_policy.grade' OR definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation' OR definition.support_contract['effects'] IS DISTINCT FROM CAST('[]' AS JSONB) OR ((definition.support_contract['capabilities']['prepared_factory']) ->> 'entrypoint') IS DISTINCT FROM 'corpus_structure.methods.declared_record_policy.RecordPolicyGrade.acquire_port' OR (intent.payload ->> 'implementation_revision') IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision OR producer.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM definition.recipe OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(intent.payload['execution_evidence']['cpu_receipts'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) != 1 OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_publication_receipt JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_publication_receipt.derivation_id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract 
WHERE ops.data_publication_receipt.derivation_id = producer.id AND ops.data_publication_receipt.intent_id = intent.id AND ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = p_product AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND ops.data_derivation_output.role = 'grade' AND ops.data_derivation_output.position = 0 AND ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity = 1 AND sem.data_kind_contract.kind = 'https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoRecordGrade' AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe = 'evaluator'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade lacks actual protected grade CPU/common producer custody', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT kb.data_product.canonical_body 
FROM kb.data_product 
WHERE kb.data_product.id = p_product AND kb.data_product.project_id = r.project_id INTO STRICT grade;
 IF ((data.ddo_json(grade) ->> 'frame_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM (selection ->> 'frame_digest') OR (((data.ddo_json(grade))['frame']) ->> 'partition') IS DISTINCT FROM CAST(CASE WHEN (role_name = 'feature_grade') THEN 'feature_fit' ELSE 'final_event_calibration' END AS TEXT)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade frame or partition differs from its actual selected input', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN grade;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_record_fit_require_selection(r ops.data_request, role_name text, selection jsonb, authenticate_output boolean) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$DECLARE

FROM ops.data_demand

(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid

'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1

WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1

WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid

selected_output_validity AS MATERIALIZED

WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND NOT (boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id') AS TEXT) AS id

WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((CAST(ops.ddo_structural_report_support(ops.demand_use.id, boundary, (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS JSONB) ->> 'use_id') AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND boundary.public_disclosure AND ops.ddo_policy_authority_leaf(ops.demand_use.derivation_id)) AS support_edge ON true

FROM selected_output_validity

FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_body_access(kb.data_product.kind_contract, kb.data_product.canonical_body) ELSE false END ELSE false END)

FROM selected_whole_outputs 
WHERE selected_whole_outputs.derivation_id = p_derivation AND selected_whole_outputs.product_id = p_product) AS anon_1 INTO admitted;

  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade is outside exact current native selected support', ERRCODE = '23514';

FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding['inputs']) AS item(value) 
WHERE (item.value ->> 'role') = role_name AND (item.value ->> 'product_id') = p_product AND (item.value ->> 'member_id') IS NULL AND CAST((item.value ->> 'multiplicity') AS INTEGER) = 1 INTO STRICT chosen;
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.binding['support']) AS support(value) 
WHERE (support.value ->> 'derivation_id') = p_derivation AND (support.value ->> 'role') = role_name)) OR NOT (ops.ddo_input_support_selection(chosen) ? p_derivation)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade selection differs from actual bound input product and producing episode', ERRCODE = '23514';

WHERE ops.data_derivation.id = p_derivation AND ops.data_derivation.outcome = 'success' INTO STRICT producer;
 SELECT sem.data_operation_definition.* 
FROM sem.data_operation_definition JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.operation_id = sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = producer.request_id AND ops.data_request.project_id = r.project_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = producer.release_id INTO STRICT definition;
 SELECT ops.data_completion_intent.* 
FROM ops.data_completion_intent 
WHERE ops.data_completion_intent.id = producer.intent_id AND ops.data_completion_intent.request_id = producer.request_id AND ops.data_completion_intent.generation = producer.generation INTO STRICT intent;
 IF ((intent.producer_task_id, intent.producer_attempt, intent.runtime_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (producer.producer_task_id, producer.producer_attempt, producer.runtime_id)) THEN

 IF (definition.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'record_policy.grade' OR definition.profile IS DISTINCT FROM 'derivation' OR definition.support_contract['effects'] IS DISTINCT FROM CAST('[]' AS JSONB) OR ((definition.support_contract['capabilities']['prepared_factory']) ->> 'entrypoint') IS DISTINCT FROM 'corpus_structure.methods.declared_record_policy.RecordPolicyGrade.acquire_port' OR (intent.payload ->> 'implementation_revision') IS DISTINCT FROM definition.implementation_revision OR producer.recipe IS DISTINCT FROM definition.recipe OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(intent.payload['execution_evidence']['cpu_receipts'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) != 1 OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_publication_receipt JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_publication_receipt.derivation_id JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = kb.data_product.kind_contract 
WHERE ops.data_publication_receipt.derivation_id = producer.id AND ops.data_publication_receipt.intent_id = intent.id AND ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = p_product AND ops.data_derivation_output.member_id IS NULL AND ops.data_derivation_output.role = 'grade' AND ops.data_derivation_output.position = 0 AND ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity = 1 AND sem.data_kind_contract.kind = 'https://corpus-structure.dev/semantic/data-operation-record-policy/protected/DdoRecordGrade' AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe = 'evaluator'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade lacks actual protected grade CPU/common producer custody', ERRCODE = '23514';

 SELECT kb.data_product.canonical_body 
FROM kb.data_product 
WHERE kb.data_product.id = p_product AND kb.data_product.project_id = r.project_id INTO STRICT grade;
 IF ((data.ddo_json(grade) ->> 'frame_digest') IS DISTINCT FROM (selection ->> 'frame_digest') OR (((data.ddo_json(grade))['frame']) ->> 'partition') IS DISTINCT FROM CAST(CASE WHEN (role_name = 'feature_grade') THEN 'feature_fit' ELSE 'final_event_calibration' END AS TEXT)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'fit grade frame or partition differs from its actual selected input', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN grade;
END$$

WITH RECURSIVE support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN root_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE root_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(support) AS root_support_reference(value)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT source AS source UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = project)
 SELECT ops.ddo_scope(project, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources UNION SELECT record_grade_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = project ORDER BY scope

DECLARE
 names text[] := ops.ddo_binding_roles(jsonb_set(node, ARRAY['children'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB)));
BEGIN
 RETURN QUERY WITH RECURSIVE combinations(n, roles) AS 
(SELECT 0 AS n, context['roles'] AS roles UNION ALL SELECT combinations.n + 1 AS n, jsonb_set(combinations.roles, ARRAY[names[(combinations.n + 1)]], jsonb_build_array(candidate.value)) AS roles 
FROM combinations JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(context['roles'][(names[(combinations.n + 1)])], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS candidate(value) ON true 
WHERE combinations.n < cardinality(names))
 SELECT jsonb_set(context, ARRAY['roles'], combinations.roles) AS jsonb_set_1 
FROM combinations 
WHERE combinations.n = cardinality(names);
END

DECLARE

BEGIN

  IF (CAST((p ->> 'after') AS INTEGER) != 0) THEN

  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('kind', 'rows', 'items', CAST('[]' AS JSONB), 'next_after', NULL);
 END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE entries AS 
(SELECT row.value AS body, CAST(row.ordinality AS INTEGER) AS ordinal 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(mapped['rows']) WITH ORDINALITY AS row(value, ordinality)), 
anchor AS 
(SELECT entries.body AS body 
FROM entries 
WHERE (entries.body ->> 'occurrence_id') = (p ->> 'occurrence_id')), 
cell_root AS 
(SELECT ((anchor.body['cells'][CAST((p ->> 'cell_index') AS INTEGER)]) ->> 'content_occurrence_id') AS id 
FROM anchor), 
subtree(body, ordinal) AS 
(SELECT entries.body AS body, entries.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM entries 
WHERE (entries.body ->> 'occurrence_id') = (SELECT cell_root.id 
FROM cell_root) UNION ALL SELECT entries.body AS body, entries.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM entries JOIN subtree AS parent ON (entries.body ->> 'parent_occurrence_id') = (parent.body ->> 'occurrence_id')), 
text_matches AS 
(SELECT entries.body AS body

text_ancestors(body) AS 
(SELECT text_matches.body AS body 
FROM text_matches UNION ALL SELECT entries.body AS body 
FROM entries JOIN text_ancestors AS child ON (entries.body ->> 'occurrence_id') = (child.body ->> 'parent_occurrence_id')), 
targets AS 
(SELECT (text_ancestors.body ->> 'occurrence_id') AS id 
FROM text_ancestors 
WHERE (text_ancestors.body ->> 'kind') = 'picture' UNION SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(text_matches.body['parser_attachment_occurrence_ids']) AS id 
FROM text_matches UNION SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(text_matches.body['associated_picture_occurrence_ids']) AS id 
FROM text_matches), 
candidates AS 
(SELECT entries.body AS body, entries.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM entries 
WHERE entries.ordinal > CAST((p ->> 'after') AS INTEGER) AND ((p ->> 'kind') IS NULL OR (entries.body ->> 'kind') = (p ->> 'kind')) AND ((p ->> 'occurrence_id') IS NULL OR CASE WHEN ((p ->> 'cell_index') IS NULL) THEN (entries.body ->> 'occurrence_id') = (p ->> 'occurrence_id') ELSE entries.ordinal IN (SELECT subtree.ordinal 
FROM subtree) END) AND ((p ->> 'query') IS NULL OR (entries.body ->> 'kind') = 'picture' AND (entries.body ->> 'occurrence_id') IN (SELECT targets.id 
FROM targets)) AND (jsonb_array_length(p['regions']) = 0 OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(p['regions']) AS region(value) 
WHERE entries.body['source_region'] IS NOT NULL AND entries.body['source_region'] != CAST('null' AS JSONB) AND CAST(((entries.body['source_region']) ->> 'left') AS NUMERIC) < CAST((region.value ->> 'right') AS NUMERIC) AND CAST((region.value ->> 'left') AS NUMERIC) < CAST(((entries.body['source_region']) ->> 'right') AS NUMERIC) AND CAST(((entries.body['source_region']) ->> 'top') AS NUMERIC) < CAST((region.value ->> 'bottom') AS NUMERIC) AND CAST((region.value ->> 'top') AS NUMERIC) < CAST(((entries.body['source_region']) ->> 'bottom') AS NUMERIC)))) ORDER BY entries.ordinal 
 LIMIT CAST((p ->> 'limit') AS INTEGER) + 1), 
ranked AS 
(SELECT candidates.body AS body, candidates.ordinal AS ordinal, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY candidates.ordinal) AS n 
FROM candidates)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(ranked.body ORDER BY ranked.ordinal) FILTER (WHERE ranked.n <= CAST((p ->> 'limit') AS INTEGER)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1, CASE WHEN (max(ranked.n) > CAST((p ->> 'limit') AS INTEGER)) THEN max(ranked.ordinal) FILTER (WHERE ranked.n <= CAST((p ->> 'limit') AS INTEGER)) END AS anon_1 
FROM ranked INTO rows_, following;
 IF ((p ->> 'occurrence_id') IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(mapped['rows']) AS retained(value) 
WHERE (retained.value ->> 'occurrence_id') = (p ->> 'occurrence_id')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'visual occurrence is outside candidate artifact', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF ((p ->> 'cell_index') IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(mapped['rows']) AS retained(value) 
WHERE (retained.value ->> 'occurrence_id') = (p ->> 'occurrence_id') AND (retained.value ->> 'kind') = 'table' AND ((retained.value['cells'][CAST((p ->> 'cell_index') AS INTEGER)]) ->> 'content_occurrence_id') IS NOT NULL))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'visual cell has no exact retained content group', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (CAST((p ->> 'after') AS INTEGER) > 0 AND jsonb_array_length(rows_) = 0) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'visual continuation is outside selected scope', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('kind', 'rows', 'items', rows_, 'next_after', following);
END

DECLARE
 scratch oid := to_regclass('pg_temp.' || p_name);
BEGIN
 IF (scratch IS NULL OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_class.oid = scratch AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relowner = (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_roles.oid 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_roles.rolname = 'corpus_sem_publisher') AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relnamespace = pg_my_temp_schema() AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relkind = 'r' AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relpersistence = 't' AND NOT pg_catalog.pg_class.relrowsecurity)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_trigger.tgrelid = scratch)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_rewrite 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_rewrite.ev_class = scratch)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhrelid = scratch OR pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhparent = scratch)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_attrdef.adrelid = scratch)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_index 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_index.indrelid = scratch)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_constraint.conrelid = scratch AND ((pg_catalog.pg_constraint.contype NOT IN ('c', 'n')) OR NOT pg_catalog.pg_constraint.convalidated)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'untrusted private PDF scratch', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF ((SELECT coalesce(array_agg(CAST((pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnum, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attname, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.atttypid, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.atttypmod, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnotnull, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attgenerated, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attidentity) AS TEXT) ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnum), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attrelid = scratch AND pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnum > 0 AND NOT pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attisdropped) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(CAST((pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnum, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attname, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.atttypid, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.atttypmod, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnotnull, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attgenerated, pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attidentity) AS TEXT) ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnum), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_2 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attrelid = p_relation AND pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attnum > 0 AND NOT pg_catalog.pg_attribute.attisdropped) OR (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(pg_get_constraintdef(pg_catalog.pg_constraint.oid, true) ORDER BY pg_get_constraintdef(pg_catalog.pg_constraint.oid, true)), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_3 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_constraint.conrelid = scratch AND pg_catalog.pg_constraint.contype = 'c') IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(pg_get_constraintdef(pg_catalog.pg_constraint.oid, true) ORDER BY pg_get_constraintdef(pg_catalog.pg_constraint.oid, true)), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_4 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_constraint.conrelid = p_relation AND pg_catalog.pg_constraint.contype = 'c')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'private PDF scratch schema differs', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
END

SELECT coalesce(CASE WHEN (p_left_stream IS NULL) THEN octet_length(convert_to(p_left, 'UTF8')) ELSE left_stream.byte_length END = CASE WHEN (p_right_stream IS NULL) THEN octet_length(convert_to(p_right, 'UTF8')) ELSE right_stream.byte_length END AND CASE WHEN (p_left_stream IS NULL) THEN encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(p_left, 'UTF8')), 'hex') ELSE left_stream.byte_root END = CASE WHEN (p_right_stream IS NULL) THEN encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(p_right, 'UTF8')), 'hex') ELSE right_stream.byte_root END, false) AS coalesce_1 
FROM (SELECT 1 AS anon_1) AS anchor LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS left_stream ON left_stream.product_id = p_product AND left_stream.revision_id = p_revision AND left_stream.stream_id = p_left_stream LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS right_stream ON right_stream.product_id = p_product AND right_stream.revision_id = p_revision AND right_stream.stream_id = p_right_stream

FROM (SELECT 1 AS anon_1) AS anchor LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS left_stream ON left_stream.product_id = p_product AND left_stream.revision_id = p_revision AND left_stream.stream_id = p_left_stream LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS right_stream ON right_stream.product_id = p_product AND right_stream.revision_id = p_revision AND right_stream.stream_id = p_right_stream$$

DECLARE
 b ops.pdf_stage_build%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 b := ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build, p_task, p_attempt, p_holder, p_frozen);
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_operation(b.release_id, 'prepare_pdf_build');
 INSERT INTO ops.pdf_record_document (product_id, revision_id, release_id, source_digest, mapping_profile, contract_version, native_schema_digest, root_id) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.release_id, s.source_digest, s.mapping_profile, s.contract_version, s.native_schema_digest, s.root_id 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_document AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO ops.pdf_artifact_stream (product_id, revision_id, stream_id, byte_length, serialization_sha256, byte_root, encoding_profile) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.stream_id, s.byte_length, s.serialization_sha256, s.byte_root, s.encoding_profile 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_artifact_stream AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_native (product_id, revision_id, record_id, native_type, family, native_address, native_address_stream_id, scalars_json, structure_json) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.record_id, s.native_type, s.family, s.native_address, s.native_address_stream_id, s.scalars_json, s.structure_json 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_native AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_membership (product_id, revision_id, parent_id, field_name, ordinal, member_key, member_key_stream_id, value_kind, record_id, scalar_json, stream_id) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.parent_id, s.field_name, s.ordinal, s.member_key, s.member_key_stream_id, s.value_kind, s.record_id, s.scalar_json, s.stream_id 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_membership AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 WITH streamed_targets AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_native.record_id AS record_id, ops.pdf_artifact_stream.byte_length AS byte_length, ops.pdf_artifact_stream.byte_root AS byte_root 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream ON ops.pdf_artifact_stream.product_id = kb.pdf_record_native.product_id AND ops.pdf_artifact_stream.revision_id = kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id AND ops.pdf_artifact_stream.stream_id = kb.pdf_record_native.native_address_stream_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_native.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_native.native_address IS NULL)
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_reference (product_id, revision_id, reference_id, source_id, field_name, native_pointer, native_pointer_stream_id, target_id) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.reference_id, s.source_id, s.field_name, s.native_pointer, s.native_pointer_stream_id, coalesce(s.target_id, CASE WHEN (s.field_name IN ('source_cell_id', 'target_cell_id')) THEN (SELECT kb.pdf_record_native.record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_native.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_native.native_type = 'GraphCell' AND (kb.pdf_record_native.scalars_json ->> 'cell_id') = s.native_pointer AND regexp_replace(kb.pdf_record_native.native_address, '/cells/[0-9]+$', '') = regexp_replace((SELECT source.native_address 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS source 
WHERE source.product_id = p_build AND source.revision_id = p_build AND source.record_id = s.source_id), '/links/[0-9]+$', '')) WHEN (s.native_pointer_stream_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT target.record_id 
FROM (SELECT kb.pdf_record_native.record_id AS record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_native.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_native.native_address = s.native_pointer UNION ALL SELECT streamed_targets.record_id AS record_id 
FROM streamed_targets 
WHERE streamed_targets.byte_length = octet_length(convert_to(s.native_pointer, 'UTF8')) AND streamed_targets.byte_root = encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(s.native_pointer, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) AS target) ELSE (SELECT kb.pdf_record_native.record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_native.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build, p_build, kb.pdf_record_native.native_address, kb.pdf_record_native.native_address_stream_id, s.native_pointer, s.native_pointer_stream_id)) END) AS coalesce_1 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_reference AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_companion (product_id, revision_id, family, local_id, body, ordinal) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.family, s.local_id, s.body, s.ordinal 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_companion AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_endpoint (product_id, revision_id, relation_id, ordinal, target_task_id, target_product_key, target_content_digest, occurrence_id, role) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.relation_id, s.ordinal, s.target_task_id, s.target_product_key, s.target_content_digest, s.occurrence_id, s.role 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_endpoint AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_companion_field (product_id, revision_id, family, local_id, field_name, stream_id, scalar_kind) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.family, s.local_id, s.field_name, s.stream_id, s.scalar_kind 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_companion_field AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_access (product_id, revision_id, pointer, ordinal, label, parent_pointer, section_pointer, content_layer, text, native_json) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.pointer, s.ordinal, s.label, s.parent_pointer, s.section_pointer, s.content_layer, s.text, s.native_json 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_access AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_region (product_id, revision_id, pointer, region_index, page_no, page_width, page_height, "left", top, "right", bottom, origin) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.pointer, s.region_index, s.page_no, s.page_width, s.page_height, s."left", s.top, s."right", s.bottom, s.origin 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_region AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build, p_task, p_attempt, p_holder, p_frozen);
END

 INSERT INTO kb.pdf_record_region (product_id, revision_id, pointer, region_index, page_no, page_width, page_height, "left", top, "right", bottom, origin) SELECT s.product_id, s.revision_id, s.pointer, s.region_index, s.page_no, s.page_width, s.page_height, s."left", s.top, s."right", s.bottom, s.origin 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_region AS s 
WHERE s.product_id = p_build ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build, p_task, p_attempt, p_holder, p_frozen);
END$$

DECLARE
 bad_owner_ boolean;
 unreachable_ boolean;
BEGIN
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_native_record_shape(n.native_type, n.scalars_json, n.structure_json['fields']) IS NOT true)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native schema field/required/primitive constraint differs', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND (jsonb_typeof(n.structure_json['fields']) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json['fields']) AS fields 
WHERE ((fields.value ->> 'kind') NOT IN ('object', 'array', 'map', 'parts')))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) AS anon_1(key) 
WHERE (n.structure_json['fields'] ? anon_1.key)))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid native field decomposition', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS n ON n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.record_id = m.parent_id 
WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build AND (n.record_id IS NULL OR (((n.structure_json['fields'][m.field_name]) ->> 'kind') NOT IN ('array', 'map'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'membership outside declared collection', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref' GROUP BY n.scalars_json ->> 'self_ref' 
HAVING count(*) != 1)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native self-reference is not unique', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH ref_index AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT r.reference_id AS reference_id, r.source_id AS source_id, r.native_pointer AS native_pointer, r.native_pointer_stream_id AS native_pointer_stream_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_reference AS r 
WHERE r.product_id = p_build AND r.revision_id = p_build AND r.field_name = '$ref')
 SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_index ON ref_index.source_id = n.record_id 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.native_type IN ('RefItem', 'FineRef') AND (ref_index.reference_id IS NULL OR CASE WHEN (ref_index.native_pointer_stream_id IS NULL AND ((n.structure_json['fields']['$ref']) ->> 'stream_id') IS NULL) THEN ((ref_index.native_pointer COLLATE "C") = ((n.scalars_json ->> '$ref') COLLATE "C")) IS NOT true ELSE NOT ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build, p_build, ref_index.native_pointer, ref_index.native_pointer_stream_id, (n.scalars_json ->> '$ref'), ((n.structure_json['fields']['$ref']) ->> 'stream_id')) END))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native reference index does not correspond to supplied spelling', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE owner_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT n.record_id AS parent_id, fields.value ->> 'target' AS child_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json['fields']) AS fields ON true 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND (fields.value ->> 'kind') = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT m.parent_id AS parent_id, m.record_id AS record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build AND m.value_kind = 'record'), 
owner_counts AS 
(SELECT owner_edges.child_id AS child_id, count(owner_edges.parent_id) AS owners 
FROM owner_edges GROUP BY owner_edges.child_id), 
reachable(root_id) AS 
(SELECT ops.pdf_record_document.root_id AS root_id 
FROM ops.pdf_record_document 
WHERE ops.pdf_record_document.product_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_record_document.revision_id = p_build UNION SELECT owner_edges.child_id AS child_id 
FROM reachable JOIN owner_edges ON owner_edges.parent_id = reachable.root_id)
 SELECT coalesce(bool_or(coalesce(owner_counts.owners, 0) != CASE WHEN (n.record_id = (SELECT ops.pdf_record_document.root_id 
FROM ops.pdf_record_document 
WHERE ops.pdf_record_document.product_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_record_document.revision_id = p_build)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), true) AS coalesce_1, coalesce(bool_or(reachable.root_id IS NULL), true) AS coalesce_2 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n LEFT OUTER JOIN owner_counts ON n.record_id = owner_counts.child_id LEFT OUTER JOIN reachable ON reachable.root_id = n.record_id 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build INTO bad_owner_, unreachable_;
 IF (bad_owner_) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native orphan or repeated containment owner', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (unreachable_) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native containment cycle or unreachable record', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF ((WITH access_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT parent.pointer AS parent_pointer, children.value ->> '$ref' AS child_pointer 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS parent JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(parent.native_json['children'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS children ON true 
WHERE parent.product_id = p_build AND parent.revision_id = p_build)
 SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS child ON child.product_id = parent.product_id AND child.revision_id = parent.revision_id AND child.parent_pointer = parent.pointer 
WHERE parent.product_id = p_build AND parent.revision_id = p_build AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM access_edges 
WHERE access_edges.parent_pointer = parent.pointer AND child.pointer = access_edges.child_pointer)))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM access_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS child ON child.product_id = p_build AND child.revision_id = p_build AND child.pointer = access_edges.child_pointer 
WHERE child.pointer IS NULL OR child.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM access_edges.parent_pointer)) AS anon_1)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native parent/child backpointer differs', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json['fields']) AS fields ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS target ON target.product_id = p_build AND target.revision_id = p_build AND target.record_id = (fields.value ->> 'target') 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND (fields.value ->> 'kind') = 'object' AND target.record_id IS NULL)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'missing native object target', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH member_counts AS 
(SELECT m.parent_id AS parent_id, m.field_name AS field_name, count(*) AS count_, min(m.ordinal) AS min_, max(m.ordinal) AS max_ 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build GROUP BY m.parent_id, m.field_name)
 SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json['fields']) AS fields ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN member_counts ON member_counts.parent_id = n.record_id AND member_counts.field_name = fields.key 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND (fields.value ->> 'kind') IN ('array', 'map') AND (coalesce(member_counts.count_, 0) != CAST((fields.value ->> 'length') AS BIGINT) OR member_counts.count_ > 0 AND (member_counts.min_ != 0 OR member_counts.max_ != member_counts.count_ - 1)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native ordered membership incomplete', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS address_stream ON address_stream.product_id = p_build AND address_stream.revision_id = p_build AND address_stream.stream_id = n.native_address_stream_id 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build GROUP BY coalesce(address_stream.byte_length, octet_length(convert_to(n.native_address, 'UTF8'))), coalesce(address_stream.byte_root, encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(n.native_address, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) 
HAVING count(*) > 1)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'duplicate native address including overflow representation', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS member_stream ON member_stream.product_id = p_build AND member_stream.revision_id = p_build AND member_stream.stream_id = m.member_key_stream_id 
WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build AND (m.member_key IS NOT NULL OR m.member_key_stream_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY m.parent_id, m.field_name, coalesce(member_stream.byte_length, octet_length(convert_to(m.member_key, 'UTF8'))), coalesce(member_stream.byte_root, encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(m.member_key, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) 
HAVING count(*) > 1)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'duplicate native map key including overflow representation', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_reference AS r LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS n ON n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.record_id = r.target_id 
WHERE r.product_id = p_build AND r.revision_id = p_build AND (n.record_id IS NULL OR r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND (r.field_name NOT IN ('source_cell_id', 'target_cell_id')) AND NOT ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build, p_build, n.native_address, n.native_address_stream_id, r.native_pointer, r.native_pointer_stream_id)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native reference/address target differs', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_product AS input_pin ON input_pin.task_id = CAST((c.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND input_pin.product_key = (c.body ->> 'product_key') AND input_pin.content_digest = (c.body ->> 'content_digest') LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_task_context(input_pin.task_id) AS input_context ON true 
WHERE c.product_id = p_build AND c.revision_id = p_build AND c.family = 'input' AND (input_pin.task_id IS NULL OR input_pin.artifact_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_source OR input_context.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_project))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF input outside exact admitted source/project custody', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c JOIN ops.pdf_product_body AS observation ON observation.task_id = CAST((c.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND observation.product_key = (c.body ->> 'product_key') 
WHERE c.product_id = p_build AND c.revision_id = p_build AND c.family = 'input' AND ((observation.descriptor['observation']) ->> 'pass_role') IN ('chandra_page', 'chandra_crop'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'visual observation cannot be an input to selected PDF publication', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH coverage_claims AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS claim_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, ops.pdf_frozen_build.kind AS product_kind 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON ops.pdf_frozen_build.build_id = kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'coverage'), 
coverage_support_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT coverage_claims.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_claims.body ->> 'scope' AS scope, coverage_claims.body ->> 'family' AS family, support.value ->> 'coverage_id' AS coverage_id, support_pin.task_id AS task_id, support_pin.product_key AS product_key, support_publication.build_id AS build_id 
FROM coverage_claims JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(nullif(coverage_claims.body['supports'], 'null'::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) AS support ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS support_input ON support_input.product_id = p_build AND support_input.revision_id = p_build AND support_input.family = 'input' AND support_input.local_id = (support.value ->> 'input_index') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_product AS support_pin ON support_pin.task_id = CAST((support_input.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND support_pin.product_key = (support_input.body ->> 'product_key') AND support_pin.content_digest = (support_input.body ->> 'content_digest') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_published_revision AS support_publication ON support_publication.task_id = support_pin.task_id AND support_publication.product_key = support_pin.product_key AND support_publication.logical_digest = support_pin.content_digest), 
resolved_coverage_supports AS 
(SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, recorded_coverage.local_id AS coverage_id, recorded_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS recorded_coverage ON recorded_coverage.product_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.revision_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.family = 'coverage' AND recorded_coverage.local_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, retained_coverage.coverage_id AS coverage_id, retained_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_product_coverage AS retained_coverage ON retained_coverage.task_id = coverage_support_edges.task_id AND retained_coverage.product_key = coverage_support_edges.product_key AND retained_coverage.coverage_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NULL), 
coverage_support_summary AS 
(SELECT resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id AS claim_id, bool_or(NOT (resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family'))) AS invalid_support, bool_or(resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family') AND (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete') AS complete_support 
FROM resolved_coverage_supports GROUP BY resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id)
 SELECT 1 AS anon_1 
FROM coverage_claims LEFT OUTER JOIN coverage_support_summary ON coverage_support_summary.claim_id = coverage_claims.claim_id 
WHERE coalesce(coverage_support_summary.invalid_support, false) OR coverage_claims.product_kind = 'integrated' AND (coverage_claims.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete' AND NOT coalesce(coverage_support_summary.complete_support, false))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'coverage support differs from exact input coverage scope/family/outcome', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS occurrence LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS item ON item.product_id = p_build AND item.revision_id = p_build AND item.pointer = (occurrence.body ->> 'pointer') 
WHERE occurrence.product_id = p_build AND occurrence.revision_id = p_build AND occurrence.family = 'occurrence' AND (occurrence.body ->> 'address_space') IN ('native_item', 'selected_item', 'native_cell') AND (item.pointer IS NULL OR (occurrence.body ? 'cell_index') AND CAST((occurrence.body ->> 'cell_index') AS BIGINT) >= greatest(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(item.native_json['data']['table_cells'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))), jsonb_array_length(coalesce(item.native_json['meta']['tabular_chart']['chart_data']['table_cells'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'companion occurrence outside native item/cell inventory', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint AS e 
WHERE e.product_id = p_build AND e.revision_id = p_build AND (e.target_task_id = 0 AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS own 
WHERE own.product_id = p_build AND own.revision_id = p_build AND own.family = 'occurrence' AND own.local_id = e.occurrence_id)) OR e.target_task_id != 0 AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.pdf_product AS p 
WHERE p.task_id = e.target_task_id AND p.product_key = e.target_product_key AND p.content_digest = e.target_content_digest AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_occurrence AS "old" 
WHERE "old".task_id = p.task_id AND "old".product_key = p.product_key AND "old".occurrence_id = e.occurrence_id)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.pdf_published_revision AS pr JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS external ON external.product_id = pr.build_id AND external.revision_id = pr.build_id 
WHERE pr.task_id = p.task_id AND pr.product_key = p.product_key AND pr.logical_digest = p.content_digest AND external.family = 'occurrence' AND external.local_id = e.occurrence_id)))))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'companion endpoint outside admitted occurrence inventory', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c 
WHERE c.product_id = p_build AND c.revision_id = p_build AND c.family = 'native_metadata' AND ((c.body ? 'value') OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field AS metadata_value 
WHERE metadata_value.product_id = c.product_id AND metadata_value.revision_id = c.revision_id AND metadata_value.family = c.family AND metadata_value.local_id = c.local_id AND metadata_value.field_name = 'value'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'metadata value has no governed byte field', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field AS field JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS c ON field.product_id = c.product_id AND field.revision_id = c.revision_id AND field.family = c.family AND field.local_id = c.local_id JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS field_stream ON field_stream.product_id = field.product_id AND field_stream.revision_id = field.revision_id AND field_stream.stream_id = field.stream_id 
WHERE field.product_id = p_build AND field.revision_id = p_build AND ((c.body ? field.field_name) OR field_stream.encoding_profile IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN (field.field_name = 'value' AND (c.body ->> 'kind') = 'inline_candidate_pages') THEN 'pdf-ocr-candidate-ipc-v1' WHEN (field.field_name IN ('value', 'endpoints')) THEN 'pdf-companion-json-field-v1' ELSE 'pdf-record-scalar-v1:s' END))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid final companion field', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.native_type IN ('TextItem', 'ListItem', 'SectionHeaderItem', 'FormulaItem', 'CodeItem', 'GroupItem', 'ListGroup', 'PictureItem', 'TableItem') AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref' AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_access.pointer = (n.scalars_json ->> 'self_ref'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native access inventory incomplete', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
END
