 END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE owner_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT n.record_id AS parent_id, fields.value ->> 'target' AS child_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json['fields']) AS fields ON true 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND (fields.value ->> 'kind') = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT m.parent_id AS parent_id, m.record_id AS record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build AND m.value_kind = 'record'), 
owner_counts AS 
(SELECT owner_edges.child_id AS child_id, count(owner_edges.parent_id) AS owners 
FROM owner_edges GROUP BY owner_edges.child_id), 
reachable(root_id) AS 
(SELECT ops.pdf_record_document.root_id AS root_id 
FROM ops.pdf_record_document 
WHERE ops.pdf_record_document.product_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_record_document.revision_id = p_build UNION SELECT owner_edges.child_id AS child_id 
FROM reachable JOIN owner_edges ON owner_edges.parent_id = reachable.root_id)
 SELECT coalesce(bool_or(coalesce(owner_counts.owners, 0) != CASE WHEN (n.record_id = (SELECT ops.pdf_record_document.root_id 
FROM ops.pdf_record_document 
WHERE ops.pdf_record_document.product_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_record_document.revision_id = p_build)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), true) AS coalesce_1, coalesce(bool_or(reachable.root_id IS NULL), true) AS coalesce_2 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n LEFT OUTER JOIN owner_counts ON n.record_id = owner_counts.child_id LEFT OUTER JOIN reachable ON reachable.root_id = n.record_id 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build INTO bad_owner_, unreachable_;
 IF (bad_owner_) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native orphan or repeated containment owner', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (unreachable_) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native containment cycle or unreachable record', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF ((WITH access_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT parent.pointer AS parent_pointer, children.value ->> '$ref' AS child_pointer 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS parent JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(parent.native_json['children'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS children ON true 
WHERE parent.product_id = p_build AND parent.revision_id = p_build)
 SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS parent JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS child ON child.product_id = parent.product_id AND child.revision_id = parent.revision_id AND child.parent_pointer = parent.pointer 
WHERE parent.product_id = p_build AND parent.revision_id = p_build AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM access_edges 
WHERE access_edges.parent_pointer = parent.pointer AND child.pointer = access_edges.child_pointer)))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM access_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS child ON child.product_id = p_build AND child.revision_id = p_build AND child.pointer = access_edges.child_pointer 
WHERE child.pointer IS NULL OR child.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM access_edges.parent_pointer)) AS anon_1)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native parent/child backpointer differs', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json['fields']) AS fields ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS target ON target.product_id = p_build AND target.revision_id = p_build AND target.record_id = (fields.value ->> 'target') 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND (fields.value ->> 'kind') = 'object' AND target.record_id IS NULL)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'missing native object target', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH member_counts AS 
(SELECT m.parent_id AS parent_id, m.field_name AS field_name, count(*) AS count_, min(m.ordinal) AS min_, max(m.ordinal) AS max_ 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build GROUP BY m.parent_id, m.field_name)
 SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(n.structure_json['fields']) AS fields ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN member_counts ON member_counts.parent_id = n.record_id AND member_counts.field_name = fields.key 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND (fields.value ->> 'kind') IN ('array', 'map') AND (coalesce(member_counts.count_, 0) != CAST((fields.value ->> 'length') AS BIGINT) OR member_counts.count_ > 0 AND (member_counts.min_ != 0 OR member_counts.max_ != member_counts.count_ - 1)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native ordered membership incomplete', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS address_stream ON address_stream.product_id = p_build AND address_stream.revision_id = p_build AND address_stream.stream_id = n.native_address_stream_id 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build GROUP BY coalesce(address_stream.byte_length, octet_length(convert_to(n.native_address, 'UTF8'))), coalesce(address_stream.byte_root, encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(n.native_address, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) 
HAVING count(*) > 1)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'duplicate native address including overflow representation', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS member_stream ON member_stream.product_id = p_build AND member_stream.revision_id = p_build AND member_stream.stream_id = m.member_key_stream_id 
WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build AND (m.member_key IS NOT NULL OR m.member_key_stream_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY m.parent_id, m.field_name, coalesce(member_stream.byte_length, octet_length(convert_to(m.member_key, 'UTF8'))), coalesce(member_stream.byte_root, encode(ops.pdf_identity_byte_root(convert_to(m.member_key, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) 
HAVING count(*) > 1)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'duplicate native map key including overflow representation', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_reference AS r LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS n ON n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.record_id = r.target_id 
WHERE r.product_id = p_build AND r.revision_id = p_build AND (n.record_id IS NULL OR r.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND (r.field_name NOT IN ('source_cell_id', 'target_cell_id')) AND NOT ops.pdf_reference_bytes_equal(p_build, p_build, n.native_address, n.native_address_stream_id, r.native_pointer, r.native_pointer_stream_id)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native reference/address target differs', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_product AS input_pin ON input_pin.task_id = CAST((c.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND input_pin.product_key = (c.body ->> 'product_key') AND input_pin.content_digest = (c.body ->> 'content_digest') LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_task_context(input_pin.task_id) AS input_context ON true 
WHERE c.product_id = p_build AND c.revision_id = p_build AND c.family = 'input' AND (input_pin.task_id IS NULL OR input_pin.artifact_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_source OR input_context.project_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_project))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF input outside exact admitted source/project custody', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c JOIN ops.pdf_product_body AS observation ON observation.task_id = CAST((c.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND observation.product_key = (c.body ->> 'product_key') 
WHERE c.product_id = p_build AND c.revision_id = p_build AND c.family = 'input' AND ((observation.descriptor['observation']) ->> 'pass_role') IN ('chandra_page', 'chandra_crop'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'visual observation cannot be an input to selected PDF publication', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH coverage_claims AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS claim_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, ops.pdf_frozen_build.kind AS product_kind 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON ops.pdf_frozen_build.build_id = kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'coverage'), 
coverage_support_edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT coverage_claims.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_claims.body ->> 'scope' AS scope, coverage_claims.body ->> 'family' AS family, support.value ->> 'coverage_id' AS coverage_id, support_pin.task_id AS task_id, support_pin.product_key AS product_key, support_publication.build_id AS build_id 
FROM coverage_claims JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(nullif(coverage_claims.body['supports'], 'null'::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) AS support ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS support_input ON support_input.product_id = p_build AND support_input.revision_id = p_build AND support_input.family = 'input' AND support_input.local_id = (support.value ->> 'input_index') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_product AS support_pin ON support_pin.task_id = CAST((support_input.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND support_pin.product_key = (support_input.body ->> 'product_key') AND support_pin.content_digest = (support_input.body ->> 'content_digest') LEFT OUTER JOIN ops.pdf_published_revision AS support_publication ON support_publication.task_id = support_pin.task_id AND support_publication.product_key = support_pin.product_key AND support_publication.logical_digest = support_pin.content_digest), 
resolved_coverage_supports AS 
(SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, recorded_coverage.local_id AS coverage_id, recorded_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS recorded_coverage ON recorded_coverage.product_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.revision_id = coverage_support_edges.build_id AND recorded_coverage.family = 'coverage' AND recorded_coverage.local_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT coverage_support_edges.claim_id AS claim_id, coverage_support_edges.scope AS scope, coverage_support_edges.family AS family, retained_coverage.coverage_id AS coverage_id, retained_coverage.body AS body 
FROM coverage_support_edges LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_product_coverage AS retained_coverage ON retained_coverage.task_id = coverage_support_edges.task_id AND retained_coverage.product_key = coverage_support_edges.product_key AND retained_coverage.coverage_id = coverage_support_edges.coverage_id 
WHERE coverage_support_edges.build_id IS NULL), 
coverage_support_summary AS 
(SELECT resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id AS claim_id, bool_or(NOT (resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family'))) AS invalid_support, bool_or(resolved_coverage_supports.coverage_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_coverage_supports.scope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'scope') AND resolved_coverage_supports.family IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'family') AND (resolved_coverage_supports.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete') AS complete_support 
FROM resolved_coverage_supports GROUP BY resolved_coverage_supports.claim_id)
 SELECT 1 AS anon_1 
FROM coverage_claims LEFT OUTER JOIN coverage_support_summary ON coverage_support_summary.claim_id = coverage_claims.claim_id 
WHERE coalesce(coverage_support_summary.invalid_support, false) OR coverage_claims.product_kind = 'integrated' AND (coverage_claims.body ->> 'outcome') = 'complete' AND NOT coalesce(coverage_support_summary.complete_support, false))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'coverage support differs from exact input coverage scope/family/outcome', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS occurrence LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS item ON item.product_id = p_build AND item.revision_id = p_build AND item.pointer = (occurrence.body ->> 'pointer') 
WHERE occurrence.product_id = p_build AND occurrence.revision_id = p_build AND occurrence.family = 'occurrence' AND (occurrence.body ->> 'address_space') IN ('native_item', 'selected_item', 'native_cell') AND (item.pointer IS NULL OR (occurrence.body ? 'cell_index') AND CAST((occurrence.body ->> 'cell_index') AS BIGINT) >= greatest(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(item.native_json['data']['table_cells'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))), jsonb_array_length(coalesce(item.native_json['meta']['tabular_chart']['chart_data']['table_cells'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'companion occurrence outside native item/cell inventory', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint AS e 
WHERE e.product_id = p_build AND e.revision_id = p_build AND (e.target_task_id = 0 AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS own 
WHERE own.product_id = p_build AND own.revision_id = p_build AND own.family = 'occurrence' AND own.local_id = e.occurrence_id)) OR e.target_task_id != 0 AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.pdf_product AS p 
WHERE p.task_id = e.target_task_id AND p.product_key = e.target_product_key AND p.content_digest = e.target_content_digest AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_occurrence AS "old" 
WHERE "old".task_id = p.task_id AND "old".product_key = p.product_key AND "old".occurrence_id = e.occurrence_id)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.pdf_published_revision AS pr JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS external ON external.product_id = pr.build_id AND external.revision_id = pr.build_id 
WHERE pr.task_id = p.task_id AND pr.product_key = p.product_key AND pr.logical_digest = p.content_digest AND external.family = 'occurrence' AND external.local_id = e.occurrence_id)))))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'companion endpoint outside admitted occurrence inventory', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c 
WHERE c.product_id = p_build AND c.revision_id = p_build AND c.family = 'native_metadata' AND ((c.body ? 'value') OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field AS metadata_value 
WHERE metadata_value.product_id = c.product_id AND metadata_value.revision_id = c.revision_id AND metadata_value.family = c.family AND metadata_value.local_id = c.local_id AND metadata_value.field_name = 'value'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'metadata value has no governed byte field', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field AS field JOIN kb.pdf_record_companion AS c ON field.product_id = c.product_id AND field.revision_id = c.revision_id AND field.family = c.family AND field.local_id = c.local_id JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream AS field_stream ON field_stream.product_id = field.product_id AND field_stream.revision_id = field.revision_id AND field_stream.stream_id = field.stream_id 
WHERE field.product_id = p_build AND field.revision_id = p_build AND ((c.body ? field.field_name) OR field_stream.encoding_profile IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN (field.field_name = 'value' AND (c.body ->> 'kind') = 'inline_candidate_pages') THEN 'pdf-ocr-candidate-ipc-v1' WHEN (field.field_name IN ('value', 'endpoints')) THEN 'pdf-companion-json-field-v1' ELSE 'pdf-record-scalar-v1:s' END))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid final companion field', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n 
WHERE n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.native_type IN ('TextItem', 'ListItem', 'SectionHeaderItem', 'FormulaItem', 'CodeItem', 'GroupItem', 'ListGroup', 'PictureItem', 'TableItem') AND n.scalars_json ? 'self_ref' AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_access.pointer = (n.scalars_json ->> 'self_ref'))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native access inventory incomplete', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
END$$
ALTER FUNCTION ops.pdf_check_build_inventory (text, text, text) OWNER TO corpus_sem_publisher
REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON FUNCTION ops.pdf_check_build_inventory (text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC

catalog.arguments: p_build text, p_task bigint, p_attempt bigint, p_holder text, p_frozen text, p_check text
catalog.body:
DECLARE
 b ops.pdf_stage_build%ROWTYPE;
 contract_ text;
 result_ text := '';
 prior_ text;
 reused_ text;
BEGIN
 IF (NOT (current_setting('transaction_isolation') = ANY (ARRAY['read committed']))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF projection admission requires READ COMMITTED', ERRCODE = '25000';
 END IF;
 IF (p_check = 'seal') THEN
  PERFORM ops.require_pdf_stage_owner(p_task, p_attempt, p_holder);
  PERFORM 1 AS anon_1 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_build 
WHERE ops.pdf_stage_build.build_id = p_build FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
 END IF;
 b := ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build, p_task, p_attempt, p_holder, p_frozen);
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_operation(b.release_id, 'validate_pdf_build');
 IF (b.state != 'frozen') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF check requires a frozen private build', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 contract_ := ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id);
 IF (p_check = 'seal') THEN
  IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.read_pdf_certification_requirement(p_build, p_task, p_attempt, p_holder, p_frozen) AS anon_1 
WHERE anon_1.oracle_receipt_id IS NOT NULL))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF lowering has no passed round-trip oracle', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.pdf_validation_check 
WHERE ops.pdf_validation_check.build_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_validation_check.attempt = p_attempt AND ops.pdf_validation_check.holder = p_holder AND ops.pdf_validation_check.frozen_digest = p_frozen AND ops.pdf_validation_check.contract_digest = contract_ AND ops.pdf_validation_check.check_name = 'seal')) THEN
   RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT ops.pdf_published_revision.build_id 
FROM ops.pdf_published_revision JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation ON ops.pdf_build_validation.build_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.build_id AND ops.pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest AND ops.pdf_build_validation.logical_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.logical_digest AND ops.pdf_build_validation.native_contract_digest = contract_ AND ops.pdf_build_validation.native_callbacks JOIN ops.task ON ops.task.id = ops.pdf_published_revision.task_id JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_task_context(ops.task.id) AS previous_context ON true JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON ops.pdf_frozen_build.build_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_frozen_build.kind = ops.pdf_published_revision.kind 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_derivation 
WHERE ops.data_derivation.producer_task_id = ops.task.id AND ops.ddo_node_valid('episode', ops.data_derivation.id))) AND ops.pdf_published_revision.source_digest = b.source_digest AND ops.pdf_published_revision.schema_digest = b.schema_digest AND ops.pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest = b.recipe_digest AND ops.pdf_published_revision.release_id = b.release_id AND previous_context.project_id = (SELECT anon_1.project_id 
FROM ops.pdf_task_context(b.task_id) AS anon_1) ORDER BY ops.task.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1 INTO reused_;
 ELSE
  SELECT ops.pdf_validation_check.predecessor_build_id 
FROM ops.pdf_validation_check 
WHERE ops.pdf_validation_check.build_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_validation_check.attempt = p_attempt AND ops.pdf_validation_check.holder = p_holder AND ops.pdf_validation_check.frozen_digest = p_frozen AND ops.pdf_validation_check.contract_digest = contract_ AND ops.pdf_validation_check.check_name = 'seal' INTO prior_;
  IF (NOT found) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF projection seal missing or stale', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.pdf_validation_check 
WHERE ops.pdf_validation_check.build_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_validation_check.attempt = p_attempt AND ops.pdf_validation_check.holder = p_holder AND ops.pdf_validation_check.frozen_digest = p_frozen AND ops.pdf_validation_check.contract_digest = contract_ AND ops.pdf_validation_check.check_name = p_check)) THEN
   RETURN;
  END IF;
  IF (p_check = 'inventory') THEN
   PERFORM ops.pdf_check_build_inventory(p_build, b.source_digest, (SELECT anon_1.project_id 
FROM ops.pdf_task_context(b.task_id) AS anon_1));
  ELSE
   IF (p_check = 'access') THEN
    IF (prior_ IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ((SELECT kb.pdf_record_access.pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.ordinal, kb.pdf_record_access.label, kb.pdf_record_access.parent_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.section_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.content_layer, kb.pdf_record_access.text, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_access.native_json AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = p_build EXCEPT ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_access.pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.ordinal, kb.pdf_record_access.label, kb.pdf_record_access.parent_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.section_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.content_layer, kb.pdf_record_access.text, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_access.native_json AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = prior_ AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = prior_) UNION ALL (SELECT kb.pdf_record_access.pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.ordinal, kb.pdf_record_access.label, kb.pdf_record_access.parent_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.section_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.content_layer, kb.pdf_record_access.text, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_access.native_json AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = prior_ AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = prior_ EXCEPT ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_access.pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.ordinal, kb.pdf_record_access.label, kb.pdf_record_access.parent_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.section_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.content_layer, kb.pdf_record_access.text, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_access.native_json AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = p_build AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = p_build))) AND NOT (EXISTS ((SELECT kb.pdf_record_region.pointer, kb.pdf_record_region.region_index, kb.pdf_record_region.page_no, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_region.page_width AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_2, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_region.page_height AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_3, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_region."left" AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_4, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_region.top AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_5, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_region."right" AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_6, convert_to(CAST(kb.pdf_record_region.bottom AS TEXT), 'UTF8') AS convert_to_7, kb.pdf_record_region.origin 
FROM kb.pdf_record_region

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.check_pdf_build(p_build text, p_task bigint, p_attempt bigint, p_holder text, p_frozen text, p_check text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$DECLARE
 b ops.pdf_stage_build%ROWTYPE;
 contract_ text;
 result_ text := '';
 prior_ text;
 reused_ text;
BEGIN
 IF (NOT (current_setting('transaction_isolation') = ANY (ARRAY['read committed']))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF projection admission requires READ COMMITTED', ERRCODE = '25000';
 END IF;
 IF (p_check = 'seal') THEN
  PERFORM ops.require_pdf_stage_owner(p_task, p_attempt, p_holder);
  PERFORM 1 AS anon_1 
FROM ops.pdf_stage_build 
WHERE ops.pdf_stage_build.build_id = p_build FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
 END IF;
 b := ops.require_pdf_frozen(p_build, p_task, p_attempt, p_holder, p_frozen);
 PERFORM ops.require_pdf_operation(b.release_id, 'validate_pdf_build');
 IF (b.state != 'frozen') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF check requires a frozen private build', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 contract_ := ops.pdf_validation_contract(b.release_id);
 IF (p_check = 'seal') THEN
  IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.read_pdf_certification_requirement(p_build, p_task, p_attempt, p_holder, p_frozen) AS anon_1 
WHERE anon_1.oracle_receipt_id IS NOT NULL))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF lowering has no passed round-trip oracle', ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.pdf_validation_check 
WHERE ops.pdf_validation_check.build_id = p_build AND ops.pdf_validation_check.attempt = p_attempt AND ops.pdf_validation_check.holder = p_holder AND ops.pdf_validation_check.frozen_digest = p_frozen AND ops.pdf_validation_check.contract_digest = contract_ AND ops.pdf_validation_check.check_name = 'seal')) THEN
   RETURN;

DECLARE
 published ops.pdf_published_revision%ROWTYPE;
 total numeric;
BEGIN
 SELECT placement.* 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task, p_product, p_digest) AS placement INTO STRICT published;
 WITH events AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_2.event AS event 
FROM ops.read_pdf_native_events(p_task, p_product, p_digest) AS anon_2(event))
 SELECT (0 + (SELECT coalesce(sum(CAST(octet_length(CAST(events.event AS TEXT)) AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS coalesce_1 
FROM events) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(CAST(ops.pdf_artifact_stream.byte_length AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS coalesce_2 
FROM events JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream ON ops.pdf_artifact_stream.stream_id = (events.event ->> 'value') 
WHERE ops.pdf_artifact_stream.product_id = published.build_id AND ops.pdf_artifact_stream.revision_id = published.build_id AND (events.event ->> 'kind') IN ('parts', 'key_parts', 'extension')) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(CAST(ops.pdf_artifact_stream.byte_length AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS coalesce_3 
FROM ops.pdf_artifact_stream 
WHERE ops.pdf_artifact_stream.product_id = published.build_id AND ops.pdf_artifact_stream.revision_id = published.build_id) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(CAST(octet_length(CAST(to_jsonb(pdf_record_companion) AS TEXT)) AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS coalesce_4 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(CAST(octet_length(CAST(to_jsonb(pdf_record_companion_field) AS TEXT)) AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS coalesce_5 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion_field.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion_field.revision_id = published.build_id) + (SELECT coalesce(sum(CAST(octet_length(CAST(to_jsonb(pdf_record_membership) AS TEXT)) AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS coalesce_6 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_membership.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_membership.revision_id = published.build_id)) * 6 + (SELECT coalesce(sum(CAST(octet_length(kb.source_artifact.content) AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS coalesce_7 
FROM kb.source_artifact 
WHERE kb.source_artifact.artifact_digest IN (published.source_digest, published.schema_digest, published.recipe_digest)) AS anon_1 INTO total;
 IF (total IS NULL OR total < 0 OR total > 9223372036854775807) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'PDF materialization bound exceeds signed integer capacity', ERRCODE = '22003';
 END IF;
 RETURN CAST(total AS BIGINT);
END

catalog.arguments: p_task bigint, p_product text, p_digest text, p_pointers text[], p_section text, p_family text, p_after text, p_limit integer
catalog.body:
DECLARE
 placement record;
BEGIN
 IF (p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR p_pointers IS NULL OR p_family IS NULL OR (p_family NOT IN ('occurrence', 'relation', 'input', 'coverage', 'mapping_report', 'health'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid published context page', ERRCODE = '22023';
 END IF;
 WITH published AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id, anon_1.task_id AS task_id, anon_1.product_key AS product_key, anon_1.logical_digest AS logical_digest, anon_1.release_id AS release_id, anon_1.source_digest AS source_digest, anon_1.schema_digest AS schema_digest, anon_1.recipe_digest AS recipe_digest, anon_1.frozen_digest AS frozen_digest, anon_1.kind AS kind 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task, p_product, p_digest) AS anon_1)
 SELECT published.build_id, published.task_id, published.product_key, published.logical_digest, published.release_id, published.source_digest, published.schema_digest, published.recipe_digest, published.frozen_digest, published.kind 
FROM published INTO STRICT placement;
 RETURN QUERY WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id, anon_1.task_id AS task_id, anon_1.product_key AS product_key, anon_1.logical_digest AS logical_digest, anon_1.release_id AS release_id, anon_1.source_digest AS source_digest, anon_1.schema_digest AS schema_digest, anon_1.recipe_digest AS recipe_digest, anon_1.frozen_digest AS frozen_digest, anon_1.kind AS kind 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task, p_product, p_digest) AS anon_1), 
selected AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'occurrence' AND (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'pointer') = ANY (p_pointers)), 
access AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_access.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_access.pointer AS pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.native_json AS native_json 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = published.build_id), 
scope_pointers(pointer) AS 
(SELECT pointer_seeds.pointer AS pointer 
FROM (SELECT unnest(p_pointers) AS pointer UNION SELECT p_section) AS pointer_seeds UNION SELECT access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer 
FROM access JOIN scope_pointers ON access.pointer = scope_pointers.pointer 
WHERE access.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL), 
pages AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT CAST((selected.body ->> 'page_no') AS BIGINT) AS page_no 
FROM selected 
WHERE (selected.body ->> 'page_no') ~ '^[0-9]+$' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CAST((anon_5.value ->> 'page_no') AS BIGINT) AS anon_4 
FROM access JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(access.native_json['prov'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS anon_5 ON true 
WHERE access.pointer = ANY (p_pointers) AND (anon_5.value ->> 'page_no') ~ '^[0-9]+$'), 
covered AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'coverage' AND ((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') = 'whole_document' OR (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') IN (SELECT scope_pointers.pointer || ':' || memberships.membership AS anon_2 
FROM scope_pointers JOIN (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['direct', 'descendants']) AS membership) AS memberships ON true) OR (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') IN (SELECT 'page:' || CAST(pages.page_no AS TEXT) AS anon_3 
FROM pages) OR CASE WHEN ((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') ~ '^pages:[0-9]+-[0-9]+$') THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pages 
WHERE pages.page_no BETWEEN CAST(split_part(split_part((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope'), ':', 2), '-', 1) AS BIGINT) AND CAST(split_part(split_part((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope'), ':', 2), '-', 2) AS BIGINT)) ELSE false END)), 
related AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id AS relation_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN selected ON selected.local_id = kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = p_task AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key = p_product AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest = p_digest OR kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0 AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key = '@self' AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest = '@self'), 
endpoints AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id AS relation_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal AS ordinal, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id AS target_task_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key AS target_product_key, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest AS target_content_digest, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id AS occurrence_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.role AS role 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN related ON related.relation_id = kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id), 
inputs AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'input' AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM endpoints 
WHERE endpoints.role != 'output' AND endpoints.target_task_id = CAST((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND endpoints.target_product_key = (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'product_key') AND endpoints.target_content_digest = (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'content_digest'))) OR kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id IN (SELECT (anon_7.value ->> 'input_index') AS anon_6 
FROM covered JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(covered.body['supports'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS anon_7 ON true))), 
chosen AS 
(SELECT selected.product_id AS product_id, selected.revision_id AS revision_id, selected.family AS family, selected.local_id AS local_id, selected.body AS body, selected.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT covered.product_id AS product_id, covered.revision_id AS revision_id, covered.family AS family, covered.local_id AS local_id, covered.body AS body, covered.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM covered UNION ALL SELECT inputs.product_id AS product_id, inputs.revision_id AS revision_id, inputs.family AS family, inputs.local_id AS local_id, inputs.body AS body, inputs.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM inputs UNION ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'relation' AND kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id IN (SELECT related.relation_id 
FROM related) UNION ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'mapping_report' AND (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'input_index') IN (SELECT inputs.local_id 
FROM inputs)), 
selected_context AS 
(SELECT chosen.product_id AS product_id, chosen.revision_id AS revision_id, chosen.family AS family, chosen.local_id AS local_id, chosen.body AS body 
FROM chosen 
WHERE chosen.family = p_family UNION ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE p_family = 'health' AND kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'health'), 
requested_page AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_context.product_id AS product_id, selected_context.revision_id AS revision_id, selected_context.family AS family, selected_context.local_id AS local_id, selected_context.body AS body 
FROM selected_context 
WHERE selected_context.local_id > coalesce(p_after, '') ORDER BY selected_context.local_id 
 LIMIT p_limit)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('local_id', requested_page.local_id, 'body', ops.pdf_companion_body(requested_page.product_id, requested_page.revision_id, requested_page.family, requested_page.local_id, requested_page.body)) AS jsonb_build_object_1 
FROM requested_page ORDER BY requested_page.local_id;
END

WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task, p_product, p_digest) AS anon_1), 
nodes AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_native.record_id AS record_id, kb.pdf_record_native.native_type AS native_type, kb.pdf_record_native.native_address AS native_address, kb.pdf_record_native.scalars_json AS scalars_json, kb.pdf_record_native.structure_json AS structure_json 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_native.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id = published.build_id), 
fields AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT field_rows.record_id AS record_id, field_rows.name AS name, field_rows.value AS value, field_rows.kind AS kind, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY field_rows.record_id ORDER BY field_rows.name COLLATE "C") - 1 AS slot 
FROM (SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, scalar_field.key AS name, scalar_field.value AS value, 'scalar' AS kind 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(nodes.scalars_json) AS scalar_field ON true UNION ALL SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, object_field.key AS key, object_field.value AS value, object_field.value ->> 'kind' AS anon_3 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(nodes.structure_json['fields']) AS object_field ON true) AS field_rows), 
members AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_membership.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.parent_id AS parent_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.field_name AS field_name, kb.pdf_record_membership.ordinal AS ordinal, kb.pdf_record_membership.member_key AS member_key, kb.pdf_record_membership.member_key_stream_id AS member_key_stream_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.value_kind AS value_kind, kb.pdf_record_membership.record_id AS record_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.scalar_json AS scalar_json, kb.pdf_record_membership.stream_id AS stream_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_membership.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_membership.revision_id = published.build_id), 
edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT fields.record_id AS parent_id, fields.value ->> 'target' AS child_id, ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1] AS suffix 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.kind = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT members.parent_id AS parent_id, members.record_id AS record_id, ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 1] AS anon_4 
FROM members JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = members.parent_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE members.value_kind = 'record'), 
walk(record_id, path) AS 
(SELECT roots.record_id AS record_id, CAST(roots.path AS BIGINT[]) AS path 
FROM (SELECT ops.pdf_record_document.root_id AS record_id, ARRAY[]::BIGINT[] AS path 
FROM ops.pdf_record_document JOIN published ON ops.pdf_record_document.product_id = published.build_id AND ops.pdf_record_document.revision_id = published.build_id) AS roots UNION ALL SELECT edges.child_id AS child_id, walk.path || edges.suffix AS anon_2 
FROM walk JOIN edges ON edges.parent_id = walk.record_id), 
events AS 
(SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '{' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN (fields.slot > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CAST(to_jsonb(fields.name) AS TEXT) || ':' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN fields.value ELSE to_jsonb(fields.value ->> 'stream_id') END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '{' ELSE '[' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 0] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN to_jsonb(members.member_key_stream_id) ELSE to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN CAST(to_jsonb(members.member_key) AS TEXT) || ':' ELSE '' END) END AS value, CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN members.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(members.stream_id) END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE members.value_kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '}' ELSE ']' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id), 0] AS path, 'extension' AS kind, nodes.structure_json['extensions']['stream_id'] AS value, CASE WHEN ((SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id) > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE nodes.structure_json ? 'extensions' UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '}' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind', events.kind, 'value', events.value, 'prefix', events.prefix) AS jsonb_build_object_1 
FROM events ORDER BY events.path

FROM walk JOIN edges ON edges.parent_id = walk.record_id), 
events AS 
(SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '{' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN (fields.slot > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CAST(to_jsonb(fields.name) AS TEXT) || ':' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN fields.value ELSE to_jsonb(fields.value ->> 'stream_id') END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '{' ELSE '[' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 0] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN to_jsonb(members.member_key_stream_id) ELSE to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN CAST(to_jsonb(members.member_key) AS TEXT) || ':' ELSE '' END) END AS value, CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN members.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(members.stream_id) END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE members.value_kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '}' ELSE ']' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id), 0] AS path, 'extension' AS kind, nodes.structure_json['extensions']['stream_id'] AS value, CASE WHEN ((SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id) > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE nodes.structure_json ? 'extensions' UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '}' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind', events.kind, 'value', events.value, 'prefix', events.prefix) AS jsonb_build_object_1 
FROM events ORDER BY events.path$$

WITH published AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task, p_key, p_digest) AS anon_1), 
companions AS MATERIALIZED

FROM (SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal

(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion_field.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.field_name AS field_name, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.stream_id AS stream_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.scalar_kind AS scalar_kind, companions.ordinal AS row_ordinal

FROM companions UNION ALL SELECT fields.row_ordinal AS row_ordinal, fields.local_id AS local_id, 1 AS anon_2, fields.field_name AS field_name, 0 AS anon_3, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS anon_4, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'field', 'field', to_jsonb(pdf_artifact_stream) || jsonb_build_object('field_name', fields.field_name, 'scalar_kind', fields.scalar_kind)) AS jsonb_build_object_1 
FROM fields JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream ON fields.product_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.product_id AND fields.revision_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.revision_id AND fields.stream_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.stream_id UNION ALL SELECT fields.row_ordinal AS row_ordinal, fields.local_id AS local_id, 1 AS anon_5, fields.field_name AS field_name, 1 AS anon_6, part.ordinal AS ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'part', 'part', to_jsonb(part)) AS jsonb_build_object_2 
FROM fields JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_artifact_parts(fields.product_id, fields.revision_id, false, ARRAY[CAST(fields.stream_id AS TEXT)]) AS part ON fields.product_id = part.product_id AND fields.revision_id = part.revision_id AND fields.stream_id = part.stream_id UNION ALL SELECT companions.ordinal AS ordinal, companions.local_id AS local_id, 2 AS phase, '' AS field_name, 0 AS subphase, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS part_ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'close') AS event 
FROM companions)
 SELECT events.event 
FROM events ORDER BY events.ordinal, events.local_id, events.phase, events.field_name, events.subphase, events.part_ordinal

WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id, anon_1.task_id AS task_id, anon_1.product_key AS product_key, anon_1.logical_digest AS logical_digest, anon_1.release_id AS release_id, anon_1.source_digest AS source_digest, anon_1.schema_digest AS schema_digest, anon_1.recipe_digest AS recipe_digest, anon_1.frozen_digest AS frozen_digest, anon_1.kind AS kind 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(p_task, p_key, p_digest) AS anon_1), 
selected AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'occurrence' AND (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'pointer') = ANY (p_pointers)), 
access AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_access.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_access.pointer AS pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.native_json AS native_json 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = published.build_id), 
scope_pointers(pointer) AS 
(SELECT pointer_seeds.pointer AS pointer 
FROM (SELECT unnest(p_pointers) AS pointer UNION SELECT p_section) AS pointer_seeds UNION SELECT access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer 
FROM access JOIN scope_pointers ON access.pointer = scope_pointers.pointer 
WHERE access.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL), 
pages AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT CAST((selected.body ->> 'page_no') AS BIGINT) AS page_no 
FROM selected 
WHERE (selected.body ->> 'page_no') ~ '^[0-9]+$' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CAST((anon_5.value ->> 'page_no') AS BIGINT) AS anon_4 
FROM access JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(access.native_json['prov'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS anon_5 ON true 
WHERE access.pointer = ANY (p_pointers) AND (anon_5.value ->> 'page_no') ~ '^[0-9]+$'), 
covered AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'coverage' AND ((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') = 'whole_document' OR (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') IN (SELECT scope_pointers.pointer || ':' || memberships.membership AS anon_2 
FROM scope_pointers JOIN (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['direct', 'descendants']) AS membership) AS memberships ON true) OR (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') IN (SELECT 'page:' || CAST(pages.page_no AS TEXT) AS anon_3 
FROM pages) OR CASE WHEN ((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') ~ '^pages:[0-9]+-[0-9]+$') THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pages 
WHERE pages.page_no BETWEEN CAST(split_part(split_part((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope'), ':', 2), '-', 1) AS BIGINT) AND CAST(split_part(split_part((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope'), ':', 2), '-', 2) AS BIGINT)) ELSE false END)), 
related AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id AS relation_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN selected ON selected.local_id = kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = p_task AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key = p_key AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest = p_digest OR kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0 AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key = '@self' AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest = '@self'), 
endpoints AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id AS relation_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal AS ordinal, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id AS target_task_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key AS target_product_key, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest AS target_content_digest, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id AS occurrence_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.role AS role 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN related ON related.relation_id = kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id), 
inputs AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'input' AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM endpoints

(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id, anon_1.task_id AS task_id, anon_1.product_key AS product_key, anon_1.logical_digest AS logical_digest, anon_1.release_id AS release_id, anon_1.source_digest AS source_digest, anon_1.schema_digest AS schema_digest, anon_1.recipe_digest AS recipe_digest, anon_1.frozen_digest AS frozen_digest, anon_1.kind AS kind

FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'occurrence' AND (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'pointer') = ANY (p_pointers)), 
access AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_access.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_access.pointer AS pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, kb.pdf_record_access.native_json AS native_json

scope_pointers(pointer) AS 
(SELECT pointer_seeds.pointer AS pointer 
FROM (SELECT unnest(p_pointers) AS pointer UNION SELECT p_section) AS pointer_seeds UNION SELECT access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer 
FROM access JOIN scope_pointers ON access.pointer = scope_pointers.pointer 
WHERE access.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL), 
pages AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT CAST((selected.body ->> 'page_no') AS BIGINT) AS page_no 
FROM selected 
WHERE (selected.body ->> 'page_no') ~ '^[0-9]+$' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CAST((anon_5.value ->> 'page_no') AS BIGINT) AS anon_4 
FROM access JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(access.native_json['prov'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS anon_5 ON true 
WHERE access.pointer = ANY (p_pointers) AND (anon_5.value ->> 'page_no') ~ '^[0-9]+$'), 
covered AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'coverage' AND ((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') = 'whole_document' OR (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope') IN (SELECT scope_pointers.pointer || ':' || memberships.membership AS anon_2

FROM pages 
WHERE pages.page_no BETWEEN CAST(split_part(split_part((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope'), ':', 2), '-', 1) AS BIGINT) AND CAST(split_part(split_part((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'scope'), ':', 2), '-', 2) AS BIGINT)) ELSE false END)), 
related AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT DISTINCT kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id AS relation_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN selected ON selected.local_id = kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = p_task AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key = p_key AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest = p_digest OR kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0 AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key = '@self' AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest = '@self'), 
endpoints AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id AS relation_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal AS ordinal, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id AS target_task_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key AS target_product_key, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest AS target_content_digest, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id AS occurrence_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.role AS role 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN related ON related.relation_id = kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id), 
inputs AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'input' AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM endpoints 
WHERE endpoints.role != 'output' AND endpoints.target_task_id = CAST((kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'task_id') AS BIGINT) AND endpoints.target_product_key = (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'product_key') AND endpoints.target_content_digest = (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'content_digest'))) OR kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id IN (SELECT (anon_7.value ->> 'input_index') AS anon_6 
FROM covered JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(covered.body['supports'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS anon_7 ON true))), 
chosen AS 
(SELECT selected.product_id AS product_id, selected.revision_id AS revision_id, selected.family AS family, selected.local_id AS local_id, selected.body AS body, selected.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT covered.product_id AS product_id, covered.revision_id AS revision_id, covered.family AS family, covered.local_id AS local_id, covered.body AS body, covered.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM covered UNION ALL SELECT inputs.product_id AS product_id, inputs.revision_id AS revision_id, inputs.family AS family, inputs.local_id AS local_id, inputs.body AS body, inputs.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM inputs UNION ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'relation' AND kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id IN (SELECT related.relation_id 
FROM related) UNION ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS body, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'mapping_report' AND (kb.pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'input_index') IN (SELECT inputs.local_id 
FROM inputs))
 SELECT chosen.family, chosen.local_id, chosen.ordinal, ops.pdf_companion_body(chosen.product_id, chosen.revision_id, chosen.family, chosen.local_id, chosen.body) AS pdf_companion_body_1 
FROM chosen$$

WHERE grouped.family = 'coverage'), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)), 'mapping_reports', coalesce((SELECT grouped.body

 RETURN result_;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_validation(p_task bigint, p_key text, p_digest text)
 RETURNS SETOF ops.pdf_build_validation
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT pdf_build_validation.build_id,
     pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.logical_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.contract_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.native_callbacks,
     pdf_build_validation.native_contract_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.certification_basis,
     pdf_build_validation.lowering_identity,
     pdf_build_validation.attested_logical_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.native_document_digest,
     pdf_build_validation.oracle_receipt_id
    FROM (((((((ops.pdf_published_revision
      JOIN ops.pdf_stage_build ON (((pdf_stage_build.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id) AND (pdf_stage_build.task_id = pdf_published_revision.task_id) AND (pdf_stage_build.release_id = pdf_published_revision.release_id) AND (pdf_stage_build.source_digest = pdf_published_revision.source_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.schema_digest = pdf_published_revision.schema_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.recipe_digest = pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON (((pdf_frozen_build.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id) AND (pdf_frozen_build.frozen_digest = pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest) AND (pdf_frozen_build.kind = pdf_published_revision.kind))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_product ON (((pdf_product.task_id = pdf_published_revision.task_id) AND (pdf_product.product_key = pdf_published_revision.product_key) AND (pdf_product.content_digest = pdf_published_revision.logical_digest) AND (pdf_product.release_id = pdf_published_revision.release_id) AND (pdf_product.artifact_digest = pdf_published_revision.source_digest) AND (pdf_product.kind = pdf_published_revision.kind))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation ON (((pdf_build_validation.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id) AND (pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest = pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest) AND (pdf_build_validation.logical_digest = pdf_published_revision.logical_digest) AND (pdf_build_validation.contract_digest = pdf_product.contract_digest))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_producer_certification ON (((pdf_producer_certification.build_id = pdf_build_validation.build_id) AND (pdf_producer_certification.lowering_identity = pdf_build_validation.lowering_identity) AND (pdf_producer_certification.logical_digest = pdf_build_validation.attested_logical_digest) AND (pdf_producer_certification.logical_digest = pdf_published_revision.logical_digest) AND (pdf_producer_certification.native_document_digest = pdf_build_validation.native_document_digest) AND (pdf_producer_certification.kind = pdf_published_revision.kind))))
      JOIN ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle ON (((pdf_roundtrip_oracle.oracle_receipt_id = pdf_build_validation.oracle_receipt_id) AND (pdf_roundtrip_oracle.lowering_identity = pdf_build_validation.lowering_identity) AND (pdf_roundtrip_oracle.kind = pdf_published_revision.kind))))
      LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_published_revision oracle_publication ON (((oracle_publication.build_id = pdf_roundtrip_oracle.build_id) AND (oracle_publication.frozen_digest = pdf_roundtrip_oracle.frozen_digest) AND (oracle_publication.logical_digest = pdf_roundtrip_oracle.logical_digest) AND (oracle_publication.kind = pdf_roundtrip_oracle.kind))))
   WHERE ((pdf_published_revision.task_id = read_pdf_published_validation.p_task) AND (pdf_published_revision.product_key = read_pdf_published_validation.p_key) AND (pdf_published_revision.logical_digest = read_pdf_published_validation.p_digest) AND (pdf_stage_build.state = 'published'::text) AND (pdf_build_validation.native_callbacks IS TRUE) AND (pdf_roundtrip_oracle.state = 'passed'::text) AND (pdf_roundtrip_oracle.actual_native_digest = pdf_roundtrip_oracle.native_document_digest) AND (((pdf_build_validation.certification_basis = 'round-trip-verified'::text) AND (pdf_roundtrip_oracle.build_id = pdf_published_revision.build_id) AND (pdf_roundtrip_oracle.frozen_digest = pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest) AND (pdf_roundtrip_oracle.native_document_digest = pdf_producer_certification.native_document_digest)) OR ((pdf_build_validation.certification_basis = 'producer-certified'::text) AND (oracle_publication.build_id IS NOT NULL))));
END

statements: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_validation(p_task bigint, p_key text, p_digest text) RETURNS SETOF ops.pdf_build_validation LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' BEGIN ATOMIC SELECT ops.pdf_build_validation.build_id, ops.pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest, ops.pdf_build_validation.logical_digest, ops.pdf_build_validation.contract_digest, ops.pdf_build_validation.native_callbacks, ops.pdf_build_validation.native_contract_digest, ops.pdf_build_validation.certification_basis, ops.pdf_build_validation.lowering_identity, ops.pdf_build_validation.attested_logical_digest, ops.pdf_build_validation.native_document_digest, ops.pdf_build_validation.oracle_receipt_id FROM ops.pdf_published_revision INNER JOIN ops.pdf_stage_build ON ops.pdf_stage_build.build_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.build_id AND ops.pdf_stage_build.task_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.task_id AND ops.pdf_stage_build.release_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.release_id AND ops.pdf_stage_build.source_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.source_digest AND ops.pdf_stage_build.schema_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.schema_digest AND ops.pdf_stage_build.recipe_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.recipe_digest INNER JOIN ops.pdf_frozen_build ON ops.pdf_frozen_build.build_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.build_id AND ops.pdf_frozen_build.frozen_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest AND ops.pdf_frozen_build.kind = ops.pdf_published_revision.kind INNER JOIN ops.pdf_product ON ops.pdf_product.task_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.task_id AND ops.pdf_product.product_key = ops.pdf_published_revision.product_key AND ops.pdf_product.content_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.logical_digest AND ops.pdf_product.release_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.release_id AND ops.pdf_product.artifact_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.source_digest AND ops.pdf_product.kind = ops.pdf_published_revision.kind INNER JOIN ops.pdf_build_validation ON ops.pdf_build_validation.build_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.build_id AND ops.pdf_build_validation.frozen_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest AND ops.pdf_build_validation.logical_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.logical_digest AND ops.pdf_build_validation.contract_digest = ops.pdf_product.contract_digest INNER JOIN ops.pdf_producer_certification ON ops.pdf_producer_certification.build_id = ops.pdf_build_validation.build_id AND ops.pdf_producer_certification.lowering_identity = ops.pdf_build_validation.lowering_identity AND ops.pdf_producer_certification.logical_digest = ops.pdf_build_validation.attested_logical_digest AND ops.pdf_producer_certification.logical_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.logical_digest AND ops.pdf_producer_certification.native_document_digest = ops.pdf_build_validation.native_document_digest AND ops.pdf_producer_certification.kind = ops.pdf_published_revision.kind INNER JOIN ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle ON ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.oracle_receipt_id = ops.pdf_build_validation.oracle_receipt_id AND ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.lowering_identity = ops.pdf_build_validation.lowering_identity AND ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.kind = ops.pdf_published_revision.kind LEFT JOIN ops.pdf_published_revision AS oracle_publication ON oracle_publication.build_id = ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.build_id AND oracle_publication.frozen_digest = ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.frozen_digest AND oracle_publication.logical_digest = ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.logical_digest AND oracle_publication.kind = ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.kind WHERE ops.pdf_published_revision.task_id = p_task AND ops.pdf_published_revision.product_key = p_key AND ops.pdf_published_revision.logical_digest = p_digest AND ops.pdf_stage_build.state = 'published' AND ops.pdf_build_validation.native_callbacks IS TRUE AND ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.state = 'passed' AND ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.actual_native_digest = ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.native_document_digest AND ((ops.pdf_build_validation.certification_basis = 'round-trip-verified' AND ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.build_id = ops.pdf_published_revision.build_id AND ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.frozen_digest = ops.pdf_published_revision.frozen_digest AND ops.pdf_roundtrip_oracle.native_document_digest = ops.pdf_producer_certification.native_document_digest) OR (ops.pdf_build_validation.certification_basis = 'producer-certified' AND oracle_publication.build_id IS NOT NULL)); END
