BEGIN
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS n ON n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.native_address = a.pointer 
WHERE a.product_id = p_build AND (a.revision_id != p_build OR n.record_id IS NULL OR (a.native_json ->> 'self_ref') IS DISTINCT FROM a.pointer OR a.label IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce((a.native_json ->> 'label'), 'unspecified') OR a.content_layer IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce((a.native_json ->> 'content_layer'), 'body') OR a.text IS DISTINCT FROM (a.native_json ->> 'text') OR a.parent_pointer IS DISTINCT FROM ((a.native_json['parent']) ->> '$ref')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native access fields do not correspond to frozen native item', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE projected(record_id, value) AS (SELECT n.record_id AS record_id, a.native_json AS value FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS a INNER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS n ON n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.native_address = a.pointer WHERE a.product_id = p_build AND a.revision_id = p_build UNION ALL SELECT child.record_id AS record_id, child.value AS value FROM projected INNER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS n ON n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.record_id = projected.record_id INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f.value ->> 'target' AS record_id, (projected.value)[f.key] AS value FROM LATERAL jsonb_each((n.structure_json)['fields']) AS f WHERE f.value ->> 'kind' = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT m.record_id AS record_id, CASE WHEN f.value ->> 'kind' = 'map' THEN (container.value)[COALESCE(m.member_key, ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build, m.member_key_stream_id) #>> CAST(ARRAY[] AS text[]))] ELSE (container.value)[CAST(m.ordinal AS integer)] END AS value FROM LATERAL jsonb_each((n.structure_json)['fields']) AS f INNER JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership AS m ON m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build AND m.parent_id = projected.record_id AND m.field_name = f.key INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type = 'NativeArray' AND f.key = 'items' THEN projected.value ELSE (projected.value)[f.key] END AS value) AS container ON TRUE WHERE f.value ->> 'kind' IN ('array', 'map') AND m.value_kind = 'record') AS child ON TRUE) CYCLE record_id SET cycle_ USING path_ SELECT 1 FROM projected AS w LEFT JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS n ON n.product_id = p_build AND n.revision_id = p_build AND n.record_id = w.record_id WHERE w.cycle_ OR n.record_id IS NULL OR w.value IS NULL OR (n.native_type = 'NativeArray' AND jsonb_typeof(w.value) <> 'array') OR (n.native_type <> 'NativeArray' AND (jsonb_typeof(w.value) <> 'object' OR CASE WHEN n.structure_json ? 'extensions' THEN ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build, (n.structure_json)['extensions'] ->> 'stream_id', w.value - (SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(field_keys.jsonb_object_keys_1), CAST(ARRAY[] AS text[])) AS coalesce_1 FROM (SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) AS jsonb_object_keys_1 UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys((n.structure_json)['fields']) AS jsonb_object_keys_2) AS field_keys)) IS NOT TRUE ELSE w.value - (SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(field_keys.jsonb_object_keys_1), CAST(ARRAY[] AS text[])) AS coalesce_1 FROM (SELECT jsonb_object_keys(n.scalars_json) AS jsonb_object_keys_1 UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys((n.structure_json)['fields']) AS jsonb_object_keys_2) AS field_keys) <> CAST('{}' AS jsonb) END)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LATERAL jsonb_each(n.scalars_json) AS s WHERE ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches((w.value)[s.key], s.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LATERAL jsonb_each((n.structure_json)['fields']) AS f INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN n.native_type = 'NativeArray' AND f.key = 'items' THEN w.value ELSE (w.value)[f.key] END AS value) AS container ON TRUE WHERE container.value IS NULL OR (f.value ->> 'kind' = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(container.value) <> 'object') OR (f.value ->> 'kind' = 'parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build, f.value ->> 'stream_id', container.value) IS NOT TRUE) OR (f.value ->> 'kind' = 'array' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value) <> 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(container.value) <> CAST(f.value ->> 'length' AS bigint))) OR (f.value ->> 'kind' = 'map' AND (jsonb_typeof(container.value) <> 'object' OR (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(container.value) AS anon_1 (value)) <> CAST(f.value ->> 'length' AS bigint))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN f.value ->> 'kind' = 'map' THEN (container.value)[COALESCE(m.member_key, ops.pdf_projection_stream_value(p_build, m.member_key_stream_id) #>> CAST(ARRAY[] AS text[]))] ELSE (container.value)[CAST(m.ordinal AS integer)] END AS value) AS actual ON TRUE WHERE m.product_id = p_build AND m.revision_id = p_build AND m.parent_id = w.record_id AND m.field_name = f.key AND (actual.value IS NULL OR (m.value_kind = 'scalar' AND ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(actual.value, m.scalar_json) IS NOT TRUE) OR (m.value_kind = 'parts' AND ops.pdf_projection_stream_matches(p_build, m.stream_id, actual.value) IS NOT TRUE)))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native access JSON differs from frozen record fields/members/scalars', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE scoped AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT a.pointer AS pointer, a.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, a.label AS label, a.section_pointer AS section_pointer 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS a 
WHERE a.product_id = p_build AND a.revision_id = p_build), 
section_owners(pointer, owner) AS 
(SELECT root.pointer AS pointer, CASE WHEN (root.label IN ('section', 'chapter')) THEN root.pointer END AS owner 
FROM scoped AS root 
WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS parent 
WHERE parent.product_id = p_build AND parent.revision_id = p_build AND parent.pointer = root.parent_pointer)) UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer AS pointer, CASE WHEN (child.label IN ('section', 'chapter')) THEN child.pointer ELSE section_owners.owner END AS anon_1 
FROM section_owners JOIN scoped AS child ON child.parent_pointer = section_owners.pointer)
 SELECT scoped.pointer, scoped.section_pointer 
FROM scoped EXCEPT ALL SELECT section_owners.pointer, section_owners.owner 
FROM section_owners)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native access section owner differs from native ancestry', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT target.scalars_json ->> 'self_ref' AS pointer, CAST(ARRAY[CASE WHEN root_field.key = 'body' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END] AS bigint[]) AS path FROM ops.pdf_record_document AS h INNER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS root ON root.product_id = p_build AND root.revision_id = p_build AND root.record_id = h.root_id INNER JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each((root.structure_json)['fields']) AS root_field ON TRUE INNER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS target ON target.product_id = p_build AND target.revision_id = p_build AND target.record_id = root_field.value ->> 'target' WHERE h.product_id = p_build AND h.revision_id = p_build AND root_field.key IN ('body', 'furniture')), traversal(pointer, path) AS (SELECT roots.pointer AS pointer, roots.path AS path FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT child.value ->> '$ref' AS anon_1, traversal.path || CAST(ARRAY[child.ordinality - 1] AS bigint[]) AS anon_2 FROM traversal INNER JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS a ON a.product_id = p_build AND a.revision_id = p_build AND a.pointer = traversal.pointer INNER JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE((a.native_json)['children'], CAST('[]' AS jsonb))) WITH ORDINALITY AS child (value, ordinality) ON TRUE) CYCLE pointer SET cycle_ USING cycle_path_ SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT a.pointer AS pointer, a.ordinal AS ordinal, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.pointer IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.path, a.pointer COLLATE "C") - 1 AS expected, t.cycle_ AS cycle_ FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS a LEFT JOIN traversal AS t ON a.pointer = t.pointer WHERE a.product_id = p_build AND a.revision_id = p_build) AS ordered WHERE ordered.ordinal <> ordered.expected OR ordered.cycle_)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native access order differs from native containment traversal', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF ((EXISTS (WITH region_counts AS 
(SELECT r.pointer AS pointer, count(*) AS count_ 
FROM kb.pdf_record_region AS r 
WHERE r.product_id = p_build AND r.revision_id = p_build GROUP BY r.pointer)
 SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN region_counts ON region_counts.pointer = a.pointer 
WHERE a.product_id = p_build AND a.revision_id = p_build AND coalesce(region_counts.count_, 0) != jsonb_array_length(coalesce(a.native_json['prov'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))))) OR (EXISTS (WITH region_counts AS 
(SELECT r.pointer AS pointer, count(*) AS count_ 
FROM kb.pdf_record_region AS r 
WHERE r.product_id = p_build AND r.revision_id = p_build GROUP BY r.pointer), 
page_sizes AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT pages.member_key AS member_key, page_size.scalars_json AS dimensions 
FROM ops.pdf_record_document AS h JOIN kb.pdf_record_membership AS pages ON pages.product_id = p_build AND pages.revision_id = p_build AND pages.parent_id = h.root_id AND pages.field_name = 'pages' LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS page ON page.product_id = p_build AND page.revision_id = p_build AND page.record_id = pages.record_id LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS page_size ON page_size.product_id = p_build AND page_size.revision_id = p_build AND page_size.record_id = ((page.structure_json['fields']['size']) ->> 'target') 
WHERE h.product_id = p_build AND h.revision_id = p_build)
 SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_region AS r LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.pdf_record_access AS a ON a.product_id = p_build AND a.revision_id = p_build AND a.pointer = r.pointer LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.native_json['prov'][CAST(r.region_index AS INTEGER)] AS value) AS prov ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN page_sizes ON page_sizes.member_key = CAST(r.page_no AS TEXT) 
WHERE r.product_id = p_build AND (r.revision_id != p_build OR a.pointer IS NULL OR prov.value IS NULL OR CAST((prov.value ->> 'page_no') AS BIGINT) IS DISTINCT FROM r.page_no OR ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_width), page_sizes.dimensions['width']) IS NOT true OR ops.pdf_projection_scalar_matches(to_jsonb(r.page_height), page_sizes.dimensions['height']) IS NOT true OR to_jsonb(r."left") IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value['bbox']['l'] OR to_jsonb(r.top) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value['bbox']['t'] OR to_jsonb(r."right") IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value['bbox']['r'] OR to_jsonb(r.bottom) IS DISTINCT FROM prov.value['bbox']['b'] OR r.origin IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN (((prov.value['bbox']) ->> 'coord_origin') = 'TOPLEFT') THEN 'top_left' WHEN (((prov.value['bbox']) ->> 'coord_origin') = 'BOTTOMLEFT') THEN 'bottom_left' END)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native access regions differ from native provenance/pages', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
END

DECLARE
 revision ops.pdf_published_revision%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF (p_section IS NULL OR p_membership IS DISTINCT FROM 'descendants' OR p_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'section-source-context-v1') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid selected source selector/policy', ERRCODE = '22023';
 END IF;
 SELECT pinned.* 
FROM ops.require_published_companion_pin(p_project, p_demand, p_read, p_use, p_product, p_derivation) AS pinned INTO STRICT revision;
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = revision.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = revision.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_access.pointer = p_section AND kb.pdf_record_access.label IN ('section', 'chapter')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'selected source root is not a published section', ERRCODE = '22023';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(revision.task_id, revision.product_key, revision.logical_digest) AS anon_1), 
access AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT a.product_id AS product_id, a.revision_id AS revision_id, a.pointer AS pointer, a.ordinal AS ordinal, a.label AS label, a.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, a.section_pointer AS section_pointer, a.content_layer AS content_layer, a.text AS text, a.native_json AS native_json 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS a JOIN published ON a.product_id = published.build_id AND a.revision_id = published.build_id), 
subtree(pointer) AS 
(SELECT access.pointer AS pointer 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer = p_section UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer AS pointer 
FROM access AS child JOIN subtree ON child.parent_pointer = subtree.pointer), 
selected AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT access.product_id AS product_id, access.revision_id AS revision_id, access.pointer AS pointer, access.ordinal AS ordinal, access.label AS label, access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, access.section_pointer AS section_pointer, access.content_layer AS content_layer, access.text AS text, access.native_json AS native_json 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer IN (SELECT subtree.pointer 
FROM subtree)), 
contained(record_id) AS 
(SELECT n.record_id AS record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN published ON n.product_id = published.build_id AND n.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN selected ON selected.pointer = n.native_address UNION SELECT child.record_id AS record_id 
FROM contained JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS contained_native ON contained_native.record_id = contained.record_id JOIN published ON contained_native.product_id = published.build_id AND contained_native.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (f.value ->> 'target') AS record_id 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_each(contained_native.structure_json['fields']) AS f 
WHERE (f.value ->> 'kind') = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT m.record_id AS record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = published.build_id AND m.revision_id = published.build_id AND m.parent_id = contained_native.record_id AND m.value_kind = 'record') AS child ON true), 
nodes AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_native.record_id AS record_id, kb.pdf_record_native.native_type AS native_type, kb.pdf_record_native.native_address AS native_address, kb.pdf_record_native.scalars_json AS scalars_json, kb.pdf_record_native.structure_json AS structure_json 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_native.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_native.record_id IN (SELECT contained.record_id 
FROM contained)), 
fields AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT field_rows.record_id AS record_id, field_rows.name AS name, field_rows.value AS value, field_rows.kind AS kind, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY field_rows.record_id ORDER BY field_rows.name COLLATE "C") - 1 AS slot 
FROM (SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, scalar_field.key AS name, scalar_field.value AS value, 'scalar' AS kind 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(nodes.scalars_json) AS scalar_field ON true UNION ALL SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, object_field.key AS key, object_field.value AS value, object_field.value ->> 'kind' AS anon_3 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(nodes.structure_json['fields']) AS object_field ON true) AS field_rows), 
members AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_membership.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.parent_id AS parent_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.field_name AS field_name, kb.pdf_record_membership.ordinal AS ordinal, kb.pdf_record_membership.member_key AS member_key, kb.pdf_record_membership.member_key_stream_id AS member_key_stream_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.value_kind AS value_kind, kb.pdf_record_membership.record_id AS record_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.scalar_json AS scalar_json, kb.pdf_record_membership.stream_id AS stream_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_membership.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_membership.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_membership.parent_id IN (SELECT nodes.record_id 
FROM nodes)), 
edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT fields.record_id AS parent_id, fields.value ->> 'target' AS child_id, ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1] AS suffix 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.kind = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT members.parent_id AS parent_id, members.record_id AS record_id, ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 1] AS anon_4 
FROM members JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = members.parent_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE members.value_kind = 'record'), 
walk(record_id, path) AS 
(SELECT roots.record_id AS record_id, CAST(roots.path AS BIGINT[]) AS path 
FROM (SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, ARRAY[CAST(selected.ordinal AS BIGINT)] AS path 
FROM nodes JOIN selected ON nodes.native_address = selected.pointer) AS roots UNION ALL SELECT edges.child_id AS child_id, walk.path || edges.suffix AS anon_2 
FROM walk JOIN edges ON edges.parent_id = walk.record_id), 
events AS 
(SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '{' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN (fields.slot > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CAST(to_jsonb(fields.name) AS TEXT) || ':' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN fields.value ELSE to_jsonb(fields.value ->> 'stream_id') END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '{' ELSE '[' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 0] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN to_jsonb(members.member_key_stream_id) ELSE to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN CAST(to_jsonb(members.member_key) AS TEXT) || ':' ELSE '' END) END AS value, CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN members.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(members.stream_id) END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE members.value_kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '}' ELSE ']' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, (SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id), 0] AS path, 'extension' AS kind, nodes.structure_json['extensions']['stream_id'] AS value, CASE WHEN ((SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id) > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE nodes.structure_json ? 'extensions' UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '}' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id), 
ancestors(pointer) AS 
(SELECT access.parent_pointer AS pointer 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer = p_section AND access.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT ancestor_access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer 
FROM access AS ancestor_access JOIN ancestors ON ancestor_access.pointer = ancestors.pointer 
WHERE ancestor_access.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL), 
selected_context AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_5.family AS family, anon_5.local_id AS local_id, anon_5.ordinal AS ordinal, anon_5.body AS body 
FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(revision.task_id, revision.product_key, revision.logical_digest, (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(selected.pointer), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_1 
FROM selected), p_section) AS anon_5), 
selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT c.product_id AS product_id, c.revision_id AS revision_id, c.family AS family, c.local_id AS local_id, c.body AS body, c.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c JOIN published ON c.product_id = published.build_id AND c.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE c.family = 'native_metadata' AND CASE c.body ->> 'kind' WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN (c.body ->> 'pointer') IN (SELECT selected.pointer 
FROM selected) WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN (((ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id, c.revision_id, c.family, c.local_id, c.body))['value']) ->> 'section_pointer') IN (SELECT selected.pointer 
FROM selected UNION SELECT ancestors.pointer 
FROM ancestors) ELSE false END), 
companion AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_context.family AS family, selected_context.local_id AS local_id, selected_context.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(selected_context.body AS TEXT) AS payload 
FROM selected_context UNION ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS TEXT) AS payload 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'health' UNION ALL SELECT selected_metadata.family AS family, selected_metadata.local_id AS local_id, selected_metadata.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(selected_metadata.body AS TEXT) AS payload 
FROM selected_metadata UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint' AS anon_6, (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id || ':') || CAST(kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal AS TEXT) AS anon_7, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(jsonb_build_object('relation_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id, 'endpoint_ordinal', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal, 'role', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.role, 'target_task_id', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.task_id ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id END, 'target_product_key', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.product_key ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key END, 'target_content_digest', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.logical_digest ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest END, 'occurrence_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id) AS TEXT) AS jsonb_build_object_1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id IN (SELECT selected_context.local_id 
FROM selected_context 
WHERE selected_context.family = 'relation')), 
companion_order AS 
(SELECT companion.family AS family, companion.local_id AS local_id, companion.ordinal AS ordinal, companion.payload AS payload, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY companion.family COLLATE "C", companion.ordinal, companion.local_id COLLATE "C") AS position 
FROM companion), 
metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_metadata.product_id AS product_id, selected_metadata.revision_id AS revision_id, selected_metadata.family AS family, selected_metadata.local_id AS local_id, selected_metadata.body AS body, selected_metadata.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM selected_metadata), 
metadata_fields AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion_field.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.field_name AS field_name, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.stream_id AS stream_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.scalar_kind AS scalar_kind, metadata_companions.ordinal AS row_ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field JOIN metadata_companions ON kb.pdf_record_companion_field.product_id = metadata_companions.product_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion_field.revision_id = metadata_companions.revision_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion_field.family = metadata_companions.family AND kb.pdf_record_companion_field.local_id = metadata_companions.local_id), 
metadata_events AS 
(SELECT metadata_companions.ordinal AS ordinal, metadata_companions.local_id AS local_id, 0 AS phase, '' AS field_name, 0 AS subphase, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS part_ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'row', 'body', metadata_companions.body) AS event 
FROM metadata_companions UNION ALL SELECT metadata_fields.row_ordinal AS row_ordinal, metadata_fields.local_id AS local_id, 1 AS anon_9, metadata_fields.field_name AS field_name, 0 AS anon_10, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS anon_11, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'field', 'field', to_jsonb(pdf_artifact_stream) || jsonb_build_object('field_name', metadata_fields.field_name, 'scalar_kind', metadata_fields.scalar_kind)) AS jsonb_build_object_2 
FROM metadata_fields JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream ON metadata_fields.product_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.product_id AND metadata_fields.revision_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.revision_id AND metadata_fields.stream_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.stream_id UNION ALL SELECT metadata_fields.row_ordinal AS row_ordinal, metadata_fields.local_id AS local_id, 1 AS anon_12, metadata_fields.field_name AS field_name, 1 AS anon_13, metadata_part.ordinal AS ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'part', 'part', to_jsonb(metadata_part)) AS jsonb_build_object_3 
FROM metadata_fields JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_artifact_parts(metadata_fields.product_id, metadata_fields.revision_id, false, ARRAY[CAST(metadata_fields.stream_id AS TEXT)]) AS metadata_part ON metadata_fields.product_id = metadata_part.product_id AND metadata_fields.revision_id = metadata_part.revision_id AND metadata_fields.stream_id = metadata_part.stream_id UNION ALL SELECT metadata_companions.ordinal AS ordinal, metadata_companions.local_id AS local_id, 2 AS phase, '' AS field_name, 0 AS subphase, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS part_ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'close') AS event 
FROM metadata_companions), 
external AS 
(SELECT jsonb_build_object('from_pointer', selected.pointer, 'field', kb.pdf_record_reference.field_name, 'reference_id', kb.pdf_record_reference.reference_id, 'source_id', kb.pdf_record_reference.source_id, 'native_address', origin.native_address, 'source_ordinal', selected.ordinal, 'source_order', to_jsonb(walk.path), 'target', jsonb_build_object('task_id', revision.task_id, 'product_key', revision.product_key, 'content_digest', revision.logical_digest) || CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_reference.field_name IN ('source_cell_id', 'target_cell_id')) THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space', 'native_graph_cell', 'cell_id_lexical', kb.pdf_record_reference.native_pointer) ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space', 'native_item', 'pointer', kb.pdf_record_reference.native_pointer) END, 'resolution', 'qualified_external') AS body 
FROM selected JOIN walk ON walk.path[1] = selected.ordinal JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference ON kb.pdf_record_reference.source_id = walk.record_id JOIN nodes AS origin ON origin.record_id = kb.pdf_record_reference.source_id JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_reference.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_reference.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_reference.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM nodes AS target 
WHERE target.record_id = kb.pdf_record_reference.target_id)) UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id, 'endpoint_ordinal', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal, 'role', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.role, 'target', jsonb_build_object('task_id', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.task_id ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id END, 'product_key', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.product_key ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key END, 'content_digest', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.logical_digest ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest END, 'occurrence_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id), 'resolution', 'qualified_external') AS jsonb_build_object_4 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id IN (SELECT companion.local_id 
FROM companion 
WHERE companion.family = 'relation') AND ((kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest) NOT IN ((revision.task_id, revision.product_key, revision.logical_digest), (0, '@self', '@self'))) AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id IN (SELECT companion.local_id 
FROM companion 
WHERE companion.family = 'occurrence'))
 SELECT output.event 
FROM (SELECT -1 AS phase, ARRAY[]::BIGINT[] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'selection_metadata', 'selected_count', (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM selected), 'membership_sha256', (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(((((selected.pointer || chr(9)) || CAST(selected.ordinal AS TEXT)) || chr(9)) || coalesce(selected.parent_pointer, '')) || chr(10), '' ORDER BY selected.ordinal), ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS encode_1 
FROM selected)) AS event UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(selected.ordinal AS BIGINT), CAST(-1 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'record_start', 'pointer', selected.pointer, 'record_id', nodes.record_id, 'ordinal', selected.ordinal, 'parent_pointer', selected.parent_pointer, 'section_pointer', selected.section_pointer, 'label', selected.label, 'role', 'selected') AS event 
FROM selected JOIN nodes ON selected.pointer = nodes.native_address UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS phase, events.path AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'native_fragment', 'native', jsonb_build_object('kind', events.kind, 'value', events.value, 'prefix', events.prefix)) AS event 
FROM events UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(selected.ordinal AS BIGINT), CAST(3 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'record_end', 'pointer', selected.pointer) AS event 
FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(access.ordinal AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'context', 'kind', 'ancestor', 'pointer', access.pointer, 'ordinal', access.ordinal, 'parent_pointer', access.parent_pointer, 'label', access.label, 'name', access.native_json['name']) AS event 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer IN (SELECT ancestors.pointer 
FROM ancestors) UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r.pointer, r.region_index) AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'context', 'kind', 'frame', 'body', (to_jsonb(r) - 'product_id') - 'revision_id') AS event 
FROM kb.pdf_record_region AS r JOIN published ON r.product_id = published.build_id AND r.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE r.pointer IN (SELECT selected.pointer 
FROM selected) UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(0 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', CASE WHEN (companion_order.family != 'native_metadata') THEN 'companion_start' ELSE 'companion_native_start' END, 'family', companion_order.family, 'local_id', companion_order.local_id, 'ordinal', companion_order.ordinal) AS event 
FROM companion_order UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(1 AS BIGINT), CAST(anon_8.part AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'scalar_part', 'part', anon_8.part, 'encoding', 'base64', 'value', encode(substr(convert_to(companion_order.payload, 'UTF8'), CAST(anon_8.part * 32768 + 1 AS INTEGER), 32768), 'base64'), 'final', (anon_8.part + 1) * 32768 >= octet_length(companion_order.payload)) AS event 
FROM companion_order JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0, CAST(octet_length(companion_order.payload) - 1 AS INTEGER) / 32768) AS anon_8(part) ON true 
WHERE companion_order.family != 'native_metadata' UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(2 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'companion_end', 'byte_length', octet_length(companion_order.payload), 'sha256', encode(sha256(convert_to(companion_order.payload, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) AS event 
FROM companion_order 
WHERE companion_order.family != 'native_metadata' UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(1 AS BIGINT), CAST(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY companion_order.position ORDER BY metadata_events.phase, metadata_events.field_name COLLATE "C", metadata_events.subphase, metadata_events.part_ordinal) AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'companion_native_fragment', 'fragment', metadata_events.event) AS event 
FROM metadata_events JOIN companion_order ON companion_order.family = 'native_metadata' AND metadata_events.local_id = companion_order.local_id UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(2 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'companion_native_end') AS event 
FROM companion_order 
WHERE companion_order.family = 'native_metadata' UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(external.body AS TEXT)) AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'outside_reference', 'body', external.body) AS event 
FROM external) AS output ORDER BY output.phase, output.path;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_selected_source_events(p_project text, p_demand text, p_read text, p_use text, p_product text, p_derivation text, p_section text, p_membership text, p_policy text) RETURNS SETOF jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$DECLARE
 revision ops.pdf_published_revision%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF (p_section IS NULL OR p_membership IS DISTINCT FROM 'descendants' OR p_policy IS DISTINCT FROM 'section-source-context-v1') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid selected source selector/policy', ERRCODE = '22023';
 END IF;
 SELECT pinned.* 
FROM ops.require_published_companion_pin(p_project, p_demand, p_read, p_use, p_product, p_derivation) AS pinned INTO STRICT revision;
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_access.product_id = revision.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_access.revision_id = revision.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_access.pointer = p_section AND kb.pdf_record_access.label IN ('section', 'chapter')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'selected source root is not a published section', ERRCODE = '22023';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH RECURSIVE published AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_1.build_id AS build_id 
FROM ops.read_pdf_published_revision(revision.task_id, revision.product_key, revision.logical_digest) AS anon_1), 
access AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT a.product_id AS product_id, a.revision_id AS revision_id, a.pointer AS pointer, a.ordinal AS ordinal, a.label AS label, a.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, a.section_pointer AS section_pointer, a.content_layer AS content_layer, a.text AS text, a.native_json AS native_json 
FROM kb.pdf_record_access AS a JOIN published ON a.product_id = published.build_id AND a.revision_id = published.build_id), 
subtree(pointer) AS 
(SELECT access.pointer AS pointer 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer = p_section UNION ALL SELECT child.pointer AS pointer 
FROM access AS child JOIN subtree ON child.parent_pointer = subtree.pointer), 
selected AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT access.product_id AS product_id, access.revision_id AS revision_id, access.pointer AS pointer, access.ordinal AS ordinal, access.label AS label, access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer, access.section_pointer AS section_pointer, access.content_layer AS content_layer, access.text AS text, access.native_json AS native_json 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer IN (SELECT subtree.pointer 
FROM subtree)), 
contained(record_id) AS 
(SELECT n.record_id AS record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native AS n JOIN published ON n.product_id = published.build_id AND n.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN selected ON selected.pointer = n.native_address UNION SELECT child.record_id AS record_id 
FROM contained JOIN kb.pdf_record_native AS contained_native ON contained_native.record_id = contained.record_id JOIN published ON contained_native.product_id = published.build_id AND contained_native.revision_id = published.build_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (f.value ->> 'target') AS record_id 
FROM LATERAL jsonb_each(contained_native.structure_json['fields']) AS f 
WHERE (f.value ->> 'kind') = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT m.record_id AS record_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership AS m 
WHERE m.product_id = published.build_id AND m.revision_id = published.build_id AND m.parent_id = contained_native.record_id AND m.value_kind = 'record') AS child ON true), 
nodes AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_native.record_id AS record_id, kb.pdf_record_native.native_type AS native_type, kb.pdf_record_native.native_address AS native_address, kb.pdf_record_native.scalars_json AS scalars_json, kb.pdf_record_native.structure_json AS structure_json 
FROM kb.pdf_record_native JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_native.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_native.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_native.record_id IN (SELECT contained.record_id 
FROM contained)), 
fields AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT field_rows.record_id AS record_id, field_rows.name AS name, field_rows.value AS value, field_rows.kind AS kind, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY field_rows.record_id ORDER BY field_rows.name COLLATE "C") - 1 AS slot 
FROM (SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, scalar_field.key AS name, scalar_field.value AS value, 'scalar' AS kind 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(nodes.scalars_json) AS scalar_field ON true UNION ALL SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, object_field.key AS key, object_field.value AS value, object_field.value ->> 'kind' AS anon_3 
FROM nodes JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(nodes.structure_json['fields']) AS object_field ON true) AS field_rows), 
members AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_membership.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.parent_id AS parent_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.field_name AS field_name, kb.pdf_record_membership.ordinal AS ordinal, kb.pdf_record_membership.member_key AS member_key, kb.pdf_record_membership.member_key_stream_id AS member_key_stream_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.value_kind AS value_kind, kb.pdf_record_membership.record_id AS record_id, kb.pdf_record_membership.scalar_json AS scalar_json, kb.pdf_record_membership.stream_id AS stream_id 
FROM kb.pdf_record_membership JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_membership.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_membership.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_membership.parent_id IN (SELECT nodes.record_id 
FROM nodes)), 
edges AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT fields.record_id AS parent_id, fields.value ->> 'target' AS child_id, ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1] AS suffix 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.kind = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT members.parent_id AS parent_id, members.record_id AS record_id, ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 1] AS anon_4 
FROM members JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = members.parent_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE members.value_kind = 'record'), 
walk(record_id, path) AS 
(SELECT roots.record_id AS record_id, CAST(roots.path AS BIGINT[]) AS path 
FROM (SELECT nodes.record_id AS record_id, ARRAY[CAST(selected.ordinal AS BIGINT)] AS path 
FROM nodes JOIN selected ON nodes.native_address = selected.pointer) AS roots UNION ALL SELECT edges.child_id AS child_id, walk.path || edges.suffix AS anon_2 
FROM walk JOIN edges ON edges.parent_id = walk.record_id), 
events AS 
(SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '{' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE CASE WHEN (fields.slot > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CAST(to_jsonb(fields.name) AS TEXT) || ':' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'scalar') THEN fields.value ELSE to_jsonb(fields.value ->> 'stream_id') END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 0] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '{' ELSE '[' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 0] AS path, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN 'key_parts' ELSE 'literal' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map' AND members.member_key IS NULL) THEN to_jsonb(members.member_key_stream_id) ELSE to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN CAST(to_jsonb(members.member_key) AS TEXT) || ':' ELSE '' END) END AS value, CASE WHEN (members.ordinal > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 1, members.ordinal, 1] AS path, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN 'inline' ELSE 'parts' END AS kind, CASE WHEN (members.value_kind = 'scalar') THEN members.scalar_json ELSE to_jsonb(members.stream_id) END AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id JOIN members ON members.parent_id = fields.record_id AND members.field_name = fields.name 
WHERE members.value_kind IN ('scalar', 'parts') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, fields.slot, 1, 2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (fields.kind = 'map') THEN '}' ELSE ']' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN fields ON fields.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE fields.kind IN ('array', 'map') UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[1, (SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id), 0] AS path, 'extension' AS kind, nodes.structure_json['extensions']['stream_id'] AS value, CASE WHEN ((SELECT count(*) AS count_2 
FROM fields 
WHERE fields.record_id = nodes.record_id) > 0) THEN ',' ELSE '' END AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id 
WHERE nodes.structure_json ? 'extensions' UNION ALL SELECT walk.path || ARRAY[2] AS path, 'literal' AS kind, to_jsonb(CASE WHEN (nodes.native_type = 'NativeArray') THEN '' ELSE '}' END) AS value, '' AS prefix 
FROM walk JOIN nodes ON nodes.record_id = walk.record_id), 
ancestors(pointer) AS 
(SELECT access.parent_pointer AS pointer 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer = p_section AND access.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT ancestor_access.parent_pointer AS parent_pointer 
FROM access AS ancestor_access JOIN ancestors ON ancestor_access.pointer = ancestors.pointer 
WHERE ancestor_access.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL), 
selected_context AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_5.family AS family, anon_5.local_id AS local_id, anon_5.ordinal AS ordinal, anon_5.body AS body 
FROM ops.pdf_record_context_rows(revision.task_id, revision.product_key, revision.logical_digest, (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(selected.pointer), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_1 
FROM selected), p_section) AS anon_5), 
selected_metadata AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT c.product_id AS product_id, c.revision_id AS revision_id, c.family AS family, c.local_id AS local_id, c.body AS body, c.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion AS c JOIN published ON c.product_id = published.build_id AND c.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE c.family = 'native_metadata' AND CASE c.body ->> 'kind' WHEN 'formula_outcomes' THEN (c.body ->> 'pointer') IN (SELECT selected.pointer 
FROM selected) WHEN 'recognition_coverage' THEN (((ops.pdf_companion_body(c.product_id, c.revision_id, c.family, c.local_id, c.body))['value']) ->> 'section_pointer') IN (SELECT selected.pointer 
FROM selected UNION SELECT ancestors.pointer 
FROM ancestors) ELSE false END), 
companion AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_context.family AS family, selected_context.local_id AS local_id, selected_context.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(selected_context.body AS TEXT) AS payload 
FROM selected_context UNION ALL SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(kb.pdf_record_companion.body AS TEXT) AS payload 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_companion.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_companion.family = 'health' UNION ALL SELECT selected_metadata.family AS family, selected_metadata.local_id AS local_id, selected_metadata.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(selected_metadata.body AS TEXT) AS payload 
FROM selected_metadata UNION ALL SELECT 'endpoint' AS anon_6, (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id || ':') || CAST(kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal AS TEXT) AS anon_7, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal AS ordinal, CAST(jsonb_build_object('relation_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id, 'endpoint_ordinal', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal, 'role', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.role, 'target_task_id', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.task_id ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id END, 'target_product_key', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.product_key ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key END, 'target_content_digest', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.logical_digest ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest END, 'occurrence_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id) AS TEXT) AS jsonb_build_object_1 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id IN (SELECT selected_context.local_id 
FROM selected_context 
WHERE selected_context.family = 'relation')), 
companion_order AS 
(SELECT companion.family AS family, companion.local_id AS local_id, companion.ordinal AS ordinal, companion.payload AS payload, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY companion.family COLLATE "C", companion.ordinal, companion.local_id COLLATE "C") AS position 
FROM companion), 
metadata_companions AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT selected_metadata.product_id AS product_id, selected_metadata.revision_id AS revision_id, selected_metadata.family AS family, selected_metadata.local_id AS local_id, selected_metadata.body AS body, selected_metadata.ordinal AS ordinal 
FROM selected_metadata), 
metadata_fields AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT kb.pdf_record_companion_field.product_id AS product_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.revision_id AS revision_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.family AS family, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.local_id AS local_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.field_name AS field_name, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.stream_id AS stream_id, kb.pdf_record_companion_field.scalar_kind AS scalar_kind, metadata_companions.ordinal AS row_ordinal 
FROM kb.pdf_record_companion_field JOIN metadata_companions ON kb.pdf_record_companion_field.product_id = metadata_companions.product_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion_field.revision_id = metadata_companions.revision_id AND kb.pdf_record_companion_field.family = metadata_companions.family AND kb.pdf_record_companion_field.local_id = metadata_companions.local_id), 
metadata_events AS 
(SELECT metadata_companions.ordinal AS ordinal, metadata_companions.local_id AS local_id, 0 AS phase, '' AS field_name, 0 AS subphase, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS part_ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'row', 'body', metadata_companions.body) AS event 
FROM metadata_companions UNION ALL SELECT metadata_fields.row_ordinal AS row_ordinal, metadata_fields.local_id AS local_id, 1 AS anon_9, metadata_fields.field_name AS field_name, 0 AS anon_10, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS anon_11, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'field', 'field', to_jsonb(pdf_artifact_stream) || jsonb_build_object('field_name', metadata_fields.field_name, 'scalar_kind', metadata_fields.scalar_kind)) AS jsonb_build_object_2 
FROM metadata_fields JOIN ops.pdf_artifact_stream ON metadata_fields.product_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.product_id AND metadata_fields.revision_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.revision_id AND metadata_fields.stream_id = ops.pdf_artifact_stream.stream_id UNION ALL SELECT metadata_fields.row_ordinal AS row_ordinal, metadata_fields.local_id AS local_id, 1 AS anon_12, metadata_fields.field_name AS field_name, 1 AS anon_13, metadata_part.ordinal AS ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'part', 'part', to_jsonb(metadata_part)) AS jsonb_build_object_3 
FROM metadata_fields JOIN LATERAL ops.pdf_artifact_parts(metadata_fields.product_id, metadata_fields.revision_id, false, ARRAY[CAST(metadata_fields.stream_id AS TEXT)]) AS metadata_part ON metadata_fields.product_id = metadata_part.product_id AND metadata_fields.revision_id = metadata_part.revision_id AND metadata_fields.stream_id = metadata_part.stream_id UNION ALL SELECT metadata_companions.ordinal AS ordinal, metadata_companions.local_id AS local_id, 2 AS phase, '' AS field_name, 0 AS subphase, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS part_ordinal, jsonb_build_object('kind', 'close') AS event 
FROM metadata_companions), 
external AS 
(SELECT jsonb_build_object('from_pointer', selected.pointer, 'field', kb.pdf_record_reference.field_name, 'reference_id', kb.pdf_record_reference.reference_id, 'source_id', kb.pdf_record_reference.source_id, 'native_address', origin.native_address, 'source_ordinal', selected.ordinal, 'source_order', to_jsonb(walk.path), 'target', jsonb_build_object('task_id', revision.task_id, 'product_key', revision.product_key, 'content_digest', revision.logical_digest) || CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_reference.field_name IN ('source_cell_id', 'target_cell_id')) THEN jsonb_build_object('address_space', 'native_graph_cell', 'cell_id_lexical', kb.pdf_record_reference.native_pointer) ELSE jsonb_build_object('address_space', 'native_item', 'pointer', kb.pdf_record_reference.native_pointer) END, 'resolution', 'qualified_external') AS body 
FROM selected JOIN walk ON walk.path[1] = selected.ordinal JOIN kb.pdf_record_reference ON kb.pdf_record_reference.source_id = walk.record_id JOIN nodes AS origin ON origin.record_id = kb.pdf_record_reference.source_id JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_reference.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_reference.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_reference.native_pointer IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM nodes AS target 
WHERE target.record_id = kb.pdf_record_reference.target_id)) UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id, 'endpoint_ordinal', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.ordinal, 'role', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.role, 'target', jsonb_build_object('task_id', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.task_id ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id END, 'product_key', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.product_key ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key END, 'content_digest', CASE WHEN (kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id = 0) THEN revision.logical_digest ELSE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest END, 'occurrence_id', kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id), 'resolution', 'qualified_external') AS jsonb_build_object_4 
FROM kb.pdf_record_endpoint JOIN published ON kb.pdf_record_endpoint.product_id = published.build_id AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE kb.pdf_record_endpoint.relation_id IN (SELECT companion.local_id 
FROM companion 
WHERE companion.family = 'relation') AND ((kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_task_id, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_product_key, kb.pdf_record_endpoint.target_content_digest) NOT IN ((revision.task_id, revision.product_key, revision.logical_digest), (0, '@self', '@self'))) AND kb.pdf_record_endpoint.occurrence_id IN (SELECT companion.local_id 
FROM companion 
WHERE companion.family = 'occurrence'))
 SELECT output.event 
FROM (SELECT -1 AS phase, ARRAY[]::BIGINT[] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'selection_metadata', 'selected_count', (SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM selected), 'membership_sha256', (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(((((selected.pointer || chr(9)) || CAST(selected.ordinal AS TEXT)) || chr(9)) || coalesce(selected.parent_pointer, '')) || chr(10), '' ORDER BY selected.ordinal), ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS encode_1 
FROM selected)) AS event UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(selected.ordinal AS BIGINT), CAST(-1 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'record_start', 'pointer', selected.pointer, 'record_id', nodes.record_id, 'ordinal', selected.ordinal, 'parent_pointer', selected.parent_pointer, 'section_pointer', selected.section_pointer, 'label', selected.label, 'role', 'selected') AS event 
FROM selected JOIN nodes ON selected.pointer = nodes.native_address UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS phase, events.path AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'native_fragment', 'native', jsonb_build_object('kind', events.kind, 'value', events.value, 'prefix', events.prefix)) AS event 
FROM events UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(selected.ordinal AS BIGINT), CAST(3 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'record_end', 'pointer', selected.pointer) AS event 
FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(access.ordinal AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'context', 'kind', 'ancestor', 'pointer', access.pointer, 'ordinal', access.ordinal, 'parent_pointer', access.parent_pointer, 'label', access.label, 'name', access.native_json['name']) AS event 
FROM access 
WHERE access.pointer IN (SELECT ancestors.pointer 
FROM ancestors) UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r.pointer, r.region_index) AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'context', 'kind', 'frame', 'body', (to_jsonb(r) - 'product_id') - 'revision_id') AS event 
FROM kb.pdf_record_region AS r JOIN published ON r.product_id = published.build_id AND r.revision_id = published.build_id 
WHERE r.pointer IN (SELECT selected.pointer 
FROM selected) UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(0 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', CASE WHEN (companion_order.family != 'native_metadata') THEN 'companion_start' ELSE 'companion_native_start' END, 'family', companion_order.family, 'local_id', companion_order.local_id, 'ordinal', companion_order.ordinal) AS event 
FROM companion_order UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(1 AS BIGINT), CAST(anon_8.part AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'scalar_part', 'part', anon_8.part, 'encoding', 'base64', 'value', encode(substr(convert_to(companion_order.payload, 'UTF8'), CAST(anon_8.part * 32768 + 1 AS INTEGER), 32768), 'base64'), 'final', (anon_8.part + 1) * 32768 >= octet_length(companion_order.payload)) AS event 
FROM companion_order JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0, CAST(octet_length(companion_order.payload) - 1 AS INTEGER) / 32768) AS anon_8(part) ON true 
WHERE companion_order.family != 'native_metadata' UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(2 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'companion_end', 'byte_length', octet_length(companion_order.payload), 'sha256', encode(sha256(convert_to(companion_order.payload, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) AS event 
FROM companion_order 
WHERE companion_order.family != 'native_metadata' UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(1 AS BIGINT), CAST(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY companion_order.position ORDER BY metadata_events.phase, metadata_events.field_name COLLATE "C", metadata_events.subphase, metadata_events.part_ordinal) AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'companion_native_fragment', 'fragment', metadata_events.event) AS event 
FROM metadata_events JOIN companion_order ON companion_order.family = 'native_metadata' AND metadata_events.local_id = companion_order.local_id UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(companion_order.position AS BIGINT), CAST(2 AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'companion_native_end') AS event 
FROM companion_order 
WHERE companion_order.family = 'native_metadata' UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS phase, ARRAY[CAST(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(external.body AS TEXT)) AS BIGINT)] AS path, jsonb_build_object('event', 'outside_reference', 'body', external.body) AS event 
FROM external) AS output ORDER BY output.phase, output.path;
END$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_sections_rows(p_build text, p_revision text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pointer text, parent_pointer text, ordinal bigint, label text, content_layer text, name text, ancestors text[], section_pointer text, text text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH RECURSIVE access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.content_layer,
             pdf_record_access.text,
             pdf_record_access.native_json
            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_sections_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_sections_rows.p_revision))
         ), section_ancestors(section_pointer, ancestor, depth) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer AS section_pointer,
             access_1.parent_pointer AS ancestor,
             0 AS depth
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE ((access_1.label = ANY (ARRAY['section'::text, 'chapter'::text])) AND (access_1.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL))
         UNION ALL
          SELECT section_ancestors.section_pointer,
             parent_node.parent_pointer,
             (section_ancestors.depth + 1) AS anon_1
            FROM (section_ancestors
              JOIN access parent_node ON ((parent_node.pointer = section_ancestors.ancestor)))
           WHERE (parent_node.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL)
         )
  SELECT access.pointer,
     access.parent_pointer,
     access.ordinal,
     access.label,
     access.content_layer,
     (access.native_json ->> 'name'::text) AS name,
     COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(section_ancestors.ancestor ORDER BY section_ancestors.depth DESC) AS array_agg_1
            FROM section_ancestors
           WHERE (section_ancestors.section_pointer = access.pointer)), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS ancestors,
     access.section_pointer,
     access.text
    FROM access
   WHERE (access.label = ANY (ARRAY['section'::text, 'chapter'::text]))
   ORDER BY access.ordinal;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows(p_build text, p_revision text, p_section text, p_membership text)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id text, revision_id text, pointer text, ordinal bigint, label text, parent_pointer text, section_pointer text, content_layer text, text text, native_json jsonb, role character varying)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH RECURSIVE access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.content_layer,
             pdf_record_access.text,
             pdf_record_access.native_json
            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_revision))
         ), members(pointer) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE ((access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_section) AND (access_1.content_layer = 'body'::text))
         UNION ALL
          SELECT child.pointer
            FROM (access child
              JOIN members ON ((child.parent_pointer = members.pointer)))
           WHERE ((child.content_layer = 'body'::text) AND ((read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_membership = 'descendants'::text) OR (child.label <> ALL (ARRAY['section'::text, 'chapter'::text]))))
         ), ancestors(pointer) AS (
          SELECT access_1.parent_pointer AS pointer
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE ((access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_section_nodes_rows.p_section) AND (access_1.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL))
         UNION ALL
          SELECT parent.parent_pointer
            FROM (access parent
              JOIN ancestors ON ((parent.pointer = ancestors.pointer)))
           WHERE (parent.parent_pointer IS NOT NULL)
         )
  SELECT access.product_id,
     access.revision_id,
     access.pointer,
     access.ordinal,
     access.label,
     access.parent_pointer,
     access.section_pointer,
     access.content_layer,
     access.text,
     access.native_json,
         CASE
             WHEN (access.pointer IN ( SELECT members.pointer
                FROM members)) THEN 'selected'::text
             ELSE 'ancestor'::text
         END AS role
    FROM access
   WHERE ((access.pointer IN ( SELECT members.pointer
            FROM members)) OR ((access.pointer IN ( SELECT ancestors.pointer
            FROM ancestors)) AND (access.pointer <> ALL (ARRAY['#/body'::text, '#/furniture'::text]))))
   ORDER BY access.ordinal;
END

 RETURNS TABLE(local_id text, ordinal bigint, body jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH reports AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT pdf_record_companion.local_id,
             pdf_record_companion.ordinal,
                 CASE
                     WHEN ((pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'kind'::text) = 'formula_outcomes'::text) THEN pdf_record_companion.body
                     ELSE ops.pdf_companion_body(pdf_record_companion.product_id, pdf_record_companion.revision_id, pdf_record_companion.family, pdf_record_companion.local_id, pdf_record_companion.body)
                 END AS body
            FROM kb.pdf_record_companion
           WHERE ((pdf_record_companion.product_id = read_pdf_published_section_reports_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_companion.revision_id = read_pdf_published_section_reports_rows.p_revision) AND (pdf_record_companion.family = 'native_metadata'::text) AND ((pdf_record_companion.body ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['formula_outcomes'::text, 'recognition_coverage'::text])))
         )
  SELECT reports.local_id,
     reports.ordinal,
     reports.body
    FROM reports
   WHERE ((((reports.body ->> 'kind'::text) = 'formula_outcomes'::text) AND ((reports.body ->> 'pointer'::text) = ANY (read_pdf_published_section_reports_rows.p_pointers))) OR (((reports.body ->> 'kind'::text) = 'recognition_coverage'::text) AND ((reports.body['value'::text] ->> 'section_pointer'::text) = ANY (read_pdf_published_section_reports_rows.p_sections))))
   ORDER BY reports.ordinal, (reports.local_id COLLATE "C");

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_pdf_published_item_page_rows(p_build text, p_revision text, p_section text, p_membership text, p_pointer text, p_after bigint, p_limit bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id text, revision_id text, pointer text, ordinal bigint, label text, parent_pointer text, section_pointer text, content_layer text, text text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH RECURSIVE access AS (
          SELECT pdf_record_access.product_id,
             pdf_record_access.revision_id,
             pdf_record_access.pointer,
             pdf_record_access.ordinal,
             pdf_record_access.label,
             pdf_record_access.parent_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.section_pointer,
             pdf_record_access.content_layer,
             pdf_record_access.text,
             pdf_record_access.native_json
            FROM kb.pdf_record_access
           WHERE ((pdf_record_access.product_id = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_build) AND (pdf_record_access.revision_id = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_revision))
         ), members(pointer) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE ((access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section) AND (access_1.content_layer = 'body'::text))
         UNION ALL
          SELECT child.pointer
            FROM (access child
              JOIN members ON ((child.parent_pointer = members.pointer)))
           WHERE ((child.content_layer = 'body'::text) AND ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_membership = 'descendants'::text) OR (child.label <> ALL (ARRAY['section'::text, 'chapter'::text]))))
         ), page_scope(pointer) AS (
          SELECT access_1.pointer
            FROM access access_1
           WHERE (access_1.pointer = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section)
         UNION ALL
          SELECT page_child.pointer
            FROM (access page_child
              JOIN page_scope ON ((page_child.parent_pointer = page_scope.pointer)))
         )
  SELECT access.product_id,
     access.revision_id,
     access.pointer,
     access.ordinal,
     access.label,
     access.parent_pointer,
     access.section_pointer,
     access.content_layer,
     access.text
    FROM access
   WHERE (((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section IS NULL) OR ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_membership = 'direct'::text) AND ((access.section_pointer = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section) OR ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_section = '#/body'::text) AND (access.pointer IN ( SELECT members.pointer
            FROM members))))) OR ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_membership = 'descendants'::text) AND (access.pointer IN ( SELECT page_scope.pointer
            FROM page_scope)))) AND ((read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_pointer IS NULL) OR (access.pointer = read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_pointer)) AND (access.ordinal > read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_after))
   ORDER BY access.ordinal
  LIMIT read_pdf_published_item_page_rows.p_limit;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.read_published_input_batch_rows(p_project text, p_demand text, p_read text, p_use text, p_product text, p_derivation text, p_build text, p_producer_release text, p_native_task bigint, p_native_product text, p_native_digest text, p_selection_release text)

 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
BEGIN ATOMIC
 WITH companions AS MATERIALIZED (
          SELECT raw.product_id,
             raw.revision_id,
             raw.family,
             raw.local_id,
             raw.ordinal,
             ops.pdf_companion_body(raw.product_id, raw.revision_id, raw.family, raw.local_id, raw.body) AS body
            FROM kb.pdf_record_companion raw
           WHERE ((raw.product_id = read_published_input_batch_rows.p_build) AND (raw.revision_id = read_published_input_batch_rows.p_build) AND (raw.family = 'input'::text))
         )
  SELECT c.ordinal AS input_ordinal,
     (c.body ->> 'role'::text) AS input_role,
     ((c.body ->> 'task_id'::text))::bigint AS input_task_id,
     (c.body ->> 'product_key'::text) AS input_product_key,
     (c.body ->> 'content_digest'::text) AS input_content_digest,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_project AS project_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_demand AS demand_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_read AS read_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_use AS use_id,

     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_derivation AS derivation_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_selection_release AS selection_release_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_producer_release AS producer_release_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_native_task AS task_id,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_native_product AS product_key,
     read_published_input_batch_rows.p_native_digest AS content_digest,
     'pdf-companion-projection-v4:cdc7e0b4684684f77cf95df23857da984d113bcdfd4284fab4a141072464aa39'::text AS projection_id
    FROM companions c
   WHERE (c.family = 'input'::text)
   ORDER BY c.ordinal;
END
