DECLARE
 expected jsonb;
 spec jsonb;
 owner_name text;
BEGIN
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.release_finalization 
WHERE sem.release_finalization.release_id = r))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'release is not finalized', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 PERFORM sem.require_execution_projection(r);
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.release 
WHERE sem.release.release_id = r))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'unknown execution release', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 expected := data.execution_contract_descriptor();
 SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspowner) AS pg_get_userbyid_1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname = 'sem' INTO owner_name;
 -- native catalog checks begin
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.physical_contract AS artifact 
WHERE artifact.physical_id = (expected ->> 'physical_id') AND artifact.source_digest = (expected ->> 'physical_checks_source_digest')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'physical CHECK contract is unavailable', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT item_1.value 
FROM sem.physical_contract AS artifact JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(artifact.checks) AS item_1(value) ON true LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS c ON c.conrelid = to_regclass((item_1.value ->> 'relation')) AND c.conname = (item_1.value ->> 'name') AND c.contype = 'c' 
WHERE artifact.physical_id = (expected ->> 'physical_id') AND (c.oid IS NULL OR NOT c.convalidated OR pg_get_expr(c.conbin, c.conrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM (item_1.value ->> 'expression')) 
 LIMIT 1 INTO spec;
 IF (found) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = format('physical CHECK expression differs: %s.%s', coalesce(spec ->> 'relation', '<NULL>'), coalesce(spec ->> 'name', '<NULL>')), ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS rel ON rel.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS ns ON ns.oid = rel.relnamespace 
WHERE c.contype = 'c' AND expected['physical_relations'] ? (ns.nspname || '.' || rel.relname) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.physical_contract AS artifact JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(artifact.checks) AS item_1(value) ON true 
WHERE artifact.physical_id = (expected ->> 'physical_id') AND (item_1.value ->> 'relation') = (ns.nspname || '.' || rel.relname) AND (item_1.value ->> 'name') = c.conname)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'unexpected physical CHECK', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT item.value 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected['views']) AS item(value) 
WHERE to_regclass((item.value ->> 'relation')) IS NULL OR regexp_replace(regexp_replace(pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass((item.value ->> 'relation')), true), '\mAS\M', '', 'gi'), '[[:space:]();]', '', 'g') IS DISTINCT FROM regexp_replace(regexp_replace((item.value ->> 'query'), '\mAS\M', '', 'gi'), '[[:space:]();]', '', 'g') 
 LIMIT 1 INTO spec;
 IF (found) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native selected-fact view differs', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT item.value 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected['functions']) AS item(value) LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p ON p.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure((item.value ->> 'signature')) LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language AS l ON l.oid = p.prolang 
WHERE p.oid IS NULL OR CASE WHEN ((item.value ? 'body_profile')) THEN (item.value ->> 'body_profile') IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgresql-18-sql-standard-v1' OR (item.value ->> 'body_kind') IS DISTINCT FROM 'sql_standard' OR (item.value ->> 'server_major') IS DISTINCT FROM '18' OR (CAST(pg_catalog.current_setting('server_version_num') AS INTEGER) / 10000) != 18 OR p.prosqlbody IS NULL OR pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid), 'UTF8')), 'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'body_sha256') OR (SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('kind', pg_catalog.pg_depend.deptype, 'type', i.type, 'schema', i.schema, 'name', i.name, 'identity', i.identity) ORDER BY CAST(pg_catalog.pg_depend.deptype AS TEXT) COLLATE "C", i.type COLLATE "C", i.schema COLLATE "C", i.name COLLATE "C", i.identity COLLATE "C"), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.pg_identify_object(pg_catalog.pg_depend.refclassid, pg_catalog.pg_depend.refobjid, pg_catalog.pg_depend.refobjsubid) AS i ON true 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_depend.classid = CAST('pg_proc' AS REGCLASS) AND pg_catalog.pg_depend.objid = p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value['dependencies'] ELSE p.prosqlbody IS NOT NULL OR pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(p.prosrc, 'UTF8')), 'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'body_sha256') END OR p.prosecdef IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'security') AS BOOLEAN) OR p.proisstrict IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'strict') AS BOOLEAN) OR p.proleakproof IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'leakproof') AS BOOLEAN) OR p.proretset IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'setof') AS BOOLEAN) OR CAST(p.provolatile AS TEXT) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'volatility') OR CAST(p.proparallel AS TEXT) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'parallel') OR l.lanname IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'language') OR p.prorettype IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_regtype((item.value ->> 'result')) OR CASE WHEN (item.value ? 'result_definition') THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(configuration.value ORDER BY configuration.value), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_2 
FROM unnest(p.proconfig) AS configuration(value)) ELSE coalesce(to_jsonb(p.proconfig), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) END IS DISTINCT FROM item.value['config'] OR pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN ((item.value ->> 'owner') = '$migration_owner') THEN owner_name ELSE (item.value ->> 'owner') END OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_writer', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value['execute_roles'] ? 'corpus_sem_writer')) OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_reader', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value['execute_roles'] ? 'corpus_sem_reader')) OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_admitter', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value['execute_roles'] ? 'corpus_sem_admitter')) OR pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('corpus_sem_evaluator', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') IS DISTINCT FROM ((item.value['execute_roles'] ? 'corpus_sem_evaluator')) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('f', p.proowner))) AS acl 
WHERE acl.grantee = 0 AND acl.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE')) OR (item.value ? 'result_definition') AND pg_get_function_result(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'result_definition') OR (item.value ? 'argument_definition') AND pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'argument_definition') OR (item.value ? 'argument_defaults') AND pg_get_expr(p.proargdefaults, 0) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'argument_defaults') OR (item.value ? 'support') AND CAST(CAST(p.prosupport AS regproc) AS TEXT) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'support') OR (item.value ? 'cost') AND p.procost IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'cost') AS REAL) OR (item.value ? 'rows') AND p.prorows IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'rows') AS REAL) OR (item.value ? 'catalog_acl') AND (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(observed_acl.anon_1, observed_acl.privilege_type, observed_acl.is_grantable) ORDER BY observed_acl.anon_1, observed_acl.privilege_type, observed_acl.is_grantable), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_3 
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN (a.grantee = 0) THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS anon_1, a.privilege_type AS privilege_type, a.is_grantable AS is_grantable 
FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(CAST(p.proacl AS aclitem[]), pg_catalog.acldefault(CAST('f' AS "char"), CAST(p.proowner AS OID)))) AS a ORDER BY CASE WHEN (a.grantee = 0) THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END, a.privilege_type, a.is_grantable) AS observed_acl) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(bound_acl.grantee, bound_acl.privilege, bound_acl.grantable) ORDER BY bound_acl.grantee, bound_acl.privilege, bound_acl.grantable), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_4 
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ((CAST(entry.value AS JSONB) ->> 0) = '$migration_owner') THEN CAST(owner_name AS TEXT) ELSE (CAST(entry.value AS JSONB) ->> 0) END AS grantee, (CAST(entry.value AS JSONB) ->> 1) AS privilege, bool_or(CAST((CAST(entry.value AS JSONB) ->> 2) AS BOOLEAN)) AS grantable 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(item.value['catalog_acl']) AS entry(value) GROUP BY CASE WHEN ((CAST(entry.value AS JSONB) ->> 0) = '$migration_owner') THEN CAST(owner_name AS TEXT) ELSE (CAST(entry.value AS JSONB) ->> 0) END, (CAST(entry.value AS JSONB) ->> 1)) AS bound_acl) ORDER BY item.value ->> 'signature' 
 LIMIT 1 INTO spec;
 IF (found) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = format('native execution kernel differs: %s', coalesce(spec ->> 'signature', '<NULL>')), ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT item.value 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected['triggers']) AS item(value) LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS t ON t.tgrelid = to_regclass((item.value ->> 'relation')) AND t.tgname = (item.value ->> 'name') AND NOT t.tgisinternal 
WHERE t.oid IS NULL OR (t.tgenabled NOT IN ('O', 'A')) OR t.tgfoid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regprocedure((item.value ->> 'function')) OR t.tgtype != CAST((item.value ->> 'type') AS INTEGER) OR t.tgdeferrable IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'deferrable') AS BOOLEAN) OR t.tginitdeferred IS DISTINCT FROM CAST((item.value ->> 'deferred') AS BOOLEAN) OR (SELECT to_jsonb(coalesce(array_agg(CAST(a.attname AS TEXT) ORDER BY attrs.position), ARRAY[]::TEXT[])) AS to_jsonb_1 
FROM unnest(CAST(t.tgattr AS SMALLINT[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS attrs(num, position) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid = t.tgrelid AND a.attnum = attrs.num) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value['columns'] OR pg_get_expr(t.tgqual, t.tgrelid) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'when') OR encode(t.tgargs, 'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'args') 
 LIMIT 1 INTO spec;
 IF (found) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = format('native execution guard differs: %s.%s', coalesce(spec ->> 'relation', '<NULL>'), coalesce(spec ->> 'name', '<NULL>')), ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT item.value 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected['tables']) AS item(value) LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS relation ON relation.oid = to_regclass((item.value ->> 'relation')) 
WHERE relation.oid IS NULL OR relation.relkind != 'r' OR relation.relpersistence != 'p' OR relation.relrowsecurity OR relation.relforcerowsecurity OR pg_get_userbyid(relation.relowner) IS DISTINCT FROM (item.value ->> 'owner') OR (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', a.attname, 'type', format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod), 'not_null', a.attnotnull, 'identity', CAST(a.attidentity AS TEXT), 'generated', CAST(a.attgenerated AS TEXT), 'default', pg_get_expr(default_value.adbin, default_value.adrelid)) ORDER BY a.attname COLLATE "C") AS jsonb_agg_1 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef AS default_value ON default_value.adrelid = a.attrelid AND default_value.adnum = a.attnum 
WHERE a.attrelid = relation.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) IS DISTINCT FROM item.value['columns'] OR (SELECT to_jsonb((SELECT coalesce(array_agg(CAST(vector_attribute.attname AS TEXT) ORDER BY vector_position.position), ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS coalesce_1 
FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS vector_position(num, position) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS vector_attribute ON vector_attribute.attrelid = c.conrelid AND vector_attribute.attnum = vector_position.num)) AS to_jsonb_1

  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native execution requires the current declared data operation model', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.registry_row 
WHERE sem.registry_row.release_id = r AND sem.registry_row.kind = 'execution_model')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'target archive contains legacy execution model', ERRCODE = '23514';
 END IF;
 IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.artifact 
WHERE sem.artifact.release_id = r AND sem.artifact.artifact_name = 'operation/scientific-policy.json')) THEN
  PERFORM sem.require_scientific_layout(r);
 END IF;
 IF (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.deployment_admission 
WHERE sem.deployment_admission.release_id = r AND sem.deployment_admission.physical_id = (expected ->> 'physical_id') AND sem.deployment_admission.deployment_id = encode(sha256(convert_to(CAST(expected AS TEXT), 'UTF8')), 'hex') AND sem.deployment_admission.kind = 'native' AND sem.deployment_admission.content = convert_to(CAST(expected AS TEXT), 'UTF8')))) THEN
  IF (NOT (pg_has_role(SESSION_USER, 'corpus_sem_admitter', 'USAGE') OR pg_has_role(SESSION_USER, owner_name, 'MEMBER'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'native admission requires restricted admission phase', ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  PERFORM sem.record_deployment_admission(r, expected ->> 'physical_id', encode(sha256(convert_to(CAST(expected AS TEXT), 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 'native', convert_to(CAST(expected AS TEXT), 'UTF8'));
 END IF;
END

DECLARE
 p jsonb := p_payload;
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 snapshot jsonb := CAST('{}' AS JSONB);
 results jsonb;
 lim integer;
 after_key text;
 selected_view text;
 selected_max_bytes bigint;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
 scope_key text;
 epoch bigint;
 acquired_scopes jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = (p ->> 'demand_id') INTO STRICT d;
 IF (NOT ((p ? 'read_id')) AND coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) = CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN
  PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(sem.data_kind_contract.universe) AS ddo_authorize_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles || sem.data_operation_definition.output_roles) AS role_1 ON true JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = (role_1.value ->> 'kind_contract');
 END IF;
 IF (((p ? 'after') OR (p ? 'read_snapshot') OR (p ? 'frontier_at')) AND NOT ((p ? 'read_id'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'demand read selection/snapshot pins are incomplete or differ', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 selected_view := coalesce(p ->> 'view', 'frontier');
 IF ((selected_view NOT IN ('frontier', 'products', 'support'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'unknown demand read view', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 selected_max_bytes := coalesce(CAST(p ->> 'max_bytes' AS BIGINT), 8388608);
 IF (selected_max_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 67108864) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid product page byte bound', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 lim := coalesce(CAST(p ->> 'limit' AS INTEGER), 100);
 after_key := coalesce(p ->> 'after', '');
 IF (lim NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid demand read bound', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (p ? 'read_id') THEN
  SELECT ops.data_demand_read.* 
FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = (p ->> 'read_id') AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = d.id INTO STRICT boundary;
  IF (boundary.scope IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'read scope differs from its pinned acquisition', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  snapshot := ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, d.project_id);
  IF ((p ? 'read_snapshot') AND (p ->> 'read_snapshot') IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.read_snapshot OR (p ? 'frontier_at') AND CAST((p ->> 'frontier_at') AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.frontier_at) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'read acquisition pins differ', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
 ELSE
  boundary.id := 'read:' || CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS TEXT);
  boundary.demand_id := d.id;
  boundary.read_snapshot := CAST(pg_current_snapshot() AS TEXT);
  boundary.frontier_at := clock_timestamp();
  boundary.owner_xid := CAST(pg_current_xact_id() AS TEXT);
  boundary.scope := coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB));
  boundary.public_disclosure := NOT pg_has_role(coalesce(nullif(current_setting('role'), 'none'), SESSION_USER), 'corpus_sem_evaluator', 'MEMBER');
  WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry, source_set.value AS source_set 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value['entries']) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AND ops.ddo_source_set_proof_matches(source_entries.source_set, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id, source_entries.entry ->> 'member', ops.data_derivation.id, ops.demand_use.id, jsonb_build_object('member_id', ops.data_derivation_output.member_id, 'role', ops.data_derivation_output.role, 'position', ops.data_derivation_output.position, 'multiplicity', ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity)))) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(scoped_read)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM (SELECT read_scope_origins.scope AS scope, bool_or(read_scope_origins.ordinary) AS ordinary, bool_or(read_scope_origins.domain) AS domain 
FROM (SELECT ordinary_read_scopes.scope AS scope, true AS ordinary, false AS domain 
FROM (SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources ORDER BY ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source)) AS ordinary_read_scopes UNION ALL SELECT domain_read_scopes.scope AS scope, false AS ordinary, true AS domain 
FROM (SELECT record_grade_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope) AS domain_read_scopes) AS read_scope_origins GROUP BY read_scope_origins.scope ORDER BY read_scope_origins.scope) AS scoped_read INTO acquired_scopes;
  boundary.kernel_digest := '1f80f692078f149f1cd5bbb47848d9d78357e75afde167a66311b8dacb3cdb6d';
  FOR scope_key IN SELECT acquired_scope.value ->> 'scope' AS anon_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(acquired_scopes) AS acquired_scope ORDER BY acquired_scope.value ->> 'scope' LOOP
   INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope (scope, project_id, epoch) VALUES (scope_key, d.project_id, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
   SELECT ops.data_trust_scope.epoch 
FROM ops.data_trust_scope 
WHERE ops.data_trust_scope.scope = scope_key FOR SHARE INTO epoch;
   snapshot := snapshot || jsonb_build_object(scope_key, epoch);
  END LOOP;
  boundary.trust_snapshot := snapshot;
  boundary.access_universes := (WITH RECURSIVE access_scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
access_selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM access_scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = access_scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
export_support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(access_selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM access_selected_uses UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM access_scoped_obligations 
WHERE access_scoped_obligations.subject = ops.original_source_admission.subject AND access_scoped_obligations.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.original_source_admission.original_source AND access_scoped_obligations.analyzed_scope = ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope)) OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1

FROM support_export_bounded) <= lim) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE NULL END, 'attempt_failures', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('failure_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.id, 'request_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, 'generation', ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, 'task_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.task_id, 'attempt', ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt, 'holder', ops.data_attempt_failure.holder, 'failure', CASE WHEN ((ops.data_attempt_failure.failure ? 'd1_limitation') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_request JOIN jsonb_array_elements(ops.data_request.binding['inputs']) AS failure_input(value) ON true JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = (failure_input.value ->> 'product_id') LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_product_member AS failure_member ON failure_member.product_id = kb.data_product.id AND failure_member.member_id = (failure_input.value ->> 'member_id') 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND NOT CASE WHEN (NOT boundary.public_disclosure OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_kind_access(coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract)) ELSE false END))) THEN (ops.data_attempt_failure.failure - 'd1_limitation') || jsonb_build_object('d1_limitation_disclosure', 'undisclosed') ELSE ops.data_attempt_failure.failure END) ORDER BY ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_9 
FROM ops.data_attempt_failure 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.request_id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND selected_uses.generation = ops.data_attempt_failure.generation)) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_attempt_failure.created_at, ops.data_attempt_failure.created_xid, boundary)), 'populations', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(((((to_jsonb(data_population) - 'created_at') - 'created_xid') - 'selected_obligation_id') - 'context_key') || jsonb_build_object('population_id', ops.data_population.id, 'evidence', ops.data_population.evidence || jsonb_build_object('producer_context', ops.ddo_population_producer_context(data_population))) ORDER BY ops.data_population.name), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_10 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.id IN (SELECT candidate_populations.id 
FROM candidate_populations) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM page_validity 
WHERE page_validity.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = page_validity.id AND page_validity.valid))), 'continuation', CASE WHEN ((SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT ops.data_obligation.id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.data_obligation.id > (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) AND (NOT (p ? 'obligation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.id = (p ->> 'obligation_id'))))) THEN jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'selection', CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND boundary.scope != CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN jsonb_build_object('version', 'data-demand-public-selection-v1', 'model', d.selection['model'], 'intent_digest', ops.ddo_digest(d.selection), 'roots', d.selection['roots'], 'targets', d.selection['targets'], 'root_operations', d.selection['root_operations'], 'discovery', d.selection['discovery']) ELSE d.selection END, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'view', selected_view, 'after', (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded), 'limit', lim, 'max_bytes', selected_max_bytes) ELSE NULL END)) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END AS result INTO results;
 IF (selected_view IN ('products', 'support') AND octet_length(data.canonical_json(results)) > selected_max_bytes) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'complete native product page envelope exceeds max_bytes; reduce the page limit', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 RETURN results;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.ddo_impl_read_demand_result(p_payload jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp' AS $$DECLARE
 p jsonb := p_payload;
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 snapshot jsonb := CAST('{}' AS JSONB);
 results jsonb;
 lim integer;
 after_key text;
 selected_view text;
 selected_max_bytes bigint;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
 scope_key text;
 epoch bigint;
 acquired_scopes jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = (p ->> 'demand_id') INTO STRICT d;
 IF (NOT ((p ? 'read_id')) AND coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) = CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN
  PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(sem.data_kind_contract.universe) AS ddo_authorize_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles || sem.data_operation_definition.output_roles) AS role_1 ON true JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = (role_1.value ->> 'kind_contract');
 END IF;
 IF (((p ? 'after') OR (p ? 'read_snapshot') OR (p ? 'frontier_at')) AND NOT ((p ? 'read_id'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'demand read selection/snapshot pins are incomplete or differ', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 selected_view := coalesce(p ->> 'view', 'frontier');
 IF ((selected_view NOT IN ('frontier', 'products', 'support'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'unknown demand read view', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 selected_max_bytes := coalesce(CAST(p ->> 'max_bytes' AS BIGINT), 8388608);
 IF (selected_max_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 67108864) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid product page byte bound', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 lim := coalesce(CAST(p ->> 'limit' AS INTEGER), 100);
 after_key := coalesce(p ->> 'after', '');
 IF (lim NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid demand read bound', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (p ? 'read_id') THEN
  SELECT ops.data_demand_read.* 
FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = (p ->> 'read_id') AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = d.id INTO STRICT boundary;
  IF (boundary.scope IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'read scope differs from its pinned acquisition', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  snapshot := ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, d.project_id);
  IF ((p ? 'read_snapshot') AND (p ->> 'read_snapshot') IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.read_snapshot OR (p ? 'frontier_at') AND CAST((p ->> 'frontier_at') AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.frontier_at) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'read acquisition pins differ', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
 ELSE
  boundary.id := 'read:' || CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS TEXT);
  boundary.demand_id := d.id;
  boundary.read_snapshot := CAST(pg_current_snapshot() AS TEXT);
  boundary.frontier_at := clock_timestamp();
  boundary.owner_xid := CAST(pg_current_xact_id() AS TEXT);
  boundary.scope := coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB));
  boundary.public_disclosure := NOT pg_has_role(coalesce(nullif(current_setting('role'), 'none'), SESSION_USER), 'corpus_sem_evaluator', 'MEMBER');
  WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry, source_set.value AS source_set 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value['entries']) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AND ops.ddo_source_set_proof_matches(source_entries.source_set, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id, source_entries.entry ->> 'member', ops.data_derivation.id, ops.demand_use.id, jsonb_build_object('member_id', ops.data_derivation_output.member_id, 'role', ops.data_derivation_output.role, 'position', ops.data_derivation_output.position, 'multiplicity', ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity)))) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(scoped_read)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1 
FROM (SELECT read_scope_origins.scope AS scope, bool_or(read_scope_origins.ordinary) AS ordinary, bool_or(read_scope_origins.domain) AS domain 
FROM (SELECT ordinary_read_scopes.scope AS scope, true AS ordinary, false AS domain 
FROM (SELECT ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source) AS scope 
FROM support_sources ORDER BY ops.ddo_scope(d.project_id, support_sources.source)) AS ordinary_read_scopes UNION ALL SELECT domain_read_scopes.scope AS scope, false AS ordinary, true AS domain 
FROM (SELECT record_grade_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_grade_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_grade_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT record_fit_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_record_fit_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS record_fit_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT operation_event_scope.scope AS scope 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id JOIN ops.ddo_operation_event_dependency_scopes(ops.data_derivation.id) AS operation_event_scope(scope) ON true 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope) AS domain_read_scopes) AS read_scope_origins GROUP BY read_scope_origins.scope ORDER BY read_scope_origins.scope) AS scoped_read INTO acquired_scopes;
  boundary.kernel_digest := '1f80f692078f149f1cd5bbb47848d9d78357e75afde167a66311b8dacb3cdb6d';
  FOR scope_key IN SELECT acquired_scope.value ->> 'scope' AS anon_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(acquired_scopes) AS acquired_scope ORDER BY acquired_scope.value ->> 'scope' LOOP
   INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope (scope, project_id, epoch) VALUES (scope_key, d.project_id, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
   SELECT ops.data_trust_scope.epoch 
FROM ops.data_trust_scope 
WHERE ops.data_trust_scope.scope = scope_key FOR SHARE INTO epoch;
   snapshot := snapshot || jsonb_build_object(scope_key, epoch);
  END LOOP;
  boundary.trust_snapshot := snapshot;
  boundary.access_universes := (WITH RECURSIVE access_scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
access_selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM access_scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = access_scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
export_support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(access_selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM access_selected_uses UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM access_scoped_obligations 
WHERE access_scoped_obligations.subject = ops.original_source_admission.subject AND access_scoped_obligations.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.original_source_admission.original_source AND access_scoped_obligations.analyzed_scope = ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope)) OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1

FROM support_export_bounded) <= lim) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END ELSE NULL END, 'attempt_failures', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('failure_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.id, 'request_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, 'generation', ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, 'task_id', ops.data_attempt_failure.task_id, 'attempt', ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt, 'holder', ops.data_attempt_failure.holder, 'failure', CASE WHEN ((ops.data_attempt_failure.failure ? 'd1_limitation') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.data_request JOIN jsonb_array_elements(ops.data_request.binding['inputs']) AS failure_input(value) ON true JOIN kb.data_product ON kb.data_product.id = (failure_input.value ->> 'product_id') LEFT OUTER JOIN kb.data_product_member AS failure_member ON failure_member.product_id = kb.data_product.id AND failure_member.member_id = (failure_input.value ->> 'member_id') 
WHERE ops.data_request.id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND NOT CASE WHEN (NOT boundary.public_disclosure OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM sem.data_kind_contract 
WHERE sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract) AND sem.data_kind_contract.universe IN ('ordinary', 'source')))) THEN ops.ddo_kind_access(coalesce(failure_member.kind_contract, kb.data_product.kind_contract)) ELSE false END))) THEN (ops.data_attempt_failure.failure - 'd1_limitation') || jsonb_build_object('d1_limitation_disclosure', 'undisclosed') ELSE ops.data_attempt_failure.failure END) ORDER BY ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id, ops.data_attempt_failure.generation, ops.data_attempt_failure.attempt), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_9 
FROM ops.data_attempt_failure 
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM selected_uses 
WHERE selected_uses.request_id = ops.data_attempt_failure.request_id AND selected_uses.generation = ops.data_attempt_failure.generation)) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_attempt_failure.created_at, ops.data_attempt_failure.created_xid, boundary)), 'populations', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(((((to_jsonb(data_population) - 'created_at') - 'created_xid') - 'selected_obligation_id') - 'context_key') || jsonb_build_object('population_id', ops.data_population.id, 'evidence', ops.data_population.evidence || jsonb_build_object('producer_context', ops.ddo_population_producer_context(data_population))) ORDER BY ops.data_population.name), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_10 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.id IN (SELECT candidate_populations.id 
FROM candidate_populations) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM page_validity 
WHERE page_validity.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = page_validity.id AND page_validity.valid))), 'continuation', CASE WHEN ((SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT ops.data_obligation.id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary) AND ops.data_obligation.id > (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded) AND (NOT (p ? 'obligation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.id = (p ->> 'obligation_id'))))) THEN jsonb_build_object('demand_id', d.id, 'scope', boundary.scope, 'selection', CASE WHEN (boundary.public_disclosure AND boundary.scope != CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN jsonb_build_object('version', 'data-demand-public-selection-v1', 'model', d.selection['model'], 'intent_digest', ops.ddo_digest(d.selection), 'roots', d.selection['roots'], 'targets', d.selection['targets'], 'root_operations', d.selection['root_operations'], 'discovery', d.selection['discovery']) ELSE d.selection END, 'trust_snapshot', boundary.trust_snapshot, 'read_id', boundary.id, 'read_snapshot', boundary.read_snapshot, 'frontier_at', boundary.frontier_at, 'view', selected_view, 'after', (SELECT max(bounded.id) AS max_2 
FROM bounded), 'limit', lim, 'max_bytes', selected_max_bytes) ELSE NULL END)) ELSE ops.ddo_result_bytes_refusal() END AS result INTO results;
 IF (selected_view IN ('products', 'support') AND octet_length(data.canonical_json(results)) > selected_max_bytes) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'complete native product page envelope exceeds max_bytes; reduce the page limit', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;

ALTER FUNCTION ops.ddo_impl_read_demand_result (jsonb) OWNER TO corpus_sem_publisher
REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON FUNCTION ops.ddo_impl_read_demand_result (jsonb) FROM PUBLIC

DECLARE
 p jsonb := p_payload;
 d ops.data_demand%ROWTYPE;
 snapshot jsonb := CAST('{}' AS JSONB);
 results jsonb;
 lim integer;
 after_key text;
 selected_view text;
 selected_max_bytes bigint;
 boundary ops.data_demand_read%ROWTYPE;
 scope_key text;
 epoch bigint;
 acquired_scopes jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT ops.data_demand.* 
FROM ops.data_demand 
WHERE ops.data_demand.id = (p ->> 'demand_id') INTO STRICT d;
 IF (NOT ((p ? 'read_id')) AND coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) = CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) THEN
  PERFORM ops.ddo_authorize(sem.data_kind_contract.universe) AS ddo_authorize_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.selection['operations']) AS selected JOIN sem.data_operation_definition ON sem.data_operation_definition.release_id = d.release_id AND sem.data_operation_definition.operation_id = (selected.value ->> 'operation') JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(sem.data_operation_definition.input_roles || sem.data_operation_definition.output_roles) AS role_1 ON true JOIN sem.data_kind_contract ON sem.data_kind_contract.kind_contract = (role_1.value ->> 'kind_contract');
 END IF;
 IF (((p ? 'after') OR (p ? 'read_snapshot') OR (p ? 'frontier_at')) AND NOT ((p ? 'read_id'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'demand read selection/snapshot pins are incomplete or differ', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 selected_view := coalesce(p ->> 'view', 'frontier');
 IF ((selected_view NOT IN ('frontier', 'products', 'support'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'unknown demand read view', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 selected_max_bytes := coalesce(CAST(p ->> 'max_bytes' AS BIGINT), 8388608);
 IF (selected_max_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 67108864) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid product page byte bound', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 lim := coalesce(CAST(p ->> 'limit' AS INTEGER), 100);
 after_key := coalesce(p ->> 'after', '');
 IF (lim NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'invalid demand read bound', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
 END IF;
 IF (p ? 'read_id') THEN
  SELECT ops.data_demand_read.* 
FROM ops.data_demand_read 
WHERE ops.data_demand_read.id = (p ->> 'read_id') AND ops.data_demand_read.demand_id = d.id INTO STRICT boundary;
  IF (boundary.scope IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'read scope differs from its pinned acquisition', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  snapshot := ops.ddo_require_read_current(boundary, d.project_id);
  IF ((p ? 'read_snapshot') AND (p ->> 'read_snapshot') IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.read_snapshot OR (p ? 'frontier_at') AND CAST((p ->> 'frontier_at') AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) IS DISTINCT FROM boundary.frontier_at) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE = 'read acquisition pins differ', ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
 ELSE
  boundary.id := 'read:' || CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS TEXT);
  boundary.demand_id := d.id;
  boundary.read_snapshot := CAST(pg_current_snapshot() AS TEXT);
  boundary.frontier_at := clock_timestamp();
  boundary.owner_xid := CAST(pg_current_xact_id() AS TEXT);
  boundary.scope := coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB));
  boundary.public_disclosure := NOT pg_has_role(coalesce(nullif(current_setting('role'), 'none'), SESSION_USER), 'corpus_sem_evaluator', 'MEMBER');
  WITH RECURSIVE source_entries AS 
(SELECT source_entry.value AS entry, source_set.value AS source_set 
FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(d.selection['source_sets'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB))) AS source_set(key, value) JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_set.value['entries']) AS source_entry(value) ON true), 
direct_sources AS 
(SELECT root.value ->> 'original_source' AS source 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.root) AS root(value) UNION SELECT source_entries.entry ->> 'original_source' AS anon_1 
FROM source_entries), 
selected_use_seeds AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (ops.demand_use.obligation_id) ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.obligation_id, ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC), 
support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(selected_use_seeds.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM selected_use_seeds 
WHERE true UNION SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE ops.data_population.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_population.created_at, ops.data_population.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.derivation_id = ops.data_derivation.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM source_entries 
WHERE (source_entries.entry ->> 'product') = ops.data_derivation_output.product_id AND ops.ddo_source_set_proof_matches(source_entries.source_set, ops.data_derivation_output.product_id, source_entries.entry ->> 'member', ops.data_derivation.id, ops.demand_use.id, jsonb_build_object('member_id', ops.data_derivation_output.member_id, 'role', ops.data_derivation_output.role, 'position', ops.data_derivation_output.position, 'multiplicity', ops.data_derivation_output.multiplicity)))) AND ops.demand_use.fate = 'fulfilled' AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.original_source_admission.created_at, ops.original_source_admission.created_xid, boundary)), 
support_closure(kind, id) AS 
(SELECT support_seed.kind AS kind, support_seed.id AS id 
FROM support_seed 
WHERE support_seed.id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT support_edge.kind AS kind, support_edge.id AS id 
FROM support_closure JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(coalesce(ops.data_derivation_support.admission_use_id, ops.data_derivation_support.support_derivation_id) AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_derivation_original_support.admission_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_derivation_original_support 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation_original_support.derivation_id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('episode' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN 'original' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'use' ELSE 'episode' END AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(CASE WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'kind') IN ('original-source', 'authored')) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_id' WHEN ((selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id') IS NOT NULL) THEN selected_support_reference.value ->> 'admission_use_id' ELSE selected_support_reference.value ->> 'derivation_id' END AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['support'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_support_reference(value) ON true 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.data_population.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.demand_use JOIN jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ops.demand_use.selection['populations'], CAST('[]' AS JSONB))) AS selected_population_reference(value) ON true JOIN ops.data_population ON ops.data_population.id = (selected_population_reference.value ->> 'population_id') AND ops.data_population.demand_id = ops.demand_use.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'use' AND ops.demand_use.id = support_closure.id AND true UNION ALL SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.demand_use.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population JOIN ops.demand_use ON ops.demand_use.id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'admission_use_id') AND ops.demand_use.derivation_id = (ops.data_population.evidence ->> 'derivation_id') AND ops.demand_use.demand_id = ops.data_population.demand_id 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id UNION ALL SELECT CAST('population' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST((ops.data_population.evidence['selection']) ->> 'parent_population_id' AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.data_population 
WHERE support_closure.kind = 'population' AND ops.data_population.id = support_closure.id) AS support_edge ON true 
WHERE support_edge.id IS NOT NULL), 
support_sources AS 
(SELECT direct_sources.source AS source 
FROM direct_sources UNION SELECT ops.data_request.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.data_derivation ON support_closure.kind = 'episode' AND ops.data_derivation.id = support_closure.id JOIN ops.data_request ON ops.data_request.id = ops.data_derivation.request_id 
WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id UNION SELECT ops.original_source_admission.original_source AS source 
FROM support_closure JOIN ops.original_source_admission ON support_closure.kind = 'original' AND ops.original_source_admission.id = support_closure.id 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.project_id = d.project_id)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(scoped_read)), CAST('[]' AS JSONB)) AS coalesce_1

WHERE ops.data_request.project_id = d.project_id ORDER BY scope) AS domain_read_scopes) AS read_scope_origins GROUP BY read_scope_origins.scope ORDER BY read_scope_origins.scope) AS scoped_read INTO acquired_scopes;
  boundary.kernel_digest := 'e9c4e17612a421f4da3ce48ac19b65008cb19db8c7d570f88ea459353b83e43e';
  FOR scope_key IN SELECT acquired_scope.value ->> 'scope' AS anon_1 
FROM jsonb_array_elements(acquired_scopes) AS acquired_scope ORDER BY acquired_scope.value ->> 'scope' LOOP
   INSERT INTO ops.data_trust_scope (scope, project_id, epoch) VALUES (scope_key, d.project_id, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
   SELECT ops.data_trust_scope.epoch 
FROM ops.data_trust_scope 
WHERE ops.data_trust_scope.scope = scope_key FOR SHARE INTO epoch;
   snapshot := snapshot || jsonb_build_object(scope_key, epoch);
  END LOOP;
  boundary.trust_snapshot := snapshot;
  boundary.access_universes := (WITH RECURSIVE access_scoped_obligations AS 
(SELECT ops.data_obligation.id AS id, ops.data_obligation.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.data_obligation.operation_id AS operation_id, ops.data_obligation.subject AS subject, ops.data_obligation.original_source AS original_source, ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AS analyzed_scope, ops.data_obligation.parameters AS parameters, ops.data_obligation.created_at AS created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.data_obligation 
WHERE ops.data_obligation.demand_id = d.id AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'operation_id') OR ops.data_obligation.operation_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'operation_id')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'subject') OR ops.data_obligation.subject IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'subject')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'original_source') OR ops.data_obligation.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ->> 'original_source')) AND (NOT (coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)) ? 'product_ids') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_use JOIN ops.data_derivation_output ON ops.data_derivation_output.derivation_id = scope_use.derivation_id JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON ops.data_derivation_output.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_use.obligation_id = ops.data_obligation.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_use.created_at, scope_use.created_xid, boundary) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.demand_use AS scope_later_use 
WHERE scope_later_use.obligation_id = scope_use.obligation_id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_later_use.created_at, scope_later_use.created_xid, boundary) AND (scope_later_use.created_at > scope_use.created_at OR scope_later_use.created_at = scope_use.created_at AND scope_later_use.id > scope_use.id))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM ops.original_source_admission AS scope_original JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text((coalesce(p['scope'], CAST('{}' AS JSONB)))['product_ids']) AS scope_product(value) ON scope_original.product_id = scope_product.value 
WHERE scope_original.demand_id = d.id AND scope_original.project_id = d.project_id AND scope_original.subject = ops.data_obligation.subject AND scope_original.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.data_obligation.original_source AND scope_original.analyzed_scope = ops.data_obligation.analyzed_scope AND ops.ddo_read_visible(scope_original.created_at, scope_original.created_xid, boundary)))) AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.data_obligation.created_at, ops.data_obligation.created_xid, boundary)), 
access_selected_uses AS 
(SELECT latest.id AS id, latest.demand_id AS demand_id, latest.obligation_id AS obligation_id, latest.fate AS fate, latest.request_id AS request_id, latest.generation AS generation, latest.derivation_id AS derivation_id, latest.selection AS selection, latest.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, latest.created_at AS created_at, latest.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM access_scoped_obligations JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ops.demand_use.id AS id, ops.demand_use.demand_id AS demand_id, ops.demand_use.obligation_id AS obligation_id, ops.demand_use.fate AS fate, ops.demand_use.request_id AS request_id, ops.demand_use.generation AS generation, ops.demand_use.derivation_id AS derivation_id, ops.demand_use.selection AS selection, ops.demand_use.trust_snapshot AS trust_snapshot, ops.demand_use.created_at AS created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid AS created_xid 
FROM ops.demand_use 
WHERE ops.demand_use.obligation_id = access_scoped_obligations.id AND ops.ddo_read_visible(ops.demand_use.created_at, ops.demand_use.created_xid, boundary) ORDER BY ops.demand_use.created_at DESC, ops.demand_use.id DESC 
 LIMIT 1) AS latest ON true), 
export_support_seed AS 
(SELECT CAST('use' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(access_selected_uses.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM access_selected_uses UNION SELECT CAST('original' AS TEXT) AS kind, CAST(ops.original_source_admission.id AS TEXT) AS id 
FROM ops.original_source_admission 
WHERE ops.original_source_admission.demand_id = d.id AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM access_scoped_obligations 
WHERE access_scoped_obligations.subject = ops.original_source_admission.subject AND access_scoped_obligations.original_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ops.original_source_admission.original_source AND access_scoped_obligations.analyzed_scope = ops.original_source_admission.analyzed_scope)) OR NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1
